name: 封面
role: 开场 · 第 1 页
summary: 左侧是编辑感标题与导语，右侧一个超大展示数字，底部三项关键事实。数字会随鼠标轻微漂移。
summaryEn: Editorial title and lead on the left, one oversized display numeral on the right, three key facts along the bottom. The numeral drifts slightly with the mouse.
useWhen: 整份演示的第一页
主题能浓缩成一个数字或短代号：版本号、年份、季度、排名
useWhenEn: The first slide of a deck
The subject condenses into one number or short code: a version number, year, quarter, rank
avoidWhen: 主题没有能代表它的数字：此时用 numeral 放首字母或年份后两位，而不是硬凑
章节分隔页：分隔页用 Teaser 更克制
avoidWhenEn: The subject has no number that represents it: put an initial or the last two digits of a year in numeral instead of forcing one
A section break: Teaser is more restrained for that
limits: numeral 1–4 个字符；3–4 个字符时字号自动缩小
title 1–2 行，每行 ≤ 12 个字符；subtitle ≤ 10 个字符，并且比 numeral 窄，否则会贴近大数字
facts 2–4 项，每个 value ≤ 10 个字符
没有 source 字段：封面上的事实必须在后面某页出现并带出处
limitsEn: numeral 1–4 characters; at 3–4 characters the size shrinks automatically
title 1–2 lines, ≤ 12 characters per line; subtitle ≤ 10 characters and narrower than numeral, otherwise it crowds the big numeral
No source field: any fact on the cover must appear on a later slide with its source
interaction: 鼠标移动时数字轻微跟随；数字逐位从遮罩中升起。
interactionEn: The numeral follows the mouse slightly; its digits rise out of a mask one by one.

props.name: subtitle
props.note: 衬线斜体第二行，自动加引号，适合代号、口号
props.noteEn: Serif italic second line, quoted automatically; suits codenames and taglines

props.name: lead
props.note: 一句话说明这份演示讲什么，≤ 60 字
props.noteEn: One sentence on what this deck covers, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: note
props.note: 右上角小注，适合冷知识
props.noteEn: Small note in the top right; suits trivia

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉操作提示，封面建议写“按 → 翻页”
props.noteEn: Header operation hint; on the cover, use "Press → to advance"

example:
<Cover
  kicker="Release Briefing · 版本发布解读"
  title="Lumen 13"
  subtitle="aurora"
  lead="2025 年 8 月 9 日发布的新稳定版。这份简报梳理它的主要变化与升级路径。"
  facts={[
    { label: '发布', value: '2025.08.09' },
    { label: '支持', value: '5 年' },
    { label: '官方架构', value: '7 个' },
  ]}
  numeral="13"
  note={['代号 aurora', '取自北方夜空里的极光']}
/>

name: Bento 总览
role: 总览 · 紧跟封面
summary: 6 张不同尺寸的卡片组成全局概览，每张都能展开为全屏详情，卡片标题、编号和主数字以共享元素动画过渡。
summaryEn: Six cards of different sizes form a global overview; each expands to a full-screen detail, with card title, number and main figure carried by a shared-element transition.
useWhen: 需要一页讲清“这是什么”，并允许听众按兴趣深入
有 6 个并列主题，其中 1 个是最重要的（放在第 1 格）
useWhenEn: One slide must explain what this is and let the audience go deeper by interest
There are 6 parallel topics and 1 of them matters most (in slot 1)
avoidWhen: 主题不足 6 个：不要凑数，改用 NumberedColumns
每个主题的详情你说不出一张图或一张表：详情页会空洞
一份演示里使用超过一次
avoidWhenEn: Fewer than 6 topics: do not pad, use NumberedColumns
You cannot name one figure or table for a topic's detail: the detail page will be empty
Used more than once in one deck
limits: cards 必须正好 6 张；顺序即位置：1 大卡（左），2–3 宽卡（右上），4–6 小卡（底部）
标题必须预先断行且不会自动换行：第 1 格 1 行；第 2–3 格 ≤ 2 行 × 8 字；第 4–6 格 1 行 ≤ 12 字
feature.stats 正好 3 项，value ≤ 7 个字符
limitsEn: cards exactly 6; order is position: 1 large (left), 2–3 wide (top right), 4–6 small (bottom)
Titles must be pre-broken and never wrap: slot 1 one line; slots 2–3 ≤ 2 lines × 8 chars; slots 4–6 one line ≤ 12 chars
interaction: 点击或 Tab + Enter 展开；Esc 返回并把焦点还给原卡片；详情打开时方向键不会翻页。
interactionEn: Click or Tab + Enter to expand; Esc returns and gives focus back to the card; arrow keys do not change slides while a detail is open.

props.name: cards
props.note: id, title[], summary, lead, source, mini?, detail, aside?, figure?
props.noteEn: id, title[], summary, lead, source, mini?, detail, aside?, figure?

props.name: feature
props.note: 第 1 格专用：numeral, codename?, pill?, date?, stats[3]
props.noteEn: Slot 1 only: numeral, codename?, pill?, date?, stats[3]

props.name: card.mini
props.note: 卡片上的小图形（第 2–6 格），纯 DOM/CSS，参考 decks/release/minis.tsx
props.noteEn: Small graphic on a card (slots 2–6), plain DOM/CSS; see decks/release/minis.tsx

props.name: card.detail
props.note: 详情页右栏：图表、代码对照、表格，参考 decks/release/details.tsx
props.noteEn: Right column of the detail page: chart, code comparison, table; see decks/release/details.tsx

props.name: card.figure
props.note: 详情页左下的锚点大数字
props.noteEn: Anchor figure at the lower left of the detail page

props.name: card.aside
props.note: 替代 figure 的自定义块，例如一条命令
props.noteEn: Custom block instead of figure, for example one command

example:
<Bento
  cards={[
    { id: 'release', title: ['Lumen 13'], summary: '…', lead: '…', source: '…', detail: <ReleaseVisual /> },
    { id: 'apt', title: ['APT 源改用', 'deb822 格式'], summary: '…', lead: '…', source: '…',
      mini: <MiniCode />, detail: <AptVisual />, aside: <AptAside /> },
    // …共 6 张
  ]}
  feature={{ numeral: '13', codename: 'aurora', pill: 'Stable', date: '2025.08.09',
    stats: [{ label: '软件包总数', value: '69,830+' }, { label: '官方架构', value: '7' }, { label: '支持周期', value: '5 年' }] }}
/>

name: 数字条
role: 数据 · 规模与占比
summary: 左栏论点，右栏 2–4 个大数字配比例条，可选一行强调色的合计。左栏底部可放一句衬线体结论。
summaryEn: Argument on the left; on the right 2–4 big numbers with share bars, plus an optional accent total row. A serif conclusion can sit at the lower left.
useWhen: 几个可加总或可比较的数量：新增 / 更新 / 删除，收入构成，用户分层
需要让听众记住一个比例
useWhenEn: A few quantities that add up or compare: added / updated / removed, revenue mix, user segments
The audience should remember one proportion
avoidWhen: 数字之间没有可比性（单位不同）：改用 SpotlightList
超过 4 个数：改用表格或拆页
数据随时间变化：改用 Timeline
avoidWhenEn: The numbers are not comparable (different units): use SpotlightList
More than 4 numbers: use a table or split the slide
Data changes over time: use Timeline
limits: rows 2–4 行（含 total 最多 5 行）
interaction: 比例条依次生长；数字使用等宽数字并右对齐，便于纵向比较。
interactionEn: Share bars grow in sequence; numbers use tabular figures and are right-aligned for vertical comparison.

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: rows
props.note: suffix 显示为灰色上标，如 “+” 表示“超过”
props.noteEn: suffix shows as a grey superscript, e.g. "+" for "over"

props.name: total
props.note: 强调色合计行；比例以它为分母，否则以最大值为分母
props.noteEn: Accent total row; shares use it as denominator, otherwise the largest value

props.name: pull
props.noteEn: Conclusion at the lower left, for example 1 / 5

props.name: shares
props.note: 是否显示 ≈% 列，默认 true；各行不是同一整体的部分时关掉
props.noteEn: Whether to show the ≈% column, default true; turn it off when rows are not parts of one whole

example:
<MetricBars
  kicker="软件包"
  title="数字里的 aurora"
  lead="与 Lumen 12 相比，超过 14,116 个新软件包进入仓库。"
  rows={[
    { label: '新增', value: 14116, suffix: '+' },
    { label: '更新', value: 44326, suffix: '+' },
  ]}
  total={{ label: '软件包总数', value: 69830, suffix: '+' }}
  pull={{ figure: '1 / 5', text: '每五个软件包里，约有一个是新增的。' }}
  source="Lumen 发布公告（示意） 2025-08-09"
/>

name: 时间线
role: 时间 · 周期与路线图
summary: 共享日历轴上的分段条，自动标注每个分界日期、画出“今天”并给过去的时间加斜纹；可选 3 个按浏览者时钟实时计算的倒计时。
summaryEn: Segment bars on a shared calendar axis; it labels each boundary date, draws today and hatches time already past; optionally 3 countdowns computed live from the viewer's clock.
useWhen: 支持周期、合同期限、版本路线图、项目阶段
想让听众意识到“还剩多久”
useWhenEn: Support periods, contract terms, release roadmaps, project phases
The audience should feel how much time is left
avoidWhen: 只有一个日期：放进 Cover 的 facts
超过 3 行：拆成两页
事件是离散的点而不是区间：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: Only one date: put it in Cover's facts
More than 3 rows: split across two slides
Events are discrete points, not ranges: use StepTrack
limits: rows 1–3 行；有 countdowns 时 ≤ 2 行
每行 segments 首尾相接，1–3 段
段内 label 要比段短：一年长的段 ≤ 6 字
轴两端各留约半年空白
limitsEn: segments on each row are contiguous, 1–3 per row
A segment label must be shorter than the segment: ≤ 6 chars for a one-year segment
About half a year of blank space at each end of the axis
interaction: 分段依次生长；“今天”与倒计时在每次打开时按当前日期计算，演示不会过期。
interactionEn: Segments grow in sequence; today and the countdowns are computed from the current date on every open, so the deck never expires.

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: axis
props.note: 可见范围，年份刻度自动生成
props.noteEn: Visible range; year ticks are generated

props.name: rows
props.note: name, code?, segments[{ from, to, label?, tone }], planned?
props.noteEn: name, code?, segments[{ from, to, label?, tone }], planned?

props.name: legend
props.noteEn: Legend text for the two tones

props.name: today
props.note: 是否画“今天”线与过去斜纹，默认 true
props.noteEn: Whether to draw the today line and the hatching over past time, default true

example:
<Timeline
  kicker="支持周期"
  title="birch 已转入 LTS"
  axis={{ from: '2023-01-01', to: '2031-01-01' }}
  legend={{ ink: '常规安全支持', accent: 'LTS 长期支持' }}
  rows={[{
    name: 'Lumen 12', code: 'birch',
    segments: [
      { from: '2023-06-10', to: '2026-07-12', label: '常规安全支持', tone: 'ink' },
      { from: '2026-07-12', to: '2028-06-30', label: 'LTS', tone: 'accent' },
    ],
  }]}
  countdowns={[{ label: 'birch 剩余维护', until: '2028-06-30' }]}
  source="wiki.example.org/LTS"
/>

name: 聚焦列表
role: 数据 · 名称 + 数值
summary: 右栏是名称与超大数值的列表，第一项用强调色和更大字号聚焦。左栏可附一个 KeyValue 细节表。
summaryEn: The right column is a list of names with oversized values; the first item is spotlighted with accent colour and a larger size. The left column can carry a KeyValue detail table.
useWhen: 一组“名称 → 版本 / 分数 / 数量”，其中一项是重点
排行榜、组件版本、地区数据
useWhenEn: A set of name → version / score / count, with one item that matters
Rankings, component versions, regional data
avoidWhen: 需要展示前后变化：用 CompareTable
数值是可加总的数量：用 MetricBars
没有明确的重点项
avoidWhenEn: Before and after must be shown: use CompareTable
Values are quantities that add up: use MetricBars
No item clearly stands out
limits: items 3–6 项；第一项为聚焦项
name ≤ 14 个字符；tag ≤ 8 字，只给第一项
limitsEn: items 3–6; the first item is the spotlight
name ≤ 14 characters; tag ≤ 8 chars, first item only

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: items
props.note: 第一项会被放大并着强调色
props.noteEn: The first item is enlarged and set in the accent colour

props.name: extra
props.note: 列表下方的灰色补充行
props.noteEn: Grey supplementary line below the list

props.name: detail
props.note: 左栏底部的补充块，通常是 <KeyValue rows={…} />
props.noteEn: Supplementary block at the lower left, usually <KeyValue rows={…} />

example:
<SpotlightList
  kicker="桌面"
  title={['KDE Plasma 6', '首次进入 Lumen']}
  items={[
    { name: 'KDE Plasma', value: '6.3', tag: '全新大版本' },
    { name: 'GNOME', value: '48' },
    { name: 'Xfce', value: '4.20' },
  ]}
  detail={<KeyValue rows={[{ key: 'Qt 6', value: { from: '6.4.2', to: '6.8.2' } }]} />}
  source="aurora 发行说明 §2"
/>

name: 前后对比表
role: 对比 · 旧 → 新
summary: 逐行对比“之前 / 之后”，新状态所在列浮在一块白色面板上，视线先落在变化后的结果。
summaryEn: Row by row before / after; the column with the new state floats on a white panel, so the eye lands on the result first.
useWhen: 版本升级、政策调整、改版前后
每行都是同一维度的旧值与新值
useWhenEn: Version upgrades, policy changes, before and after a redesign
Every row is the old and new value of one dimension
avoidWhen: 只有 1–2 处变化：写进 NumberedColumns
需要三方以上比较：拆页或自定义
单元格需要换行解释
avoidWhenEn: Only 1–2 changes: put them in NumberedColumns
Three or more sides to compare: split the slide or build it custom
A cell needs a line break to explain
limits: rows 4–7 行；少于 4 行时下方会空
每个单元格必须一行放下：item ≤ 12 字，值 ≤ 22 字
命令、文件名设 mono: true
limitsEn: rows 4–7; fewer than 4 leaves the bottom empty
Every cell must fit on one line: item ≤ 12 chars, value ≤ 22 chars
Set mono: true for commands and file names

props.name: columns
props.noteEn: Column names for the two columns

props.name: source
props.note: 显示在标题右侧（表格占满高度）
props.noteEn: Shown right of the title (table fills the height)

example:
<CompareTable
  kicker="行为变化"
  title="升级之后，这些默认行为变了"
  columns={['Lumen 12 · birch', 'Lumen 13 · aurora']}
  rows={[
    { item: '仓库配置', before: 'sources.list 单行格式', after: 'lumen.sources（deb822）', mono: true },
    { item: '/tmp', before: '磁盘上的普通目录', after: 'tmpfs，最多占用 50% 内存' },
  ]}
  source="aurora 发行说明 §2 · §5"
/>

name: 编号要点
role: 要点 · 并列特性
summary: 3–4 列等权要点，每列一个等宽标签、标题和说明，列底是巨大的衬线编号，悬停时编号点亮。
summaryEn: 3–4 points of equal weight, each column with a monospace tag, title and body; a huge serif number sits at the column foot and lights up on hover.
useWhen: 3–4 个同等重要的特性、原则或发现
每个要点都能用一个关键词标签概括
useWhenEn: 3–4 equally important features, principles or findings
Each point fits under one keyword tag
avoidWhen: 要点有先后顺序：用 StepTrack
要点有轻重之分：用 SpotlightList 或 Bento
超过 4 个：拆页
avoidWhenEn: The points have an order: use StepTrack
The points differ in weight: use SpotlightList or Bento
More than 4: split the slide
limits: items 正好 3 或 4 个
body 24–40 字：太短列会显得空，太长会压到底部的大编号
长的英文标识符（组件名、包名）放进 tag，不要堆在 body 里，它们不能在中间断行
各列 body 长度尽量接近
limitsEn: body 24–40 chars: shorter leaves the column empty, longer pushes into the big number at the foot
Put long English identifiers (component names, package names) in tag, not in body; they cannot break mid-word
Keep body lengths close across columns
interaction: 悬停整列：编号变为强调色并上浮，标签换成强调底色。
interactionEn: Hover a whole column: the number turns accent and lifts, and the tag takes the accent background.

name: 分组建议
role: 建议 · 适用 / 观望 / 不适用
summary: 把场景归入 2–3 个结论桶：强调色“推荐”、墨色“有条件”、空心“暂不”。顶部色条直接表达态度。
summaryEn: Sorts cases into 2–3 verdict buckets: accent for recommended, ink for conditional, outline for not yet. A colour bar at the top states the stance.
useWhen: “谁该用 / 谁该等 / 谁不该”这类决策建议
选型结论、风险分级
useWhenEn: Advice of the form who should use it, who should wait and who should not
Selection verdicts, risk grades
avoidWhen: 没有明确的结论倾向
每组超过 3 项：精简或拆页
avoidWhenEn: There is no clear direction in the verdict
More than 3 items per group: trim or split the slide
limits: groups 2–3 组，按“是 → 否”排序
每组 2–3 项，各组项数相差不超过 1；只有 1 项的组会显得空
limitsEn: groups 2–3, ordered from yes to no
2–3 items per group, counts within 1 of each other; a group with 1 item looks empty

props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

<VerdictColumns
  kicker="升级建议"
  title="该不该现在升级？"
  groups={[
    { tone: 'go', label: '优先升级', items: [{ title: 'RISC-V 设备', body: '首个正式支持 riscv64 的稳定版。' }] },
    { tone: 'plan', label: '验证后升级', items: [{ title: '生产服务器', body: 'LTS 维护到 2028-06-30。' }] },
    { tone: 'stop', label: '暂不升级', items: [{ title: 'i386 机器', body: '发行说明建议不要升级。' }] },
  ]}
/>

name: 可勾选清单
role: 操作 · 准备工作
summary: 两列可点击的检查项，每项含标题、一条命令和原因。右上角的大计数随勾选实时变化，适合现场带读。
summaryEn: Two columns of clickable checks, each with a title, one command and a reason. A large counter in the top right updates live with each tick, good for reading through live.
useWhen: 上线前检查、升级前准备、验收标准
每项都能给出一条具体命令或动作
useWhenEn: Pre-launch checks, pre-upgrade preparation, acceptance criteria
Each item has one concrete command or action
avoidWhen: 项之间有严格顺序：用 StepTrack
只是罗列特性：用 NumberedColumns
avoidWhenEn: Items have a strict order: use StepTrack
You are only listing features: use NumberedColumns
limits: items 6 或 8 项（两列等高）；4 项时页面下半会空
cmd ≤ 56 个字符；每项都尽量给出 cmd，没有 cmd 的项会比相邻项矮
limitsEn: items 6 or 8 (two equal columns); with 4 the lower half is empty
cmd ≤ 56 characters; give a cmd for every item where possible, an item without one is shorter than its neighbour
interaction: 点击条目勾选，对勾以描边动画画出；勾选不会触发翻页（Space 在按钮上被保留）。
interactionEn: Click an item to tick it; the tick is drawn with a stroke animation. Ticking never changes slides (Space stays with the button).

props.name: countLabel
props.note: 计数后的文字，默认“已确认”

props.name: hint
props.note: 默认“点击条目可以逐项勾选”
props.noteEn: Defaults to "Click an item to tick it off"

example:
<Checklist
  kicker="升级前"
  title="先回到“纯净”的 Lumen 12"
  items={[
    { title: '备份关键数据', cmd: "dpkg --get-selections '*' > ~/curr-pkgs.txt", note: '另存 /etc 与 /var/lib/dpkg' },
    { title: '检查软件包状态', cmd: 'dpkg --audit && apt-mark showhold', note: '解除会阻塞核心包的 hold' },
  ]}
  source="aurora 发行说明 §4.1 – §4.4"
/>

name: 步骤轨道
role: 操作 · 有序流程
summary: 3–5 个节点串在一条轨道上，最后一步为强调色终点。每步可附一条命令（深色）或配置行（浅色），下方可接“之后”命令条。
summaryEn: 3–5 nodes on one track, the last step as the accent end point. Each step can carry one command (dark) or config line (light), with an optional bar of after commands below.
useWhen: 必须按顺序执行的流程：升级、部署、入职
每步都有明确的动作
useWhenEn: A flow that must run in order: upgrade, deploy, onboarding
Every step has one clear action
avoidWhen: 步骤无先后：用 NumberedColumns
超过 5 步：合并步骤或拆页
avoidWhenEn: Steps have no order: use NumberedColumns
More than 5 steps: merge steps or split the slide
limitsEn: title ≤ 8 chars; body ≤ 40 chars (within two lines)
interaction: 轨道从左向右画出，节点依次出现，轨道止于最后一个节点。
interactionEn: The track draws left to right, nodes appear in order and the track ends at the last node.

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: steps
props.note: config: true 时 cmd 显示为浅色配置行，没有 # 提示符
props.noteEn: with config: true the cmd shows as a light config line without the # prompt

props.name: after
props.noteEn: Bar of closing commands after the flow

example:
<StepTrack
  kicker="升级步骤"
  title="四步完成升级"
  steps={[
    { title: '改写软件源', body: '把 birch 改为 aurora。', cmd: 'Suites: aurora aurora-updates', config: true },
    { title: '刷新索引', body: '确认没有旧源。', cmd: 'apt update' },
    { title: '完整升级', body: '完成后重启。', cmd: 'apt full-upgrade' },
  ]}
  after={{ label: '重启之后', cmds: ['apt autoremove'] }}
/>

name: 下一站
role: 预告 · 展望
summary: 左侧一个只有描边的巨大数字与衬线代号，右侧标题、导语与 2–4 条前瞻笔记。语气比封面更安静。
summaryEn: A huge outlined numeral and a serif codename on the left; title, lead and 2–4 forward-looking notes on the right. Quieter than the cover.
useWhen: “接下来会发生什么”：下一版本、下一季度、路线图要点
章节过渡页
useWhenEn: What happens next: next release, next quarter, roadmap points
A chapter transition slide
avoidWhen: 要传达确定的结论：用 Closing
没有可以引用的前瞻信息：不要编造
avoidWhenEn: A firm conclusion must land: use Closing
There is no forward-looking information to cite: do not invent it
limits: notes 2–4 条：key ≤ 16 个字符，text ≤ 34 字
interaction: 描边数字随鼠标漂移，逐位升起。
interactionEn: The outlined numeral drifts with the mouse and rises digit by digit.

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: word
props.note: 衬线斜体词，自动加引号

example:
<Teaser
  kicker="下一站"
  title="Lumen 14 cedar"
  numeral="14"
  word="cedar"
  notes={[
    { key: 'armel', text: 'aurora 是最后一个支持 armel 的版本。' },
    { key: 'KDE Frameworks 5', text: '将在 cedar 周期中移除。' },
  ]}
/>

name: 结论
role: 收尾 · 最后一页
summary: 一句大字结论加一句灰色行动号召，下方三条编号要点与参考资料。左上角的小数字呼应封面。
summaryEn: One large statement plus one grey call to action, with three numbered takeaways and references below. A small number in the top left echoes the cover.
useWhen: 整份演示的最后一页
useWhenEn: The last slide of a deck
avoidWhen: 结论超过一句：先把它写短
没有参考资料时不要伪造链接，省略 refs
avoidWhenEn: The conclusion runs past one sentence: shorten it first
With no references, do not fake links; omit refs
limits: takeaways 正好 3 条，每条 20–46 字；最后一行只剩一两个字时改写句子
refs 2–5 条，不带协议头；refs 就是这一页的出处，没有单独的 source
limitsEn: takeaways exactly 3, each 20–46 chars; rewrite a sentence when its last line holds only a word or two
refs 2–5 without a protocol prefix; refs are this slide's source, there is no separate source

props.name: mark
props.note: 呼应封面的小数字，只写 1–4 位数字，写成文字会整页空白
props.noteEn: Small number echoing the cover; 1–4 digits only, text blanks the whole slide

props.name: follow
props.noteEn: Grey second line: call to action

example:
<Closing
  kicker="结论"
  mark="13"
  statement="aurora 是当前的稳定版。"
  follow="birch 已转入 LTS，现在开始规划升级。"
  takeaways={['新装系统直接选 aurora。', '老机器按「检查 → 改源 → 两步升级」推进。', '留意 /tmp 与 deb822 源。']}
  refs={['example.org/releases/aurora/release-notes', 'wiki.example.org/LTS']}
/>

name: 终端会话
role: 操作 · 要敲的几条命令
summary: 左侧一个深色终端窗口，命令依次打出，每条带编号；右侧按编号解释每条命令说明了什么。
summaryEn: A dark terminal window on the left where commands are typed in sequence, each numbered; the right side explains by number what each command shows.
useWhen: 3–4 条互相独立、但都要在终端里敲的命令
想让听众看到“到底敲什么”，并知道每条为什么要敲
useWhenEn: 3–4 independent commands that all have to be typed in a terminal
The audience should see exactly what to type and why each command is there
avoidWhen: 命令有先后依赖、构成一个流程：用 StepTrack
需要逐项勾选确认：用 Checklist
没有真实命令：不要编造输出
avoidWhenEn: The commands depend on each other and form a flow: use StepTrack
Items must be ticked off: use Checklist
There is no real command: do not invent output
limits: steps 3–4 条；cmd ≤ 44 个字符，只写 ASCII（中文会让打字动画错位）
out 0–3 行，每行 ≤ 48 个字符；只写文档里出现过的输出或注释（# 开头），不要编造
limitsEn: steps 3–4; cmd ≤ 44 characters, ASCII only (non-ASCII breaks the typing animation)
out 0–3 lines, ≤ 48 characters per line; only output or comments (# prefix) that appear in the docs, never invented
interaction: 命令按顺序逐字打出，输出随后淡入，最后一行光标闪烁。悬停右侧注释时编号变为强调色。
interactionEn: Commands type out character by character in order, output fades in after each, and the cursor blinks on the last line. Hovering a note on the right turns its number accent.

name: 配置对照
role: 变化 · 同一份配置的前后写法
roleEn: Change · same config, old and new form
summary: 左右两个代码窗格：左边旧写法（改动行划掉），右边新写法（改动行铺强调色），底部 2–3 条说明。
summaryEn: Two code panes: the old form on the left with changed lines struck through, the new form on the right with changed lines in accent; 2–3 notes at the bottom.
useWhen: 配置文件、代码片段从旧格式换成新格式
两段写法等价，想让听众逐行对照
useWhenEn: A config file or snippet moves from an old format to a new one
The two forms are equivalent and the audience should compare them line by line
avoidWhen: 只是几项设置的值变了：用 CompareTable
代码超过 8 行：截取关键部分，或拆成两页
avoidWhenEn: Only a few setting values changed: use CompareTable
More than 8 lines of code: cut to the key part or split across two slides
limits: before / after 各 2–8 行，每行 ≤ 52 个字符
label ≤ 12 字；file 写完整路径
mark 是从 0 开始的行号
notes 2–3 条：key ≤ 12 个字符（等宽），text ≤ 30 字
limitsEn: before / after 2–8 lines each, ≤ 52 characters per line
label ≤ 12 chars; file takes the full path
mark is a zero-based line number
interaction: 两个窗格依次滑入，代码逐行淡入。
interactionEn: The two panes slide in one after the other and code fades in line by line.

name: 状态网格
role: 现状 · 一组对象各自的状态
roleEn: Status · state of each object in a set
summary: 6–10 张小卡片，每张一个名字和一个状态标签（支持 / 新增 / 部分 / 不支持，名称可改），顶部图例统计每种状态的数量。
summaryEn: 6–10 small cards, each with a name and a status label (supported / new / partial / unsupported, renameable); a legend at the top counts each status.
useWhen: 架构、平台、职能、模块等一组对象的支持或就绪状态
想让听众一眼数出“几个好、几个有问题”
useWhenEn: Support or readiness of a set of objects: architectures, platforms, functions, modules
The audience should see at a glance how many are fine and how many are not
avoidWhen: 每个对象要比较多个维度：用 Matrix
状态只有两种且对象少于 4 个：用 VerdictColumns
avoidWhenEn: Each object must be compared on several dimensions: use Matrix
Only two states and fewer than 4 objects: use VerdictColumns
limits: tiles 6–10 张；6 张 3 列，7–8 张 4 列，9–10 张 5 列
name ≤ 10 个字符（等宽显示）；sub ≤ 12 字
note ≤ 24 字，只给“部分”“不支持”写原因
limitsEn: note ≤ 24 chars, only for partial or unsupported
interaction: 卡片依次淡入；悬停时抬起。
interactionEn: Cards fade in one by one and lift on hover.

name: 版本对照表
role: 变化 · 一批组件的新旧版本
roleEn: Change · old and new versions of a set of components
summary: 2–3 列分组表格，每行一个组件的旧版本 → 新版本；主版本号变化的行用强调色和圆点标出。
summaryEn: A grouped table of 2–3 columns, one component per row from old to new version; rows with a major version change are marked with accent colour and a dot.
useWhen: 发行版、依赖、平台升级时的一批版本号
想让听众快速找出“哪些是大版本跳跃”
useWhenEn: A batch of version numbers in a distro, dependency or platform upgrade
The audience should spot which ones are major jumps
avoidWhen: 只有 3 个以下组件：用 KeyValue 或 CompareTable
值不是版本号而是行为描述：用 CompareTable
avoidWhenEn: Fewer than 3 components: use KeyValue or CompareTable
Values are behaviour descriptions, not versions: use CompareTable
limits: groups 2–3 组，每组 3–6 行，各组行数相差不超过 1
name ≤ 12 个字符；from / to ≤ 10 个字符
major 只标主版本号变化，不要全标
limitsEn: groups 2–3, 3–6 rows each, row counts within 1 of each other
major marks a major version change only, never every row
interaction: 各组依次淡入；悬停一组时图标点亮。
interactionEn: Groups fade in one by one; hovering a group lights its icon.

name: 循环图
role: 机制 · 首尾相接的阶段
summary: 左侧一个环，3–6 个阶段按顺时针排在环上，一个强调色小点沿环转动；中心写一个数字或词；右侧逐项解释。
summaryEn: A ring on the left with 3–6 stages clockwise around it and a small accent dot travelling the ring; one number or word in the centre; each stage explained on the right.
useWhen: 阶段会循环往复：开发周期、增长飞轮、复盘闭环
想强调“最后一步会喂回第一步”
useWhenEn: Stages repeat: development cycle, growth flywheel, review loop
The last step feeding back into the first is the point
avoidWhen: 阶段只走一遍、不回到起点：用 FlowDiagram 或 StepTrack
阶段超过 6 个：合并相近阶段
avoidWhenEn: Stages run once and do not return to the start: use FlowDiagram or StepTrack
More than 6 stages: merge similar ones
limits: nodes 3–6 个，从顶部开始顺时针
title ≤ 8 个字符（显示在环旁）；body ≤ 36 字；tag ≤ 14 个字符
limitsEn: title ≤ 8 characters (shown beside the ring); body ≤ 36 chars; tag ≤ 14 characters
interaction: 阶段依次弹出，强调色小点沿环持续转动；悬停阶段时图标格轻转。
interactionEn: Stages pop in one by one and the accent dot keeps circling; hovering a stage turns its icon tile slightly.

name: 常见问题
role: 答疑 · 听众最常问的问题
roleEn: Questions · questions the audience asks most
summary: 两列问答，每题左侧一个衬线体编号 Q1–Q6，问题加粗，下面一到两句回答，可附一个等宽标签。
summaryEn: Two columns of questions and answers, each with a serif number Q1–Q6 on the left, the question in bold, one or two sentences of answer below and an optional monospace tag.
useWhen: 升级、上线、采购前常被问到的 4–6 个问题
每个问题都能用一两句话回答
useWhenEn: The 4–6 questions that come up before an upgrade, a launch or a purchase
Every question can be answered in one or two sentences
avoidWhen: 回答需要一整页解释：单独成页
其实是在核查说法真假：用 ClaimCards
avoidWhenEn: An answer needs a whole slide: give it its own slide
You are really checking whether a claim is true: use ClaimCards
limits: tag ≤ 24 个字符：命令、章节号或参数
limitsEn: tag ≤ 24 characters: a command, section number or parameter
interaction: 问答依次淡入；悬停时编号变为强调色并上移。
interactionEn: Q&A pairs fade in one by one; hovering turns the number accent and moves it up.

name: 泳道看板
role: 规划 · 现在 / 下一步 / 之后
summary: 3–4 列泳道，每列一个时间范围，下面 2–4 张卡片；指定一列铺强调色浅底，表示“现在就该做”的那一列。
summaryEn: 3–4 lanes, each with a time range and 2–4 cards below; one lane takes a pale accent background to mark what to do now.
useWhen: 路线图：现在、下一步、之后
按状态归类：已移除、将移除、已弃用
useWhenEn: Roadmap: now, next, later
Grouping by status: removed, to be removed, deprecated
avoidWhen: 有明确日期和周期：用 Gantt
项目之间有先后依赖：用 FlowDiagram
avoidWhenEn: There are exact dates and durations: use Gantt
Projects depend on each other: use FlowDiagram
limits: 每列 2–4 张卡，列与列相差不超过 1 张
card.title ≤ 14 字；body ≤ 28 字；tag ≤ 12 个字符
limitsEn: 2–4 cards per lane, counts within 1 of each other
card.title ≤ 14 chars; body ≤ 28 chars; tag ≤ 12 characters
interaction: 泳道依次出现，卡片逐张落下；悬停卡片时抬起。
interactionEn: Lanes appear in order and cards drop in one by one; hovering a card lifts it.

props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

name: 折线图
role: 趋势 · 随时间的变化
summary: 1–3 条折线，一条焦点线用强调色并带面积底色和数值标签，最后一个点放大；1–2 条注释挂在线下方，用虚线连到数据点；右栏可写解读。
summaryEn: 1–3 lines; one focus line in accent with an area fill and value labels and its last point enlarged; 1–2 annotations hang below the line and connect to data points with a dashed line; the right column can carry interpretation.
useWhen: 4–12 个时间点的变化：版本、年份、季度、月份
要指出某个时间点发生了什么
useWhenEn: Change across 4–12 points in time: releases, years, quarters, months
A point in time needs a callout
avoidWhen: 只有 2–3 个点：用 MetricBars 或 DeltaBars
比较的是同一时刻的不同对象：用 MetricBars
各期之间是加减关系：用 Waterfall
avoidWhenEn: Only 2–3 points: use MetricBars or DeltaBars
Different objects at one moment are compared: use MetricBars
Periods add and subtract into each other: use Waterfall
limits: x 4–12 个标签，每个 ≤ 6 个字符
series 1–3 条，且只有一条 focus；近似值用 labels 照原文写，如 43,000+
annotations ≤ 2 条，text ≤ 16 字，不要放在最后一个点上
yFrom 默认 0；抬高坐标起点要在 lead 里说明
limitsEn: series 1–3 with only one focus; write approximate values in labels as in the original, e.g. 43,000+
annotations ≤ 2, text ≤ 16 chars, never on the last point
yFrom defaults to 0; say so in the lead when the axis start is raised
interaction: 折线从左向右展开，数据点依次弹出，注释最后淡入。
interactionEn: The line draws from left to right, data points pop in one by one and the annotations fade in last.

name: 目录
role: 导航 · 封面之后
summary: 左侧标题与导语，右侧 3–6 行章节目录：编号、图标、章节名、一句说明和起始页码。每行都是跳转按钮。
summaryEn: Title and lead on the left; 3–6 chapter rows on the right with number, icon, chapter name, one line of description and the opening page. Every row is a jump button.
useWhen: 15 页以上、分成几章的演示
想让听众先看到全貌，或者演讲中途要跳回某一章
useWhenEn: A deck of more than 15 slides with several chapters
The audience should see the shape first, or you need to jump back to a chapter mid-talk
avoidWhen: 10 页以下的短演示：目录本身就占了一成篇幅
章节只有 2 个：直接在封面导语里说
avoidWhenEn: A short deck under 10 slides: the contents alone takes a tenth of it
Only 2 chapters: say so in the cover lead
limits: items 3–6 项，顺序与演示一致
title ≤ 10 字；body 一行，≤ 26 字
page 是章节第一页的页码（从 1 开始），改动页序后记得同步
meta ≤ 20 个字符，例如“27 页 · 4 章”
没有 source 字段：目录不陈述事实
limitsEn: title ≤ 10 chars; body one line, ≤ 26 chars
page is the number of the chapter's first slide (from 1); update it after reordering
No source field: the contents states no facts
interaction: 悬停一行：背景变亮，图标格换成强调底色并轻微旋转，箭头右移；点击跳到该章第一页。
interactionEn: Hover a row: the background brightens, the icon tile takes the accent background and turns slightly, the arrow moves right; click to jump to that chapter's first slide.

props.name: items
props.noteEn: icon comes from the icon index

props.name: meta

props.noteEn: Defaults to "Click any section to jump to it"

name: 章节页
role: 分隔 · 每章第一页
roleEn: Section break · first slide of each chapter
summary: 大号章节名与一句导语，底部列出本章各页；右侧是双层托盘里的强调色大图标和衬线章节号。图标随鼠标轻微漂移。
summaryEn: A large chapter name and one line of lead, with the chapter's slides listed below; on the right a large accent icon on a double tray and a serif chapter number. The icon drifts slightly with the mouse.
useWhen: 配合 Agenda，每章开头放一页
演讲需要停顿、换话题的地方
useWhenEn: Pairs with Agenda; one at the start of each chapter
Where the talk needs a pause or a change of subject
avoidWhen: 没有 Agenda 的短演示
连续两页都是章节页
一章只有一页内容：不必单独分隔
avoidWhenEn: A short deck without an Agenda
Two section breaks in a row
A chapter with one slide of content: no separate break needed
limits: title 1–2 行，每行 ≤ 6 字（字号 128u）
contents 2–4 项，每项 ≤ 12 字，写本章各页的标题
icon 选一个能代表整章的图标，自动用强调色
limitsEn: title 1–2 lines, ≤ 6 chars per line (128u size)
contents 2–4 items, ≤ 12 chars each, the titles of the chapter's slides
Pick an icon that stands for the whole chapter; it takes the accent colour
interaction: 同心圆依次展开，章节号逐位升起；图标随鼠标漂移。
interactionEn: Concentric circles unfold in order and the chapter number rises digit by digit; the icon drifts with the mouse.

props.name: lead
props.note: 一句话说明本章讲什么
props.noteEn: One sentence on what this chapter covers

example:
<SectionBreak
  kicker="第二章"
  index={2}
  icon="routing"
  title={['让 AI', '读得到你']}
  lead="内容再好，爬虫进不来、读不到正文，也不会出现在回答里。"

/>

name: 定义与引语
role: 概念 · 定义一个词 / 引用一句话
roleEn: Concept · define a term / quote a line
summary: 一句定义或引语以 76u 大字居中排版，关键词用强调色底纹逐个划出；下方三条带图标的注释补充出处、立场或限制。
summaryEn: A definition or quotation set centred at 76u, with keywords highlighted in accent one by one; three notes with icons below add the source, the stance or a caveat.
useWhen: 给全场统一一个术语的定义
引用一句有分量的原话作为论点
useWhenEn: One definition of a term for the whole deck
A weighty original line carries the argument
avoidWhen: 句子超过 64 字：改用 NumberedColumns 拆开讲
没有可靠出处的“名言”
avoidWhenEn: The sentence runs past 64 chars: take it apart in NumberedColumns
A quotation without a reliable source
limits: quote ≤ 64 字；需要换行时传数组，最多 3 行 × 22 字
marks 1–3 个，必须是 quote 里原样出现的子串
cite ≤ 30 个字符，写原文出处
notes 正好 3 条：label ≤ 8 字，text ≤ 36 字
引语要逐字照抄原文，不要改写后加引号
limitsEn: quote ≤ 64 chars; pass an array for line breaks, at most 3 lines × 22 chars
marks 1–3, each an exact substring of quote
notes exactly 3: label ≤ 8 chars, text ≤ 36 chars
Quote the original word for word; do not paraphrase and add quotation marks
interaction: 关键词底纹依次从左向右划出；悬停注释时图标副色变为强调色。
interactionEn: Keyword highlights sweep in from the left one by one; hovering a note turns its icon secondary colour to accent.

props.name: cite
props.note: 原文出处，前面自动加破折号
props.noteEn: Original source; a dash is added before it

example:
<QuoteHero
  kicker="定义"
  quote={['GEO 指提高内容在 AI 生成回答中', '被呈现和引用的频率与准确性。']}
  marks={['频率', '准确性']}
  cite="示例知识库 · 基础概念 / 生成式引擎优化"
  notes={[
    { icon: 'academic', label: '术语出处', text: '一篇 2023 年的论文。' },
    { icon: 'search', label: 'Seekr 的立场', text: '针对其生成式 AI 功能做优化，仍然属于 SEO。' },
    { icon: 'shield-warning', label: '研究的提醒', text: '多数优化方法基本无效。' },
  ]}
  source="示例知识库 · 基础概念 / GEO"
/>

name: 流程机制
role: 机制 · 讲清“它是怎么运转的”
summary: 3–5 个带图标的环节从左到右排开，虚线箭头持续流动；可以把一个环节标为焦点，并在底部加一条“输入”色带。
summaryEn: 3–5 icon nodes run left to right with dashed arrows that keep flowing; one node can be marked as the focus and an input band can sit at the bottom.
useWhen: 解释一个系统或机制：数据怎么流、请求怎么处理
一个过程里有一步是听众能影响的，用 focus 和 band 指出来
useWhenEn: Explaining a system or mechanism: how data flows, how a request is handled
One step is within the audience's reach; point at it with focus and band
avoidWhen: 听众要照着操作的步骤：用 StepTrack
有分支或循环的流程：拆成两页或画专门的图
avoidWhenEn: The audience will follow the steps: use StepTrack
The flow branches or loops: split across two slides or draw a dedicated figure
limits: parts 每个环节最多 3 个，每个 ≤ 12 字
focus 最多标 1 个环节
band.items 3–4 项：title ≤ 6 字，body ≤ 14 字；label ≤ 10 字
示意图要在 lead 或 source 里写明“简化示意”
limitsEn: parts at most 3 per node, ≤ 12 chars each
band.items 3–4: title ≤ 6 chars, body ≤ 14 chars; label ≤ 10 chars
Say it is a simplified diagram in the lead or the source
interaction: 箭头先生长再持续流动；焦点环节使用强调色光环。
interactionEn: Arrows grow first and then keep flowing; the focus node gets an accent halo.

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

name: 说法核查
role: 辟谣 · 逐条给结论
roleEn: Claim check · a verdict per claim
summary: 4 或 6 张卡片，每张是一条流行说法、一个结论印章和一句依据。被判为“错误”的说法会在印章落下后被划掉。
summaryEn: 4 or 6 cards, each with a common claim, a verdict stamp and one line of evidence. A claim judged false is struck through after the stamp lands.
useWhen: 澄清行业里流传的误解
对一组主张逐条给出证据等级
useWhenEn: Clearing up a misunderstanding that circulates in the field
Giving each claim in a set a level of evidence
avoidWhen: 只有一两条：写进别的页面的 lead
结论没有出处：这一页的全部价值在于依据
avoidWhenEn: Only one or two: put them in another slide's lead
A verdict has no source: the whole value of this slide is the evidence
limits: claims 正好 4 或 6 条（2 × 2 或 3 × 2）
claim ≤ 22 字，按人们通常的说法写，模板自动加引号
verdict 五选一：false 错误、unsupported 缺乏依据、disputed 存在争议、partial 部分有依据、supported 有依据
note ≤ 36 字，写最关键的一条证据
tag ≤ 16 个字符，用英文主题词
limitsEn: claim ≤ 22 chars, written the way people say it; the template adds quotation marks
verdict one of five: false (wrong), unsupported (no evidence), disputed (contested), partial (partly backed), supported (backed)
note ≤ 36 chars, the single most important piece of evidence
tag ≤ 16 characters, an English topic word
interaction: 印章依次盖下；错误说法随后被一条强调色横线划掉。悬停卡片会抬起。
interactionEn: Stamps land one by one; a false claim is then struck through with an accent line. Hovering a card lifts it.

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source

props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: claims

props.noteEn: verdict sets the stamp colour and icon

name: 分层检查
role: 排查 · 从外到内逐层确认
roleEn: Troubleshooting · confirm layer by layer from outside in
summary: 4–6 层阶梯式叠放，每层有编号、图标、层名和要检查的事项，最底下是强调色的“结果”层。悬停一层时其余层变淡。
summaryEn: 4–6 layers stacked like steps; each layer has a number, icon, layer name and the item to check, and the bottom layer is the accent-coloured “outcome” layer. Hovering one layer fades the others.
useWhen: 任何一层出问题都会挡住后面的链路：网络、权限、发布流程
排查清单需要按顺序从上往下查
useWhenEn: Any layer that fails blocks the rest of the chain: network, permissions, release pipeline
The troubleshooting checklist has to be worked from the top down
avoidWhen: 各项之间没有先后或依赖：用 Checklist
每层需要命令行示例：用 Checklist 的 cmd
avoidWhenEn: The items have no order or dependency: use Checklist
Each layer needs a command-line example: use the cmd of Checklist
limits: layers 4–6 层，最外层在最上面
name ≤ 12 字；check 一行到两行，≤ 30 字
limitsEn: layers 4–6, the outermost layer on top
name ≤ 12 chars; check one or two lines, ≤ 30 chars
interaction: 悬停一层：该层变白、右移，其余层降到 45% 透明度。
interactionEn: Hover a layer: it turns white and shifts right, the others drop to 45% opacity.

name: 矩阵对照
role: 对照 · 行 × 列的标识
roleEn: Side-by-side · marks in a row × column grid
summary: 行是对象，列是类别，单元格放等宽标识或“—”。可以给一列铺上强调色底，作为这一页的重点。
summaryEn: Rows are objects, columns are categories, and cells hold a monospace mark or “—”. One column can take an accent background as the focus of the slide.
useWhen: “谁在哪一类里叫什么”：厂商 × 用途、平台 × 接口、版本 × 功能
格子里是短标识而不是句子
useWhenEn: “Which name sits in which category”: vendor × use, platform × interface, version × feature
Cells hold short marks rather than sentences
avoidWhen: 格子里要写句子：用 CompareTable 或拆页
只有新旧两列：用 CompareTable
avoidWhenEn: Cells need sentences: use CompareTable or split the slide
Only an old and a new column: use CompareTable
limits: rows 3–6 行：label ≤ 10 字，sub ≤ 16 个字符
单元格 ≤ 18 个字符，没有就写 null
focus 最多 1 列；footnote ≤ 60 字
标题写成一行时整页更从容；两行标题时最多 5 行数据
limitsEn: Cells ≤ 18 characters; write null when empty
focus at most 1 column; footnote ≤ 60 chars
A one-line title leaves the slide more room; with a two-line title keep at most 5 data rows
interaction: 悬停一行时整行变暗底；悬停单元格时标识反白。
interactionEn: Hover a row: the whole row takes a dark background; hover a cell: the mark turns white.

name: 图标卡片
role: 并列 · 6–8 个对象
summary: 3 × 2 或 4 × 2 的图标卡片，每张有图标、标题、说明和右上角标签。悬停时卡片抬起、图标点亮。
summaryEn: A 3 × 2 or 4 × 2 grid of icon cards; each card has an icon, title, description and a tag in the top right. On hover the card lifts and the icon lights up.
useWhen: 6 或 8 个并列对象：平台、产品、角色、地区
每个对象一两句话就能说清
useWhenEn: 6 or 8 parallel objects: platforms, products, roles, regions
Each object takes one or two sentences
avoidWhen: 3–4 个对象：用 NumberedColumns，每项能写得更充分
对象之间要比较数值：用 MetricBars 或 Matrix
avoidWhenEn: 3–4 objects: use NumberedColumns, each item gets more room
Objects are compared by a number: use MetricBars or Matrix
limits: items 正好 6 或 8 个
title ≤ 8 字；body 18–40 字，各卡长度尽量接近
tag ≤ 12 个字符；没有就省略，不要编
图标按含义挑，同一页不要重复
limitsEn: title ≤ 8 chars; body 18–40 chars, keep the cards close in length
tag ≤ 12 characters; omit it when there is none, do not invent one
Pick icons by meaning; do not repeat one on the same slide
interaction: 悬停卡片：抬起 6u，阴影加深，图标格换成强调底色。
interactionEn: Hover a card: it lifts 6u, the shadow deepens and the icon tile takes the accent background.

name: 单个大数字
role: 证据 · 一个数字撑起一页
roleEn: Evidence · one number carries the slide
summary: 左侧一个超大数字（逐位升起、随鼠标漂移）和它的定义，右侧是标题、导语和 2–3 个辅助数字。
summaryEn: A very large number on the left (rising digit by digit, drifting with the pointer) with its definition; on the right the title, lead and 2–3 supporting numbers.
useWhen: 需要在一串文字页之间放一个视觉重音
useWhenEn: One number is the argument: 97%, 9.34%, 1/100
A visual accent is needed between a run of text slides
avoidWhen: 几个数字同等重要：用 MetricBars
数字需要和别的数比较才有意义：用 DeltaBars 或 Dumbbell
一份演示里用超过 3 次
avoidWhenEn: Several numbers matter equally: use MetricBars
The number only means something next to others: use DeltaBars or Dumbbell
Used more than 3 times in one deck
limits: figure ≤ 6 个字符（含单位），越短字越大
caption ≤ 30 字，写清这个数字在数什么
support 2–3 项：value ≤ 8 个字符，label ≤ 24 字
title 2 行 × ≤ 8 字（右栏 640u 宽）
limitsEn: figure ≤ 6 characters (unit included); the shorter it is, the larger the type
caption ≤ 30 chars; say what the number counts
support 2–3 items: value ≤ 8 characters, label ≤ 24 chars
interaction: 数字逐位从遮罩中升起，并随鼠标轻微漂移。
interactionEn: Digits rise out of a mask one by one and drift slightly with the pointer.

name: 正负变化
role: 证据 · 涨了还是跌了
summary: 以零线为中心的发散条形图：正值向右、强调色，负值向左、墨色。左栏是论点、可选的大字要点和出处。
summaryEn: Diverging bars around a zero line: positive values to the right in the accent colour, negative to the left in ink. The left column holds the argument, an optional pull figure and the source.
useWhen: 实验或改动前后的变化：引用率、转化率、耗时
同一处理在不同平台上方向不一致
useWhenEn: Change after a test or a change: citation rate, conversion rate, time taken
The same treatment moves in different directions on different platforms
avoidWhen: 数值都是正的总量：用 MetricBars
要同时展示前后两个绝对值：用 Dumbbell
avoidWhenEn: All values are positive totals: use MetricBars
Both the before and the after value need showing: use Dumbbell
limits: rows 2–6 行：label ≤ 10 字，sub ≤ 14 个字符
unit ≤ 4 个字符；scale 是坐标半宽，取比最大绝对值稍大的整数
ends 两端说明各 ≤ 6 字，例如“引用减少 / 引用增加”
变化不显著时要在标题或 lead 里说明，不要让条形图暗示效果
limitsEn: unit ≤ 4 characters; scale is the half-width of the axis, an integer slightly above the largest absolute value
ends each ≤ 6 chars, for example “fewer citations / more citations”
When the change is not significant, say so in the title or lead; do not let the bars imply an effect
interaction: 条形从零线向两侧生长。
interactionEn: Bars grow out from the zero line to both sides.

name: 两点对比
role: 证据 · 同一指标的两种测法
roleEn: Evidence · two ways to measure one metric
summary: 每行两个点（空心墨色 a、实心强调色 b）由渐变线相连，线的长度就是差距；右侧列出差值。
summaryEn: Each row has two points (hollow ink a, solid accent b) joined by a gradient line; the length of the line is the gap, and the difference is listed on the right.
useWhen: 同一指标在两种条件下的值：API 与 App、去年与今年、对照与实验
差距本身是论点
useWhenEn: One metric under two conditions: API and App, last year and this year, control and test
The gap itself is the argument
avoidWhen: 只有一种条件：用 MetricBars
超过 5 行：拆页或只留最有代表性的几行
avoidWhenEn: Only one condition: use MetricBars
More than 5 rows: split the slide or keep only the most telling rows
limits: rows 2–5 行：label ≤ 8 字，sub ≤ 14 个字符
max 默认 100；unit 默认 %，差值自动写成“个百分点”
limitsEn: max defaults to 100; unit defaults to %, and the gap is written as “percentage points”
interaction: 先出现 a 点，连线从 a 生长到 b，b 点随后弹出。
interactionEn: Point a appears first, the line grows from a to b, then point b pops in.

name: 区间估计
role: 方法 · 数字有多可靠
roleEn: Method · how reliable the number is
summary: 每行一个点估计和它的误差区间，区间越窄越可靠；可以高亮推荐的一行，左栏可放一个“这样写结果”的示例块。
summaryEn: Each row has a point estimate and its error range; the narrower the range, the more reliable the number. One row can be highlighted, and the left column can hold an example block of “how to write the result”.
useWhen: 讲抽样误差、置信区间、预测范围
说明“样本量要多大才够”
useWhenEn: Explaining sampling error, confidence intervals, forecast ranges
Showing “how large the sample has to be”
avoidWhen: 数据没有误差范围：用 MetricBars
区间来自你自己的估算却没有标明：在 source 里写清计算方法
avoidWhenEn: The data has no error range: use MetricBars
The range is your own estimate and is not marked as one: write the calculation in source
limits: rows 3–6 行：label ≤ 8 个字符，note ≤ 8 个字符
interaction: 区间从中心向两侧展开。
interactionEn: Ranges expand from the centre to both sides.

name: 计划甘特图
role: 计划 · 按周排开的工作
roleEn: Plan · work laid out by week
summary: 以周、冲刺或天为单位的相对时间轴，上方可加月份分组，每行一条工作流，可高亮交付项。
summaryEn: A relative timeline in weeks, sprints or days, with optional month groups above, one work stream per row and deliverables that can be highlighted.
useWhen: 30–90 天的行动计划、试点排期
多条工作流互相重叠，需要看清先后
useWhenEn: A 30–90 day action plan or a pilot schedule
Several work streams overlap and the order has to be clear
avoidWhen: 有真实日期的长期周期（版本支持、合同期）：用 Timeline
只有先后没有时长：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: A long period with real dates (support window, contract term): use Timeline
Only order, no duration: use StepTrack
limits: rows 3–7 行：label ≤ 12 字；按开始时间排序
条形少于 2 个单位时，条内的“5–9”标签会放不下
limitsEn: rows 3–7: label ≤ 12 chars; sort by start
With a bar shorter than 2 units the “5–9” label inside it does not fit
interaction: 条形依次从左生长；悬停一行时条形上浮。
interactionEn: Bars grow from the left one after another; hovering a row lifts its bar.

name: 事件时间线
role: 背景 · 按日期排列的事件
summary: 一条横轴上的 4–7 个事件，上下交替排布，各自有日期、两行标题和类型标签；可以高亮一个关键事件。
summaryEn: 4–7 events on a horizontal axis, alternating above and below it, each with a date, a two-line title and a type tag; one key event can be highlighted.
useWhen: 政策、标准、发布等一串有日期的事件
想让听众看到“事情是怎么一步步来的”
useWhenEn: A run of dated events: policy, standards, releases
Showing how things got here step by step
avoidWhen: 需要按真实时间比例表现间隔：本模板等距排列，改用 Timeline
事件超过 7 个：只留关键节点
avoidWhenEn: Gaps must follow real time: this template spaces events evenly, use Timeline
More than 7 events: keep only the key ones
limits: events 4–7 个，按日期排序；等距排列，不按时间比例
date ≤ 10 个字符；title ≤ 24 字（两行）
tag ≤ 8 字，写事件的性质（法规、标准、事件）
limitsEn: events 4–7, sorted by date; spaced evenly, not to a time scale
tag ≤ 8 chars; name the kind of event (regulation, standard, event)

name: 引语墙
role: 佐证 · 几句原话
summary: 3 或 5 句逐字引语：第一句放在左侧深色大卡，其余排成网格；每句下面写说话人、出处和一个话题标签。
summaryEn: 3 or 5 verbatim quotes: the first in a large dark card on the left, the rest in a grid; each has the speaker, the source and a topic tag below it.
useWhen: 平台、监管机构、权威文档的原话
客户访谈里的原话（要能追溯到记录）
useWhenEn: Exact wording from platforms, regulators or authoritative documents
Exact wording from customer interviews, traceable to the transcript
avoidWhen: 只有一句话：用 QuoteHero
是你的总结或转述：写进正文，不要加引号
查不到原文：不要用
avoidWhenEn: One quote only: use QuoteHero
It is your summary or paraphrase: put it in body text, without quotation marks
The original cannot be found: do not use it
limits: quotes 3 或 5 句；第一句是大卡
第一句 ≤ 50 字，其余 ≤ 40 字；逐字照录，不加引号
who ≤ 16 个字符；where ≤ 24 个字符；tag ≤ 12 个字符
source 必须写出原文出处
limitsEn: quotes 3 or 5; the first one is the large card
First quote ≤ 50 chars, the rest ≤ 40 chars; copy verbatim, without quotation marks
who ≤ 16 characters; where ≤ 24 characters; tag ≤ 12 characters
source must name where the original text comes from
interaction: 卡片依次出现；悬停小卡时抬起并描出强调色边框。
interactionEn: Cards appear one after another; hovering a small card lifts it and draws an accent border.

name: 前后对比
role: 实证 · 同一画面的两种状态
roleEn: Proof · two states of the same view
summary: 两张同尺寸截图叠在一起，中间一条可拖动的分隔线；两角各一个标签，右栏写解读。入场时分隔线从右侧滑到起始位置。
summaryEn: Two screenshots of the same size stacked together with a draggable divider; one label in each corner and the reading in the right column. On entry the divider slides in from the right to its start position.
useWhen: 改版前后、优化前后
同一页面在两种条件下的样子：开关 JavaScript、桌面与移动、两个版本
useWhenEn: Before and after a redesign or an improvement
The same page under two conditions: JavaScript on and off, desktop and mobile, two versions
avoidWhen: 两张图构图不同：分开放或用 Screenshot
差别要靠文字说明而不是看出来：用 CompareTable
avoidWhenEn: The two images are composed differently: show them apart or use Screenshot
The difference needs words rather than eyes: use CompareTable
limits: 两张图尺寸和构图必须一致，ratio 填真实宽高比
必须是真实截图，source 写明怎么截的
limitsEn: Both images must match in size and composition; set ratio to the real aspect ratio
Must be real screenshots; source says how they were taken
interaction: 拖动或点击画面移动分隔线；手柄获得焦点后 ← → 微调，不会翻页。
interactionEn: Drag or click the frame to move the divider; with the handle focused ← → nudges it and does not change slide.

name: 截图标注
role: 讲解 · 产品界面
summary: 左侧一张带浏览器外框的截图，图上 3–5 个编号圆点；右侧按同样编号列出说明。悬停圆点或说明会同时高亮两边。
summaryEn: A screenshot in a browser frame on the left with 3–5 numbered dots on it; the right column lists the notes under the same numbers. Hovering a dot or a note highlights both sides.
useWhen: 介绍产品界面、网站结构、报表怎么读
要让听众看着真实界面找到具体位置
useWhenEn: Introducing a product interface, a site structure, how to read a report
The audience has to find a place on the real interface
avoidWhen: 没有真实截图：不要用示意图冒充
要比较两种状态：用 BeforeAfter
要点超过 5 个：拆成两页
avoidWhenEn: No real screenshot: do not pass a diagram off as one
Two states need comparing: use BeforeAfter
More than 5 points: split into two slides
limits: callouts 3–5 个；x、y 为百分比，点与点至少相隔 8
图片放在 deck 目录下用 import 引入，WebP 优先，单张 ≤ 200 KB
ratio 填真实宽高比；url 可选，填了才显示浏览器地址栏
limitsEn: callouts 3–5; x and y are percentages, dots at least 8 apart
Keep images in the deck folder and import them; prefer WebP, ≤ 200 KB each
Set ratio to the real aspect ratio; url is optional and shows the browser address bar when set
interaction: 圆点依次弹出并有呼吸光圈；悬停圆点或右侧说明时两边一起高亮。逐条展开时圆点和说明同步出现。
interactionEn: Dots pop in one by one with a breathing ring; hovering a dot or its note highlights both. In build steps the dot and its note appear together.

name: 转化漏斗
role: 诊断 · 逐级转化与最该修的一级
roleEn: Diagnosis · stage-by-stage conversion and the stage to fix first
summary: 居中的逐级变窄横条（等距变窄，不按比例），右侧是人数；相邻两级之间自动算出转化率，指定的一级标成强调色；右栏写为什么先修它。
summaryEn: Centred bars that narrow stage by stage (evenly, not to scale) with counts on the right; the conversion rate between stages is worked out automatically and one chosen stage is marked in accent; the right column says why to fix that one first.
useWhen: 注册、激活、付费这类逐级转化的流程
想说明“先修哪一级”，而不只是展示数字
useWhenEn: A stage-by-stage flow such as sign-up, activation, payment
Saying which stage to fix first, not just showing numbers
avoidWhen: 各阶段不是包含关系（后一级不是前一级的子集）：用 MetricBars
只有两级：直接写一个 BigStat
avoidWhenEn: The stages do not nest (a stage is not a subset of the one before): use MetricBars
Two stages only: use a BigStat
limits: leak 指向要先修的那一步（第 leak 级到下一级）；leakLabel ≤ 6 字
条宽只表示顺序，数据看数字和转化率
limitsEn: stages 4–6, values falling at every step
leak points at the step to fix first (from stage leak to the next); leakLabel ≤ 6 chars
Bar width only shows order; read the numbers and rates for data
interaction: 横条从中间展开，转化率标签依次出现；悬停一级时横条加深。
interactionEn: Bars expand from the centre, rate labels appear one by one; hovering a stage darkens its bar.

name: 定位四象限
role: 定位 · 二维竞争地图
summary: 左侧一个 2 × 2 平面，两条轴各有两端标签，四个象限可命名；3–7 个点，焦点（通常是自己）带脉冲光圈；右侧 2–3 段解读。
summaryEn: A 2 × 2 plane on the left with a label at each end of both axes and four quadrants that can be named; 3–7 points, the focus (usually you) with a pulsing ring; 2–3 notes on the right.
useWhen: 竞品定位、产品组合、优先级（影响 × 投入）
想让听众看到“哪块位置是空的”
useWhenEn: Competitor positioning, product portfolio, priority (impact × effort)
Showing which space is still empty

只有一个维度在比较：用 MetricBars 或 RangeBars
avoidWhenEn: Point coordinates have no basis and are not marked illustrative
Only one dimension is compared: use MetricBars or RangeBars
limits: points 3–7 个，坐标 0–100，相邻点至少相距 8，避免标签重叠
x / y 每端 ≤ 6 字；zones 每个 ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: points 3–7, coordinates 0–100, points at least 8 apart so labels do not overlap
each end of x and y ≤ 6 chars; each zone ≤ 8 chars

interactionEn: Points pop in one after another and the focus keeps pulsing; hovering a point turns its label white.

name: 买家画像
role: 客户 · 采购小组里的三个角色
roleEn: Customer · three roles in the buying group
summary: 三张并排卡片，每张是一个角色：图标、决策身份、用他们的话说出的需求、两个目标、两个痛点和触达渠道。主要买家顶部有强调色线条。

channels 2–3 个，每个 ≤ 8 个字符

name: 分档定价
role: 定价 · 好 / 更好 / 最好
summary: 3–4 张价格卡，推荐档是深色卡片并略微抬高，带角标；每档有价格、适用对象和 3–5 条功能，底部一行说明价值指标。

useWhen: 产品分档与定价方案
想把大多数客户引到某一档
useWhenEn: Product tiers and a pricing plan
Steering most customers to one tier
avoidWhen: 在比较竞品价格：用 Matrix
只有一档：用 BigStat
avoidWhenEn: Comparing competitor prices: use Matrix
Only one tier: use BigStat

name ≤ 6 个字符；price ≤ 6 个字符；unit ≤ 10 个字符
features 3–5 条，每条 ≤ 16 字；后一档第一条写“包含上一档全部功能”

name ≤ 6 characters; price ≤ 6 characters; unit ≤ 10 characters

name: 指标看板
role: 衡量 · 北极星与输入指标
roleEn: Measurement · north star and input metrics
summary: 左侧一张深色大卡放北极星指标（大数字和走势线），右侧 4 或 6 张小卡放输入指标，每张有数值、变化、可选走势线或口径说明。
summaryEn: A large dark card on the left holds the north star metric (big number and trend line); 4 or 6 small cards on the right hold input metrics, each with a value, a change and either a trend line or a note on how it is counted.
useWhen: 周会、月报、复盘的核心指标
想表达“一个结果指标由几个输入指标推动”
useWhenEn: The core metrics of a weekly meeting, monthly report or review
Showing one outcome metric driven by a few input metrics
avoidWhen: 只有 1–3 个数字：用 BigStat 或 MetricBars
要比较多个对象的同一指标：用 MetricBars
avoidWhenEn: Only 1–3 numbers: use BigStat or MetricBars
One metric across several objects: use MetricBars
limits: delta ≤ 6 个字符，good 决定颜色（不写则中性）
trend 6–12 个点；没有走势就写 note（≤ 18 字），两者选一个
limitsEn: delta ≤ 6 characters; good sets the colour (neutral when unset)
trend 6–12 points; with no trend write note (≤ 18 chars), one of the two
interaction: 卡片依次淡入，走势线从左向右擦出；悬停小卡时抬起。
interactionEn: Cards fade in one after another and trend lines wipe from left to right; hovering a small card lifts it.

name: 构成条
role: 分配 · 一个整体怎么切分
roleEn: Allocation · how one whole is split
summary: 每行一根 100% 堆叠横条，2–5 段，段内写百分比；可指定一段在所有行里都变成强调色；顶部是图例。
summaryEn: One 100% stacked bar per row with 2–5 segments and the percentage written inside; one segment can be set to the accent colour in every row; the legend sits on top.
useWhen: 预算、时间、渠道、流量的构成
几行之间比较构成怎么变化
useWhenEn: The make-up of a budget, of time, of channels, of traffic
Comparing how the make-up shifts from row to row
avoidWhen: 各部分加起来不是 100%：用 MetricBars
只有一行：用 BigStat 写最关键的那一段
avoidWhenEn: The parts do not add up to 100%: use MetricBars
One row only: use BigStat for the key segment
limits: rows 3–6 行；每行 values 与 legend 一一对应，加起来是 100
小于 7% 的段不显示数字
limitsEn: rows 3–6; values in each row match legend one to one and add up to 100
label ≤ 10 chars; note ≤ 16 chars; footnote ≤ 50 chars
interaction: 横条从左生长；悬停一段时其他段变淡。
interactionEn: Bars grow from the left; hovering a segment fades the others.

name: 收入桥
role: 拆解 · 从期初到期末
summary: 瀑布图：期初总数、3–6 项增减、自动算出的期末总数；增加为强调色，减少为斜纹，柱子之间有虚线衔接；右栏写解读。
summaryEn: A waterfall: an opening total, 3–6 changes and a closing total worked out automatically; increases in the accent colour, decreases hatched, dashed lines joining the bars; the reading goes in the right column.
useWhen: ARR、利润、预算、人数等从期初到期末的变化拆解
想说明“增长被什么吃掉了”
useWhenEn: Breaking down how ARR, profit, budget or headcount moved from opening to closing
Showing what ate the growth
avoidWhen: 各项之间不是加减关系：用 MetricBars 或 DeltaBars
变化项超过 6 个：合并小项
avoidWhenEn: The items do not add or subtract: use MetricBars or DeltaBars
More than 6 changes: merge the small ones
limits: steps 3–6 项，正数加、负数减；期末自动计算
notes 2–3 条：key ≤ 8 字（可含一个数字），text ≤ 30 字
数值保持在 5 位数以内，用 unit 写万元、千人
limitsEn: steps 3–6, a positive number adds, a negative one subtracts; the closing total is computed
notes 2–3: key ≤ 8 chars (one number allowed), text ≤ 30 chars
Keep values within 5 digits and put the scale in unit, for example ten thousand yuan or thousand people
interaction: 柱子依次升起（减少项从上往下落）。
interactionEn: Bars rise one after another (decreases drop from above).

name: 团队卡片
role: 分工 · 谁负责什么
summary: 4、6 或 8 张卡片，每张一个首字母头像、名字或角色、头衔，以及底部一句“负责什么”。总负责人的头像用强调色。
summaryEn: 4, 6 or 8 cards, each with an initials avatar, a name or role, a title, and one line at the bottom on what that person owns. The lead's avatar is in the accent colour.
useWhen: 项目启动会的团队介绍
上市小组、虚拟团队的角色分工
useWhenEn: Introducing the team at a kick-off
Roles in a launch team or a virtual team
avoidWhen: 要写清每件事谁执行、谁拍板：用 Matrix 做 RACI
只有 2–3 个人：写进正文
avoidWhenEn: Each task needs its owner and its decider spelled out: build a RACI in Matrix
Only 2–3 people: put them in body text
limits: initials 1–3 个字符；不填时取中文首字或英文缩写
没有照片位：真人照片不放进演示
limitsEn: name ≤ 8 chars; role ≤ 14 chars; owns ≤ 36 chars
initials 1–3 characters; when empty, the first character of the name or the English initials are used
No photo slot: real photos do not go into a deck
interaction: 卡片依次出现；悬停时抬起。
interactionEn: Cards appear one after another; hover lifts a card.

name: 议题树
role: 分析 · 把问题拆开
summary: 左侧深色卡写要回答的问题，右侧 2–4 个分支，每个分支后面一排 2–3 个待查原因；焦点分支用强调色浅底。
summaryEn: A dark card on the left holds the question to answer; 2–4 branches on the right, each followed by a row of 2–3 causes to check; the focus branch gets a light accent background.
useWhen: 复盘或诊断：指标为什么变了
咨询式分析的第一页：先把问题拆成互不重叠的几块
useWhenEn: A review or diagnosis: why a metric moved
The first slide of a consulting-style analysis: split the question into parts that do not overlap
avoidWhen: 分支之间有先后顺序：用 FlowDiagram
已经有答案：直接用 BigStat 或 NumberedColumns 给结论
avoidWhenEn: The branches have an order: use FlowDiagram
The answer is known: give it with BigStat or NumberedColumns
limits: branches 2–4 个；每个 leaves 2–3 个
branch.title ≤ 10 字；note ≤ 16 字；leaf ≤ 14 字（4 个分支时 ≤ 10 字）
分支要互不重叠、合起来覆盖整个问题
limitsEn: branch.title ≤ 10 chars; note ≤ 16 chars; leaf ≤ 14 chars (≤ 10 chars with 4 branches)
Branches must not overlap and together must cover the whole question
interaction: 分支依次出现，原因标签随后弹出；悬停分支时卡片变为强调色浅底。
interactionEn: Branches appear one after another, cause tags pop in after them; hovering a branch turns its card to a light accent.

name: 热力表
role: 分布 · 两个维度交叉的数值
roleEn: Distribution · values where two dimensions cross
summary: 行 × 列的数值表，格子按数值深浅着色，深色格子里的数字自动变白；没有数据的格子留虚框；下方一条色阶，右栏写解读。
summaryEn: A row × column table of values; cells are shaded by value and numbers on dark cells turn white automatically; cells with no data keep a dashed frame; a colour scale sits below and the reading in the right column.
useWhen: 分批留存（签约月份 × 第几个月）
渠道 × 漏斗阶段的转化率、功能 × 客户群的使用率
useWhenEn: Cohort retention (signing month × month number)
Conversion by channel × funnel stage, usage by feature × customer group
avoidWhen: 只有一行或一列：用 MetricBars
要看精确比较而非整体规律：用 Matrix
avoidWhenEn: One row or one column: use MetricBars
Exact comparison rather than the overall pattern: use Matrix
limits: cols 3–8 列，每个 ≤ 6 个字符
rows 3–7 行；label ≤ 8 字；sub ≤ 10 个字符
数值 ≤ 4 位（含小数），单位用 unit
limitsEn: Values ≤ 4 digits (decimals included); put the unit in unit
interaction: 格子沿对角线依次弹出；悬停格子时放大，悬停一行时行名变为强调色。
interactionEn: Cells pop in along the diagonal; hovering a cell enlarges it, hovering a row turns its name to the accent colour.

name: 路线图
role: 规划 · 按季度看方向
summary: 2–4 条工作线 × 3–5 个时间段；事项可以跨段，分已完成（灰底带勾）、进行中（强调色，带呼吸点）、计划（虚线框）；一条“今天”竖线标出当前位置。
summaryEn: 2–4 work streams × 3–5 periods; items can span periods and are marked done (grey with a tick), doing (accent, with a breathing dot) or planned (dashed frame); a vertical “today” line marks where you are.
useWhen: 季度或半年粒度的产品、市场、销售路线图
要同时表达方向和进度
useWhenEn: A product, marketing or sales roadmap by quarter or half year
Direction and progress in one view
avoidWhen: 按周排期：用 Gantt
没有时间段，只分现在 / 下一步 / 之后：用 Lanes
avoidWhenEn: Scheduling by week: use Gantt
No periods, only now / next / later: use Lanes
limits: periods 3–5 个，每个 ≤ 8 个字符
items 4–12 个；只占一段时 title ≤ 8 字，跨段时 ≤ 12 字
同一条工作线同一时间段最多两个事项
limitsEn: items 4–12; title ≤ 8 chars within one period, ≤ 12 chars across periods
At most two items per work stream per period
interaction: 事项按工作线依次升起；进行中的事项带呼吸点。
interactionEn: Items rise one after another along each work stream; doing items carry a breathing dot.

props.noteEn: Position of “today” in periods, for example 1.4

  ]}

  source="示意"
