name: 一句话
role: 节奏 · 两段密集内容之间的停顿
roleEn: Rhythm · a pause between two dense passages
summary: 整页只有一句话，112u 居中，关键词用强调色；下面可以加一行很淡的补充。配合 tone: "accent" 可以做成整页强调色。
summaryEn: One sentence alone on the slide, 112u and centred, key words in the accent colour; a faint line of support can go below. With tone: "accent" the whole slide takes the accent colour.
useWhen: 刚讲完一页数据，要把结论单独立住
章节中间需要一个停顿，让听众记住一句话
useWhenEn: A data slide has just finished and the conclusion needs to stand on its own
A pause is needed mid-chapter so one line sticks
avoidWhen: 一句话放不下：改用 QuoteHero 或 BigStat
连续两页都用它：停顿多了就不是停顿
avoidWhenEn: One sentence does not fit: use QuoteHero or BigStat
Two slides in a row: too many pauses stop being a pause
limits: text ≤ 28 字；传数组手动断行，最多 2 行 × 14 字
marks 0–2 个，必须是 text 里原样出现的子串
句子里的数字也要在 source 写出处
limitsEn: text ≤ 28 chars; an array breaks lines by hand, at most 2 lines × 14 chars
marks 0–2, each a substring that appears verbatim in text
Numbers in the sentence need their source in source too
example:
<Statement
  kicker="价格杠杆"
  text={['价格提高 1%，', '利润提高 11.1%']}
  marks={['11.1%']}
  sub="所以定价放在上市之前定，不放在上市之后补。"
  source="Marn & Rosiello · HBR 1992"
/>

name: 悬挂图标封面
role: 开场 · 产品发布第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · slide 1 of a product launch
summary: 居中大标题，彩色图标方块用细线从顶部吊下来，缓慢摆动；标题里一个词用强调色，下面是导语和 1–3 个胶囊。
summaryEn: A large centred title with coloured icon tiles hanging from thin threads at the top, swaying slowly; one word of the title takes the accent colour, with the lead and 1–3 pills below.
useWhen: 产品、平台、工具的发布或介绍
想要轻松、干净、有产品感的开场
useWhenEn: A launch or introduction for a product, platform or tool
A light, clean opening with a product feel
avoidWhen: 严肃的研究或政策汇报：用 Cover
没有合适的图标：图标只是装饰，不要硬凑
avoidWhenEn: A serious research or policy briefing: use Cover
No fitting icons: icons are decoration, do not force them
limits: mark 必须是 title 里原样出现的子串
icons 4–8 个，只用 icon-set 里的名称
pills 1–3 个，写事实（页数、日期），不要假按钮
limitsEn: mark must be a substring that appears verbatim in title
pills 1–3, facts only (page count, date), no fake buttons
example:
<HangingCover
  tag={{ label: '第 1 期', text: '风格引擎与面板模板' }}
  title={['同一份内容，', '换一种气质']}
  mark="气质"
  lead="风格只管外观，内容和上限都不动。"
  icons={['tuning', 'layers', 'chart', 'presentation']}
  pills={['13 页', '2026 年 10 月']}
/>

name: 面板卡片
role: 产品 · 3–4 项能力各配一小块界面
roleEn: Product · 3–4 capabilities, each with a small interface
summary: 浅灰大圆角卡片，上半是小标题，下半是一张白色小界面：列表、大数字、柱图、进度条、换算或标签。
summaryEn: A light grey rounded card: a small heading on top and a white mini interface below, as a list, big number, bars, progress bar, conversion or chips.
useWhen: 介绍产品的 3–4 项能力，每项都有能画出来的数据
把几组小数据并排展示
useWhenEn: Introduce 3–4 product capabilities, each with data you can draw
Show several small data sets side by side
avoidWhen: 只有文字没有数据：用 IconGrid
超过 4 项：拆页
avoidWhenEn: Text only and no data: use IconGrid
More than 4 items: split the slide
limits: list 3–5 行；bars 3–12 根；progress 2–4 行；chips 3–6 个
迷你界面里的数字同样要在 source 写出处
limitsEn: eyebrow ≤ 12 chars, title ≤ 8 chars, body ≤ 24 chars
list 3–5 rows; bars 3–12; progress 2–4 rows; chips 3–6
Numbers in the mini interface also need a source

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: cards
props.note: 卡片；ui.kind = list / figure / bars / progress / convert / chips
props.noteEn: Cards; ui.kind = list / figure / bars / progress / convert / chips

example:
<PanelCards
  kicker="面板卡片"
  title="一张卡，一小块界面"
  cards={[
    { title: '打包体积', ui: { kind: 'figure', value: '5.9 MB', note: '单个 HTML 文件' } },
    { title: '参考演示', ui: { kind: 'bars', values: [25, 31, 30], value: '86 页' } },
    { title: '检查视口', ui: { kind: 'list', rows: [{ label: '1920 × 1080', value: '截图' }] } },
  ]}
  source="npm run check"
/>

name: 问答卡
role: 产品 · 演示一个问题和它的答案
roleEn: Product · Show one question and its answer
summary: 右边是一块面板：问题气泡在右上角，下面一行“找到…”，再下面三张结果卡，每张一个大数字加一组小柱。左边是标题和说明。
summaryEn: A panel on the right: question bubble at the top right, a "found ..." line below it, then three result cards, each with one big number and a row of small bars. Title and notes on the left.
useWhen: 演示搜索、分析、AI 助手能回答什么
把同一个问题在三个对象上的答案并排
useWhenEn: Show what search, analysis or an AI assistant can answer
Put the answer to the same question for three targets side by side
avoidWhen: 答案不是数字：用 QuoteWall 或 ClaimCards
结果多于 3 个：拆页
avoidWhenEn: The answer is not a number: use QuoteWall or ClaimCards
More than 3 results: split the slide
limits: results 正好 3 个：name ≤ 8，value ≤ 6 个字符，bars 4–10 个
limitsEn: results exactly 3: name ≤ 8, value ≤ 6 characters, bars 4–10

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<AskAnswer
  kicker="问答卡"
  title="把一个问题，变成三张卡"
  question="三份参考演示，每一章各有几页？"
  found="找到 3 份演示，共 86 页"
  results={[
    { name: 'Lumen', value: '25 页', bars: [7, 8, 5, 3] },
    { name: 'GEO', value: '31 页', bars: [8, 8, 5, 8] },
    { name: 'GTM', value: '30 页', bars: [5, 6, 6, 11] },
  ]}
/>

name: 证明分栏
role: 论证 · 一个能力加两个证据数字
roleEn: Argument · One capability plus two evidence numbers
summary: 左边是深色面板：一个大图标方块和几行“设置项”；右边是标题、导语、两个大数字和勾选项。
summaryEn: A dark panel on the left with one large icon tile and a few setting rows; on the right a title, lead, two big numbers and check items.
useWhen: 说明一个自动化能力是怎么设定的，以及效果
一句主张配两个硬数字
useWhenEn: Explain how an automation is set up and what it does
One claim with two hard numbers
avoidWhen: 数字多于 2 个：用 KpiBoard
没有可以列成设置项的规则
avoidWhenEn: More than 2 numbers: use KpiBoard
No rule that can be listed as a setting
limits: stats 正好 2 个：value ≤ 6 个字符，label ≤ 12 字
limitsEn: stats exactly 2: value ≤ 6 characters, label ≤ 12 chars

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<ProofSplit
  kicker="检查"
  title="每次构建，都自己检查一遍"
  icon="shield"
  rows={[{ label: 'FONT', value: '≥ 16.5u' }, { label: 'VIEWPORTS', value: '4 种' }, { label: 'REMOTE', value: '禁止' }]}
  stats={[{ value: '16.5u', label: '最小字号' }, { value: '4', label: '检查的视口' }]}
  source="scripts/qa.mjs"
/>

name: 目录叠卡
role: 结构 · 一页讲 3–5 件事，一次看一件
roleEn: Structure · One slide for 3–5 items, one at a time
summary: 左边一列目录，右边的卡片像文件夹一样错开叠放。设 build: "focus" 后每按一次 → 下一张翻到最前，目录同步高亮。
summaryEn: A contents column on the left, cards stacked like folders on the right. With build: "focus", each → brings the next card to the front and highlights it in the contents.
useWhen: 一页里要依次讲 3–5 个模块
模块各有一小块数据
useWhenEn: Walk through 3–5 modules on one slide
Each module has a small data set
avoidWhen: 模块之间要并排比较：用 PanelCards
超过 5 项
avoidWhenEn: Modules need a side-by-side comparison: use PanelCards
More than 5 items
limits: 每项的 ui 和 PanelCards 相同
建议在 SlideDef 上设 build: "focus"
limitsEn: label ≤ 8 chars, title ≤ 10 chars, body ≤ 40 chars
ui is the same as PanelCards
interaction: 按 → 把下一张卡翻到最前；跳页进入时全部叠好
interactionEn: Press → to bring the next card to the front; on a direct jump all cards start stacked

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<IndexStack
  kicker="目录叠卡"
  title="一页讲四件事，一次只看一件"
  items={[
    { label: '风格令牌', icon: 'tuning', title: '风格令牌', body: '…', ui: { kind: 'figure', value: '5 种' } },
    …
  ]}
/>

name: 联系卡
role: 收尾 · 下一步怎么找到你
roleEn: Closing · How to reach you next
summary: 一张深色大圆角卡：左边标题、导语和承诺勾选项，右边一张白卡列出联系方式或入口，底部一条黑色行动条。
summaryEn: A large dark rounded card: title, lead and promise checks on the left, a white card with contact details or entry points on the right, a black action bar at the bottom.
useWhen: 演示最后一页，给出明确的下一步
销售、合作、招募的收尾
useWhenEn: Last slide of a deck, with a clear next step
Closing for sales, partnership or hiring
avoidWhen: 没有真实可用的联系方式：用 Closing
需要放二维码：用 Thanks
avoidWhenEn: No real contact details: use Closing
Need a QR code: use Thanks
limits: fields 2–4 项：label ≤ 8 字，value ≤ 28 个字符，只写真实地址
limitsEn: fields 2–4: label ≤ 8 chars, value ≤ 28 characters, real addresses only
example:
<ContactPanel
  kicker="开始用"
  title={['挑一种风格，', '写下一份演示']}
  fields={[{ icon: 'gallery', label: '组件库', value: '#/kit' }]}
  action="打开组件库挑风格"
/>

name: 轨道图
role: 结构 · 一个核心和围绕它的东西
roleEn: Structure · One core and what surrounds it
summary: 右边是两圈轨道，中心一个深色图标，4–8 个彩色图标分布在内外圈上；左边是标题、导语和要点。
summaryEn: Two orbits on the right with a dark icon in the center and 4–8 colored icons on the inner and outer ring; title, lead and points on the left.
useWhen: 生态、集成、技术栈、合作方
说明“这些都连到同一个东西上”
useWhenEn: Ecosystem, integrations, tech stack, partners
Show that all of these connect to one thing
avoidWhen: 节点之间有先后或依赖：用 FlowDiagram
超过 8 个节点
avoidWhenEn: Nodes have an order or a dependency: use FlowDiagram
More than 8 nodes

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<Orbit
  kicker="技术栈"
  title="一个文件，背后这几样"
  center={{ icon: 'presentation', label: 'PCafe' }}
  nodes={[{ icon: 'code', label: 'React 19' }, { icon: 'bolt', label: 'Vite 8' }]}
  source="package.json"
/>

name: 大数字开场
role: 节奏 · 用一个数字开一章
roleEn: Rhythm · Open a chapter with one number
summary: 左边一个 400u 的强调色数字，右边一句解释和一行补充。比 BigStat 更极简，用在开场或章节第一页。
summaryEn: A 400u accent number on the left, one explanatory line and a sub line on the right. More minimal than BigStat; use it as the opener or on the first slide of a chapter.
useWhen: 开场就抛出最关键的一个数字
章节第一页用一个数字定调
useWhenEn: Open with the single most important number
Set the tone of a chapter with one number
avoidWhen: 需要多个数字：用 BigStat 或 KpiBoard
数字没有出处
avoidWhenEn: Need several numbers: use BigStat or KpiBoard
The number has no source
example:
<NumberOpener
  kicker="这一期之后"
  value="67"
  unit="个"
  text={['固定模板，', '每个都写明内容上限']}
  source="src/kit/catalog.ts"
/>

name: 章节进度
role: 节奏 · 章节第一页，告诉听众讲到哪了
roleEn: Rhythm · First slide of a chapter, shows where the talk is
summary: 上半是章节标题和一个大号“02 / 04”，下半是一条进度线：讲完的章节打勾，当前章点亮，后面的章节变淡。
summaryEn: Chapter title and a large "02 / 04" on top, a progress line below: finished chapters ticked, the current one lit, later chapters faded.
useWhen: 分章的长演示，每章第一页
听众需要知道还剩多少
useWhenEn: A long deck in chapters, on the first slide of each chapter
The audience needs to know how much is left
avoidWhen: 只有一章
想要配图标和大卡片的章节页：用 SectionBreak
avoidWhenEn: Only one chapter
Want icons and big cards on the section break: use SectionBreak
example:
<ChapterProgress
  kicker="第二部分"
  title="面板模板"
  chapters={['风格引擎', '面板模板', '节奏页', '检查与放映']}
  current={1}
/>

name: 问题页
role: 节奏 · 用一个问题引出下一段
roleEn: Rhythm · Lead into the next part with one question
summary: 整页只有一个问题，居中大字，背后一个很淡的巨型问号。
summaryEn: The whole slide is one question in large centered type, with a very faint giant question mark behind it.
useWhen: 下一章要回答一个问题
把听众的疑问先说出来
useWhenEn: The next chapter answers one question
Say the audience's doubt out loud first
avoidWhen: 问题本身就有答案：直接用 Statement
连续使用
avoidWhenEn: The question already contains its answer: use Statement
Used twice in a row
limits: question ≤ 2 行 × 12 字，以问号结尾
limitsEn: question ≤ 2 lines × 12 chars, ends with a question mark
example: <Question kicker="为什么不现场设计" question={['为什么不让 AI', '每次现场设计？']} sub="现场设计上限高，但每次结果不同。" />

name: 双句对照
role: 节奏 · 过去 / 现在、误解 / 事实
summary: 两句大字上下排列：上一句变灰并划掉，下一句用正文色，标签用强调色。设 build 后第二句按 → 再出现。
summaryEn: Two large lines stacked: the first greyed out and struck through, the second in body color, labels in the accent color. With build, the second line appears on →.
useWhen: 一句话说清楚改变了什么
纠正一个常见误解
useWhenEn: Say in one line what changed
Correct a common misconception
avoidWhen: 两边各有多条：用 VerdictColumns
需要数据对比：用 Dumbbell
avoidWhenEn: Several items on each side: use VerdictColumns
Need a data comparison: use Dumbbell
example:
<Contrast
  kicker="换风格的成本"
  before={{ label: '过去', text: '换风格，等于重写每一页' }}
  after={{ label: '现在', text: '换风格，只改一行 style' }}
/>

name: 章节小结
role: 节奏 · 一章结束时回顾要点
roleEn: Rhythm · Review the points at the end of a chapter
summary: 3–4 张卡片，每张一个勾、一个要点标题和一句说明；底部一个黑色胶囊预告下一章。
summaryEn: 3–4 cards, each with a tick, a point title and one line; a black pill at the bottom previews the next chapter.
useWhen: 一章讲完，留下要记住的几点
长演示中途帮听众整理
useWhenEn: End a chapter with the few points to remember
Help the audience keep track in a long deck
avoidWhen: 只有一点：用 Statement
要点之间有先后：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: Only one point: use Statement
Points have an order: use StepTrack

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<Recap
  kicker="小结"
  title="这一期留下的三件事"
  points={[{ title: '风格令牌', body: '…' }, { title: '18 个新模板', body: '…' }, { title: '样张先行', body: '…' }]}
  next={{ label: '下一期', title: '等宽黑底与贴纸风' }}
/>

name: 深色主卡封面
role: 开场 · 工具或平台发布
summary: 整页是一张深色大圆角卡：左边标签、标题、导语和胶囊，右边一张真实截图带透视斜放；卡片下方可以放 3 个月桂奖章。
summaryEn: The whole slide is one dark rounded card: tag, title, lead and pills on the left, a real screenshot tilted in perspective on the right; up to 3 laurels below the card.
useWhen: 软件、平台、设计系统发布
有一张能代表产品的真实截图
useWhenEn: Launch of software, a platform or a design system
There is a real screenshot that shows the product
avoidWhen: 没有真实截图：用 HangingCover
奖章内容无法引用出处：去掉 laurels
avoidWhenEn: No real screenshot: use HangingCover
Laurel content has no source: drop laurels
limits: laurels 0–3 个：title ≤ 10 字，sub ≤ 14 字，要有出处
limitsEn: src must be a real screenshot
laurels 0–3: title ≤ 10 chars, sub ≤ 14 chars, needs a source
example:
<HeroPanel
  tag={{ label: '第 1 期', text: '工作室风格' }}
  title={['做演示，', '像搭积木']}
  lead="…"
  src={kit}
  alt="组件库首页截图"
  laurels={[{ title: '67 个模板', sub: '全部带内容上限' }]}
/>

name: 分段截图
role: 产品 · 一个产品的 2–4 个界面
summary: 居中的标题和导语，下面一个分段切换器，再下面一张大截图。点击分段切换截图，打开时显示第一张。
summaryEn: Centered title and lead, a tab switcher below, then one large screenshot. Click a tab to switch the screenshot; the first one shows on open.
useWhen: 一个产品有几个主要界面
截图本身就是论据
useWhenEn: A product has a few main screens
The screenshot is the argument
avoidWhen: 没有真实截图
截图需要标注细节：用 Screenshot
avoidWhenEn: No real screenshot
Details in the screenshot need labels: use Screenshot
limits: 每个 src 都是真实截图
limitsEn: every src is a real screenshot
interaction: 点击分段切换截图
interactionEn: Click a tab to switch the screenshot

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<TabbedShot
  kicker="三种视图"
  title="写、挑、放，各有一个入口"
  tabs={[{ label: '组件库', src: kitEntry, alt: '…' }, { label: '放映', src: slide, alt: '…' }]}
/>

name: 设计规范
role: 产品 · 字体、颜色和尺寸
summary: 左边一张卡列出 2–3 种字体（大号 Aa 样字），右上是几排色点，右下是 4 个尺寸令牌。颜色在这里是内容，可以写色值。
summaryEn: A card on the left lists 2–3 typefaces with large Aa samples, rows of color dots at the top right and 4 size tokens at the bottom right. Here color is content, so hex values are allowed.
useWhen: 介绍品牌规范或设计系统
给设计、前端交接视觉规则
useWhenEn: Introduce brand guidelines or a design system
Hand visual rules to design or front-end
avoidWhen: 只有一种颜色要说明：写在正文里即可
字体多于 3 种
avoidWhenEn: Only one color to explain: write it in the body text
More than 3 typefaces
limits: fonts 2–3 种：name ≤ 20 个字符，role ≤ 10 字
tokens 0–4 个：label ≤ 8 字，value ≤ 12 个字符

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<BrandKit
  kicker="设计规范"
  title="字体、颜色和尺寸，都在一个文件里"
  fonts={[{ name: 'Geist', role: '正文', family: 'var(--f-sans)' }]}
  palettes={[{ name: '主题色', colors: [{ name: 'cobalt', value: '#2457f5' }] }]}
/>

name: 月桂奖章
role: 论证 · 荣誉、排名或硬指标
roleEn: Argument · Awards, rankings or hard numbers
summary: 3–4 张卡片，每张中间是麦穗环绕的标题和副标题，下面一句说明。
summaryEn: 3–4 cards, each with a title and subtitle ringed by laurel and one line below.
useWhen: 可以引用出处的奖项、排名、认证
几条硬性的承诺或底线
useWhenEn: Awards, rankings and certifications you can source
A few hard promises or limits
avoidWhen: 没有出处的“最佳”“第一”
超过 4 项
avoidWhenEn: "Best" or "first" with no source
More than 4 items
limits: items 3–4 个：title ≤ 10 字，sub ≤ 14 字，note ≤ 36 字
每一项都要能在 source 里找到依据
limitsEn: items 3–4: title ≤ 10 chars, sub ≤ 14 chars, note ≤ 36 chars
every item must be backed in the source

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<Laurels
  kicker="三条底线"
  title="每次构建都守住的三件事"
  items={[{ title: '0 个外部请求', sub: '断网也能打开' }]}
  source="vite.config.ts"
/>

name: 整页图片
role: 节奏 · 一张图占满整页
roleEn: Rhythm · One image fills the slide
summary: 一张真实截图或照片铺满整页，底部渐暗，左下角白字标题和说明。SlideDef 上要设 tone: "dark"。
summaryEn: A real screenshot or photo fills the slide and darkens towards the bottom, with a white title and caption at the bottom left. Set tone: "dark" on the SlideDef.
useWhen: 一张图就能说明问题
章节之间的视觉停顿
useWhenEn: One image says it all
A visual pause between chapters
avoidWhen: 图片不是真实截图或照片
需要标注图上的细节：用 Screenshot
avoidWhenEn: The image is not a real screenshot or photo
Details in the image need labels: use Screenshot
limits: src 是真实截图或照片，16:9 或更宽
limitsEn: src is a real screenshot or photo, 16:9 or wider

name: 致谢与提问
role: 收尾 · 谢谢 + 提问 + 联系方式
summary: 左边一个超大“谢谢”和提问邀请，右边 2–4 条联系方式卡，可以加一张真实二维码。
summaryEn: A very large thank you and an invitation to ask on the left, 2–4 contact cards on the right, plus an optional real QR code.
useWhen: 演讲结束，进入问答
需要留下多种联系方式
useWhenEn: The talk ends and Q&A starts
Several contact details to leave behind
avoidWhen: 想把下一步行动讲清楚：用 ContactPanel
没有真实联系方式
avoidWhenEn: Want the next step spelled out: use ContactPanel
No real contact details
limits: contacts 2–4 条：label ≤ 6 字，value ≤ 32 个字符
qr 必须是真实二维码
limitsEn: qr must be a real QR code
example:
<Thanks
  kicker="谢谢"
  title="谢谢"
  prompt="关于模板、风格和检查规则，都可以提问。"
  contacts={[{ icon: 'gallery', label: '组件库', value: '#/kit' }]}
/>

name: 大字穿插封面
role: 开场 · 创意或品牌提案
summary: 两行巨字分别占左上和右下，中间斜插一叠 2–3 张卡片：真实截图，或色块加图标。等宽黑风格的招牌封面。
summaryEn: Two huge words sit at the top left and the bottom right, with a stack of 2–3 cards tilted between them: real screenshots, or color blocks with icons. The signature cover of the mono style.
useWhen: 创意、品牌、作品集类提案的封面
有 2–3 张能代表内容的真实截图
useWhenEn: Cover for a creative, brand or portfolio proposal
2–3 real screenshots that represent the work
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
标题超过两个词：用 HangingCover
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
Title longer than two words: use HangingCover
limits: words 2 个，各 ≤ 6 字或 10 个西文字母
cards 2–3 张：label ≤ 8 字；src 必须是真实截图
limitsEn: words 2, each ≤ 6 chars or 10 Latin letters
cards 2–3: label ≤ 8 chars; src must be a real screenshot
example:
<SplitWord
  kicker="第 2 期 · 等宽黑"
  words={['DECK', 'KIT']}
  cards={[{ label: '组件库', src: kit, alt: '…' }, { label: '放映', src: slide, alt: '…' }, { label: '总览', src: overview, alt: '…' }]}
  lead="用数字看这套模板：多少、由什么组成、节奏怎么排。"
/>

name: 胶囊目录章节页
role: 节奏 · 每章开头
summary: 顶部一排胶囊列出全部章节，已讲的划线、当前的反白；左下一个取景框框住超大章节号，右边是章节标题和导语。
summaryEn: A row of pills on top lists every chapter, past ones struck through and the current one inverted; a viewfinder at the bottom left frames a very large chapter number, with the chapter title and lead on the right.
useWhen: 等宽黑风格的章节页
让听众知道一共几章、讲到哪里
useWhenEn: Section break in the mono style
Show how many chapters there are and where the talk is
avoidWhen: 少于 3 章
其他风格：用 ChapterProgress 或 SectionBreak
avoidWhenEn: Fewer than 3 chapters
Other styles: use ChapterProgress or SectionBreak

props.name: current
props.note: 当前章节下标，从 0 开始

example: <PillAgenda kicker="第一部分" chapters={['规模', '构成', '节奏', '取舍']} current={0} title={['先看规模']} lead="…" />

name: 数字卡片行
role: 数据 · 3–4 个并列的规模数字
roleEn: Data · 3–4 scale numbers side by side
summary: 一排深色卡片，像手机小组件：右上角三个点，等宽小字标签，大数字，一句说明；第一张数字用强调色。下方可放一排名称胶囊。
summaryEn: A row of dark cards like phone widgets: three dots at the top right, a mono label, a big number and one line; the first number uses the accent color. A row of name pills can go below.
useWhen: 3–4 个同样重要的规模数字
顺带列出用到的工具或合作方（只写名字）
useWhenEn: 3–4 scale numbers of equal weight
List the tools or partners involved, names only
avoidWhen: 一个数字就是论点：用 BigStat
要看趋势：用 SparkCards
avoidWhenEn: One number is the argument: use BigStat
Need a trend: use SparkCards
limits: stats 3–4 个：value ≤ 6 字符，label ≤ 12 字符，note ≤ 28 字
names ≤ 8 个，只写文字，不放 logo
limitsEn: stats 3–4: value ≤ 6 characters, label ≤ 12 characters, note ≤ 28 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<StatRow
  kicker="规模"
  title="四个数说清这套模板"
  stats={[{ label: 'templates', value: '86', note: '…' }, …]}
  names={['React 19', 'Vite 8', 'motion']}
  source="src/kit/catalog.ts"
/>

name: 数字滚动对比
role: 数据 · 前后两个数字
roleEn: Data · One number before and after
summary: 左右两张卡片各一个大数字，进入时从 0 滚动到目标值；中间箭头和变化量胶囊。右边那张反色，代表现在。
summaryEn: A card on each side with one big number that counts from 0 to its value on entry; an arrow and a change pill in between. The right card is inverted and stands for now.
useWhen: 一个指标的前后变化，变化本身就是结论
发布、复盘、季度对比
useWhenEn: Before and after of one metric, where the change is the point
Launch, retro or quarter comparison
avoidWhen: 超过两个数字：用 MetricBars
需要过程：用 LineChart
avoidWhenEn: More than two numbers: use MetricBars
Need the path: use LineChart
limits: before / after：label ≤ 8 字，note ≤ 20 字，unit ≤ 4 字
limitsEn: before / after: label ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 20 chars, unit ≤ 4 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<CountCompare
  kicker="这一期"
  title="模板从 67 个增加到 86 个"
  before={{ label: '第 1 期结束', value: 67, unit: '个' }}
  after={{ label: '第 2 期结束', value: 86, unit: '个' }}
  change="+19 个"
  source="src/kit/catalog.ts"
/>

name: 环形图
role: 数据 · 一个整体的 2–5 个部分
summary: 一个大环，焦点部分用强调色、其余是灰阶；环中间放总数或焦点占比；右边图例列出每部分的数值和百分比。
summaryEn: One large ring, the focus part in the accent color and the rest in greys; the total or the focus share sits in the middle; a legend on the right gives the value and percentage of each part.
useWhen: 构成：预算、体积、时间花在哪
焦点只有一个部分
useWhenEn: Composition: where budget, size or time goes
Only one part is the focus
avoidWhen: 部分超过 5 个：用 ShareBar 或 MetricBars
各部分加起来不是整体
avoidWhenEn: More than 5 parts: use ShareBar or MetricBars
The parts do not add up to the whole
limits: segments 2–5 个：label ≤ 8 字，note ≤ 16 字，按从大到小排
limitsEn: segments 2–5: label ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 16 chars, sorted largest first

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<Donut
  kicker="打包构成"
  title="一个文件，六成是字体"
  center={{ value: '6.0', label: 'MB · 单个 HTML' }}
  segments={[{ label: '字体', value: 3.6 }, { label: '脚本', value: 1.8 }, { label: '截图', value: 0.4 }, { label: '样式', value: 0.2 }]}
  unit=" MB"
  decimals={1}
  source="dist/index.html"
/>

name: 柱状图
role: 数据 · 2–8 个类别，分组或堆叠
summary: 竖向柱状图，每根柱子上方标出数值；mode="stack" 时堆叠并只标总数。可以指定一个焦点类别，其余变淡。系列 1 是强调色，其余灰阶。
summaryEn: Vertical bars with the value above each bar; with mode="stack" they stack and only the total is labelled. One focus category can be set and the rest fade. Series 1 is the accent color, the rest are greys.
useWhen: 2–8 个类别的数量对比
每个类别再分 2–3 个系列（分组或构成）
useWhenEn: Compare counts across 2–8 categories
Each category splits into 2–3 series, grouped or stacked
avoidWhen: 只有 2–4 个数：用 MetricBars
时间趋势：用 LineChart
有正有负：用 DeltaBars
avoidWhenEn: Only 2–4 numbers: use MetricBars
Time trend: use LineChart
Positive and negative: use DeltaBars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<BarChart
  kicker="明暗"
  title="深色页集中在 GTM"
  categories={['Lumen', 'GEO', 'GTM', 'Launch', 'Studio']}
  series={[{ name: '浅色页', values: [24, 30, 23, 13, 6] }, { name: '深色页', values: [1, 1, 5, 0, 1] }]}
  mode="stack"
  unit=" 页"
  focus={2}
  source="…"
/>

name: 散点 / 气泡图
role: 数据 · 两个维度上的定位
summary: 两条坐标轴，3–10 个点；给 size 就成了气泡图（面积代表第三个量）。一个焦点点用强调色。标签挤在一起时，用 side 把它挪到上、左或右。
summaryEn: Two axes and 3–10 points; give size and it becomes a bubble chart, where area stands for a third value. One focus point uses the accent color. When labels collide, use side to move a label up, left or right.
useWhen: 对象在两个连续指标上的位置
想同时看第三个量（气泡大小）
useWhenEn: Where targets sit on two continuous metrics
Read a third value at the same time through bubble size
avoidWhen: 只有两个类别的定位：用 Quadrant
点超过 10 个
avoidWhenEn: Positioning of only two categories: use Quadrant
More than 10 points

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<Bubble
  kicker="页数与模板"
  title="页数越多，用到的模板越多"
  points={[{ label: 'GEO', x: 31, y: 25, size: 4, side: 'right' }, { label: 'GTM', x: 30, y: 26, size: 10, side: 'left' }, …]}
  x={{ label: '页数', min: 0, max: 35 }}
  y={{ label: '模板种类', min: 0, max: 30 }}
  sizeLabel="气泡大小：逐条展开的页数"
  focus="GTM"
  source="…"
/>

name: 仪表盘
role: 数据 · 一个值相对上限
roleEn: Data · One value against its limit
summary: 240° 的表盘，强调色填到当前值，可加一个目标刻度；中间是大数字。右边可放 2–3 个补充数字。
summaryEn: A 240 degree dial filled to the current value in the accent color, with an optional target tick; the big number in the middle. 2–3 supporting numbers can go on the right.
useWhen: 完成度、预算用量、容量占用
有明确的上限或目标
useWhenEn: Completion, budget used, capacity taken
There is a clear limit or target
avoidWhen: 没有上限的数：用 BigStat
多个指标：用 KpiBoard
avoidWhenEn: A number with no limit: use BigStat
Several metrics: use KpiBoard
limits: points 0–3 个：label ≤ 10 字，value ≤ 8 字符

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<Gauge
  kicker="体积"
  title="离预估上限还有余量"
  value={6.0}
  max={8}
  decimals={1}
  unit=" MB"
  label="当前单文件体积"
  target={{ value: 7, label: '预估下限 7 MB' }}
  source="…"
/>

name: 巨字服务列表
role: 内容 · 4–6 件事，一行一个大字
roleEn: Content · 4–6 items, one big word per row
summary: 一列巨大的词，单双行交替墨色和强调色，左边一个彩色图标方块，右边一行等宽小字说明。
summaryEn: A column of very large words, alternating ink and accent color row by row, a colored icon square on the left and one line of monospace note text on the right.
useWhen: 我们做什么、流程有哪几步
每项能用一个词说清
useWhenEn: What we do, which steps the process has
Each item fits in one word
avoidWhen: 每项要两句以上：用 NumberedColumns
有严格顺序和细节：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: Each item needs two sentences or more: use NumberedColumns
Strict order and detail: use StepTrack
limits: items 4–6 个：word ≤ 6 字或 12 个字母，note ≤ 24 字
limitsEn: items 4–6: word ≤ 6 chars or 12 letters, note ≤ 24 chars
example:
<ServiceList
  kicker="怎么用"
  items={[{ word: '挑模板', icon: 'widget', note: '在 #/kit 挑' }, { word: '填内容', icon: 'pen', note: '…' }, …]}
/>

name: 弧形引语卡
role: 内容 · 三句有出处的原话
summary: 三张引语卡排成一道弧：中间那张反色在最前，两侧的向内转。每张一句原话、人名和出处。
summaryEn: Three quote cards in an arc: the middle one inverted and in front, the side ones turned inward. Each holds one quote, a name and a source.
useWhen: 三句能逐字引用、有出处的原话
用名言或客户原话给观点背书
useWhenEn: Three quotes you can cite word for word, each with a source
Back a point with a known quote or a customer's own words
avoidWhen: 只有一句：用 QuoteHero
原话查不到出处
avoidWhenEn: Only one quote: use QuoteHero
The quote has no traceable source
limits: quotes 恰好 3 句：text ≤ 48 字，name ≤ 12 字符，role ≤ 20 字
limitsEn: quotes exactly 3: text ≤ 48 chars, name ≤ 12 characters, role ≤ 20 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example:
<QuoteArc
  kicker="取舍"
  title="删到不能再删，再把数据摆出来"
  quotes={[{ text: '少，但更好。', name: 'Dieter Rams', role: '…' }, …]}
  source="…"
/>

name: 色块作品卡
role: 内容 · 3–4 个项目或方案
summary: 每张卡一大块颜色，标题在上，中间一个大图标（或真实截图、decor- 装饰插图），左下一个描边胶囊标签。
summaryEn: Each card is one large block of color: title on top, a big icon in the middle (or a real screenshot or decor- illustration) and an outlined pill tag at bottom left.
useWhen: 作品集、方案、产品线并列展示
每项一句话就够
useWhenEn: Showing a portfolio, options or product lines side by side
One sentence per item is enough
avoidWhen: 需要说明文字：用 IconGrid
要对比优劣：用 VerdictColumns
avoidWhenEn: You need body text: use IconGrid
You need to compare pros and cons: use VerdictColumns
limits: src 必须是真实截图或 decor- 装饰插图
limitsEn: src must be a real screenshot or a decor- illustration

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: cards
props.type: { title, tag, spot?, icon?, src?, alt? }[]
props.noteEn: { title, tag, spot?, icon?, src?, alt? }

example:
<WorkCards
  kicker="风格"
  title="两期新增的四种风格"
  cards={[{ title: '静谧', tag: 'calm', icon: 'widget', spot: 1 }, …]}
/>

name: 重复字结束页
role: 收尾 · 最后一页
summary: 一个西文词组铺满整页背景（描边、缓慢漂移），正中一行大字加强调色下划线，下面一行等宽小字；右下角可放一个聊天气泡。
summaryEn: A Latin-script phrase fills the whole slide background (outlined, slowly drifting); a big line of text with an accent underline sits in the middle, a monospace line below it, and an optional chat bubble at bottom right.
useWhen: 等宽黑风格的结束页
谢谢、提问、下一期预告
useWhenEn: A closing slide in the mono black style
Thanks, questions, a preview of the next issue
avoidWhen: 要列联系方式：用 ContactPanel 或 Thanks
avoidWhenEn: You need to list contact details: use ContactPanel or Thanks

props.name: word
props.noteEn: The word repeated in the background

example: <RepeatClosing word="THANK YOU" title={['谢谢']} sub="下一期：…" chat={{ name: 'PCafe', text: '有问题，现在问' }} />

name: 贴纸封面
role: 开场 · 轻松的分享或个人介绍
roleEn: Opening · informal sharing or personal intro
summary: 网格纸上，标题最后一行套着设计软件的选中框，手写注释用弧线箭头指向标题；周围散落 2–4 张贴纸（带鼠标指针）；右边是一张拍立得，放真实截图并贴着文件名标签。
summaryEn: On grid paper, the last line of the title sits inside a design-tool selection box and a handwritten note points at the title with a curved arrow; 2–4 stickers with mouse cursors scatter around; on the right a Polaroid holds a real screenshot with a file-name label.
useWhen: 团队分享、个人介绍、内部轻松场合
有一张产品或作品的真实截图
useWhenEn: Team sharing, personal intro, informal internal sessions
You have a real screenshot of a product or a piece of work
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
没有截图时可去掉 shot，标题会占满
avoidWhenEn: A formal report: use Cover
With no screenshot you can drop shot; the title then fills the slide
example:
<StickerCover
  title={['写演示，', '像贴贴纸']}
  lead="…"
  note="这就是标题"
  stickers={[{ text: '86 个模板' }, { text: '7 种风格' }]}
  shot={{ src: kit, alt: '…', caption: '组件库 #/kit', file: 'KIT.WEBP' }}
/>

name: 彩色词块
role: 内容 · 4–10 个关键词
summary: 每个词一块粗边彩色积木，前面一个小图形（圆、星、方、花、三角、半圆），像贴纸一样略微歪斜地排开。
summaryEn: Each word is a thick-bordered color block with a small shape in front (circle, star, square, flower, triangle, half circle), laid out slightly tilted like stickers.
useWhen: 技能、主题、能力清单
每项一个词就够
useWhenEn: A list of skills, topics or abilities
One word per item is enough
avoidWhen: 每项要解释：用 IconGrid
有先后顺序：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: Each item needs an explanation: use IconGrid
The items have an order: use StepTrack
limits: words 4–10 个，各 ≤ 6 字或 12 个字母

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

example: <WordBlocks kicker="能做什么" title="这些页面，都有现成的模板" words={[{ word: '封面' }, { word: '数据图表' }, …]} />

name: 文件夹叠卡
role: 内容 · 3–4 个项目，一次看一个
roleEn: Content · 3–4 projects, one at a time
summary: 几只文件夹叠在一起，页签错开排列；最前面的展示标题、说明、要点和一张真实截图。配合逐条展开 focus 时，每按一次 → 下一只翻到最前。
summaryEn: A few folders stacked with offset tabs; the front one shows a title, a body, points and a real screenshot. With build set to focus, each → brings the next folder to the front.
useWhen: 3–4 个项目或模块，要逐个讲
每个都有截图
useWhenEn: 3–4 projects or modules to walk through one by one
Each one has a screenshot
avoidWhen: 要并排比较：用 PanelCards
超过 4 个
avoidWhenEn: You need a side-by-side comparison: use PanelCards
More than 4
limits: items 3–4 个：tab ≤ 10 字符，title ≤ 14 字，body ≤ 60 字，points 0–3 条各 ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: items 3–4: tab ≤ 10 characters, title ≤ 14 chars, body ≤ 60 chars, points 0–3, each ≤ 16 chars
src must be a real screenshot
interaction: build 设为 focus：当前文件夹翻到最前。
interactionEn: Set build to focus: the current folder moves to the front.

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: items
props.type: { tab?, title, body, points?, src?, alt?, file? }[]
props.noteEn: { tab?, title, body, points?, src?, alt?, file? }

example:
<FolderCards
  kicker="三种视图"
  title="一个文件夹一个入口"
  items={[{ tab: 'KIT', title: '组件库', body: '…', src: kitEntry, alt: '…', file: 'ENTRY.WEBP' }, …]}
/>

name: 迷你走势卡
role: 数据 · 3–4 个指标各带走势
roleEn: Data · 3–4 metrics, each with a trend
summary: 每张卡一个大数字、一个变化胶囊和一条小折线（带面积，终点一个圆点），底部注明周期。
summaryEn: Each card has a big number, a change pill and a small line chart (with area and a dot at the end); the period is noted at the bottom.
useWhen: 3–4 个指标，每个都有一串历史值
既要看现在也要看走势
useWhenEn: 3–4 metrics, each with a series of past values
You need both the current value and the trend
avoidWhen: 只看一个指标的趋势：用 LineChart
没有历史值：用 StatRow
avoidWhenEn: Only one metric's trend: use LineChart
No past values: use StatRow
limits: cards 3–4 张：label ≤ 10 字，value ≤ 7 字符，series 4–32 个点，note ≤ 12 字
limitsEn: cards 3–4: label ≤ 10 chars, value ≤ 7 characters, series 4–32 points, note ≤ 12 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: cards
props.type: { label, value, unit?, delta?, series, note? }[]
props.noteEn: { label, value, unit?, delta?, series, note? }

example:
<SparkCards
  kicker="文字密度"
  title="每页写多少字，起伏比平均数重要"
  cards={[{ label: 'Lumen 解读', value: '101', unit: '字/页', series: [74, 115, 52, …], note: '25 页' }, …]}
  source="…"
/>

name: 象形占比
role: 数据 · “每 N 个里有几个”
roleEn: Data · “how many out of every N”
summary: 左边是结论和图例，右边 10 个大格或 10×10 的小格，按比例从第一格起依次涂色，最多三种颜色。
summaryEn: The conclusion and legend on the left; 10 large cells or a 10×10 grid on the right, filled in order from the first cell in proportion, in at most three colors.
useWhen: 比例换成“每 10 / 100 个里有几个”更好懂
一到三个部分
useWhenEn: A share reads better as “how many out of every 10 / 100”
One to three parts
avoidWhen: 精确到小数的比例：用 ShareBar
部分超过 3 个：用 Donut
avoidWhenEn: A share precise to decimals: use ShareBar
More than 3 parts: use Donut
example:
<Pictogram
  kicker="页面类型"
  title={['每 100 页里，', '23 页逐条展开']}
  of={100}
  parts={[{ label: '逐条展开', value: 23 }, { label: '深色或强调色整页', value: 9 }]}
  rest="静态浅色页"
  source="…"
/>

name: 排名变化
role: 数据 · 两个时间点或两种口径的名次
roleEn: Data · ranks at two time points or under two measures
summary: 左右两列名次，中间连线：上升的线较深，焦点一条用强调色；右侧标出升降几位。
summaryEn: Two columns of ranks with connecting lines: rising lines are darker, the focus line uses the accent color, and the change in places is marked on the right.
useWhen: 排名在两个时间点之间的变化
同一批对象按两种口径排名
useWhenEn: How ranks change between two time points
The same set ranked under two measures
avoidWhen: 要看具体数值：用 Dumbbell
超过 8 个对象
avoidWhenEn: You need the actual values: use Dumbbell
More than 8 items

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

example:
<SlopeRank
  kicker="两种排名"
  title="按页数排第二，按模板种类排第一"
  periods={['按页数', '按模板种类']}
  items={[{ name: 'GEO 简报', from: 1, to: 2 }, { name: 'GTM 手册', from: 2, to: 1 }, …]}
  focus="GTM 手册"
  source="…"
/>

name: 像素字结束页
role: 收尾 · 最后一页
summary: 巨大的像素体西文（例如 LET'S TALK），下面一块黄黑斜纹色块托着一个按钮式的行动号召；顶部一个吉祥物（decor- 装饰插图，没有时用图标方块代替）。
summaryEn: Very large pixel Latin text (for example LET'S TALK), over a yellow and black diagonal-striped block that holds a button-style call to action; a mascot at the top (a decor- illustration, replaced by an icon square when there is none).
useWhen: 贴纸风格的结束页
有一个明确的下一步动作
useWhenEn: A closing slide in the sticker style
There is one clear next action
avoidWhen: 正式场合：用 Closing
avoidWhenEn: A formal setting: use Closing
limits: contacts 0–3 条：label ≤ 6 字，value ≤ 24 字符
example: <PixelClosing big="LET'S TALK" action="打开 #/kit 试试" sub="…" contacts={[{ label: '规则', value: 'docs/zh-CN/guide.md' }]} />

name: 漂浮几何封面
role: 开场 · 品牌或发布会第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · slide 1 of a brand or launch deck
summary: 居中的超大标题，下面一张数字卡片，四个 CSS 画的 3D 球体、立方体、圆环、胶囊漂浮在周围，背后一条巨字跑马灯缓缓横移。几何风格的招牌封面。
summaryEn: A very large centered title with a number card below it; four CSS-drawn 3D shapes (sphere, cube, torus, capsule) float around it, and a big-word marquee drifts slowly behind. The signature cover of the geometric style.
useWhen: 发布会、品牌介绍的封面
有一个能代表这次主题的数字
useWhenEn: A cover for a launch or a brand intro
There is a number that stands for the topic
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
没有合适的数字：用 HangingCover
avoidWhenEn: A formal report: use Cover
No suitable number: use HangingCover
limits: marquee ≤ 10 字符，只重复页面上已有的词
limitsEn: marquee ≤ 10 characters, only repeats words already on the slide

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

name: 图标砖墙
role: 并列 · 6–9 个功能或零件

useWhen: 6 或 9 个并列的功能、集成、零件
每项一个词就能说清
useWhenEn: 6 or 9 parallel features, integrations or parts
Each item fits in one word
avoidWhen: 每项需要一句解释：用 IconGrid
少于 6 项
avoidWhenEn: Each item needs a sentence: use IconGrid
Fewer than 6 items

props.name: title

props.name: shape
props.note: 背后的几何体，默认球体

name: 大编号服务栏
role: 操作 · 3–4 个步骤或服务
summary: 3–4 列，每列压在一个超大的淡色编号上：标题加一段说明。右上角一个小立方体点缀。
summaryEn: 3–4 columns, each sitting on a very large pale number: a title plus a short body. A small cube sits in the top right.
useWhen: 3–4 个步骤、服务或方法
每项需要一两句说明
useWhenEn: 3–4 steps, services or methods
Each item needs a sentence or two
avoidWhen: 步骤之间有明确的先后箭头：用 StepTrack
超过 4 项
avoidWhenEn: The steps have explicit order arrows: use StepTrack
More than 4 items

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: shape
props.note: 右上角几何体，默认立方体
props.noteEn: Shape in the top right, cube by default

example: <ServiceIndex kicker="工作流" title="做好一页，按四步走" items={[{ title: '收集事实', text: '…' }, …]} />

name: 发光叠卡
role: 预告 · 这一个，然后下一个
roleEn: Preview · this one, then the next
summary: 前面一张清晰的卡片列出当前的要点，后面一张略模糊的卡片是下一个，底下透出一团彩色光晕。
summaryEn: A clear card in front lists the current points, a slightly blurred card behind it is the next one, and a colored glow shows through underneath.
useWhen: 讲本期 / 下期、当前版本 / 下个版本
当前这项有 2–4 个要点
useWhenEn: This issue versus the next, the current version versus the next
The current one has 2–4 points
avoidWhen: 两项同样重要：用 DuoCards
超过两项：用 Roadmap
avoidWhenEn: Both items matter equally: use DuoCards
More than two items: use Roadmap
limits: front.title ≤ 14 字，items 2–4 条各 ≤ 20 字

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

example: <GlowStack kicker="路线" title="…" front={{ label: 'PHASE 3', title: '几何与桌面', items: ['…'] }} back={{ label: 'PHASE 4', title: '…' }} />

name: 双色方案卡
role: 对比 · 两个方案或两种用法
roleEn: Comparison · two options or two uses
summary: 橙、紫两张实色大卡并排，各有一个大数字、一句说明和绿点清单。像两档价格，也适合两种用法。
summaryEn: Two large solid cards, orange and purple, side by side; each has a big number, one line of text and a list with green dots. It reads like two price tiers and also suits two ways of using something.
useWhen: 两个方案、两档套餐、两种用法
每项有一个代表数字
useWhenEn: Two options, two tiers, two ways of using something
Each one has a number that represents it
avoidWhen: 三档：用 PricingTiers
要逐行对比属性：用 CompareTable
avoidWhenEn: Three tiers: use PricingTiers
You need a row-by-row attribute comparison: use CompareTable
limits: cards 正好 2 张：name ≤ 8 字，value ≤ 6 字符，note ≤ 24 字，items 3–5 条各 ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: cards exactly 2: name ≤ 8 chars, value ≤ 6 characters, note ≤ 24 chars, items 3–5, each ≤ 16 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

example: <DuoCards kicker="两种用法" title="…" cards={[{ name: '单文件', value: '6.0', unit: 'MB', note: '…', items: ['…'] }, { … }]} />

name: 桌面封面
role: 开场 · 轻松的产品演示
summary: 一张电脑桌面：左边一列桌面图标，中间一个窗口放标题和导语，右上角一个时钟小组件，底部一排程序坞。
summaryEn: A computer desktop: a column of desktop icons on the left, a window in the middle holding the title and lead, a clock widget in the top right and a dock along the bottom.
useWhen: 产品演示、个人分享的封面或目录
桌面风格的演示
useWhenEn: A cover or contents slide for a product demo or a personal talk
A deck in the desktop style
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
avoidWhenEn: A formal report: use Cover

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: file
props.noteEn: File name in the window title bar

example: <Desktop kicker="第 3 期" title={['把演示', '放进桌面']} file="phase-3.deck" apps={[…]} dock={[…]} />

name: 层叠窗口
role: 操作 · 2–3 个步骤
summary: 2–3 个系统窗口错开层叠，每个窗口一个小标题和一两行说明，逐条展开时依次出现。
summaryEn: 2–3 system windows stacked with an offset; each has a small title and one or two lines, and they appear in order during the build step.
useWhen: 2–3 个步骤，每步对应一个文件或工具
桌面风格的演示
useWhenEn: 2–3 steps, each with its own file or tool
A deck in the desktop style
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 3 个：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 steps: use StepTrack
limits: windows 2–3 个：title ≤ 16 字符，heading ≤ 14 字，lines 1–3 行各 ≤ 26 字
limitsEn: windows 2–3: title ≤ 16 characters, heading ≤ 14 chars, lines 1–3, each ≤ 26 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: windows
props.noteEn: Windows, the last one in front

example: <WindowStack kicker="一页怎么来" title="…" windows={[{ title: 'index.tsx', heading: '写内容', lines: ['…'] }, …]} />

name: 开关设置窗
role: 要点 · 哪些开着、哪些关着
roleEn: Key points · which are on, which are off
summary: 一个设置窗口，每行一个图标、名称、说明和开关。开关可以现场点，但只是演示，不控制任何东西。
summaryEn: A settings window where each row has an icon, a name, a note and a toggle. The toggles can be clicked live, but it is only illustrative and controls nothing.
useWhen: 讲默认设置、功能开关、可选项
桌面风格的演示
useWhenEn: Default settings, feature switches or options
A deck in the desktop style
avoidWhen: 要说明的是状态好坏：用 StatusGrid
avoidWhenEn: The point is whether a state is good or bad: use StatusGrid
interaction: 点击开关可切换，仅为演示
interactionEn: Clicking a toggle switches it; illustrative only

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

example: <ToggleCard kicker="放映" title="…" file="放映设置" rows={[{ icon: 'monitor', label: '全屏', note: 'F 键', on: true }, …]} />

name: 金字塔
role: 结构 · 层层依赖的条件
summary: 3–5 层梯形叠成金字塔，下层最宽、颜色最浅，每层右边一句说明。逐条展开时从底层往上出现。
summaryEn: 3–5 trapezoid layers stacked into a pyramid: the bottom layer is widest and palest, each layer has one line of text on its right, and they appear bottom-up during the build step.
useWhen: 前提条件、层级、需求层次
下层是上层的基础
useWhenEn: Preconditions, levels, layers of need
The layer below is the basis for the one above
avoidWhen: 各层没有依赖关系：用 LayerStack
要表达数量递减：用 Funnel
avoidWhenEn: The layers do not depend on each other: use LayerStack
You need to show a falling count: use Funnel

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually in the array

props.name: levels
props.noteEn: Write from the top layer down

example: <Pyramid kicker="交付条件" title="…" levels={[{ label: '人工看图', note: '…' }, …, { label: '事实有出处', note: '…' }]} />

name: 维恩图
role: 概念 · 几样东西的交集
roleEn: Concept · the overlap of a few things
summary: 2 或 3 个半透明圆相交，每个圆写名称和一句说明，正中的深色胶囊写它们的交集。
summaryEn: 2 or 3 translucent circles overlap; each circle holds a name and one line of text, and a dark pill in the middle holds their overlap.
useWhen: 几个维度共同决定一个结果
定性说明，不带数量
useWhenEn: Several dimensions together decide one result
A qualitative point with no numbers
avoidWhen: 要比较各部分大小：用 Donut
超过 3 个集合
avoidWhenEn: You need to compare part sizes: use Donut
More than 3 sets

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <Venn kicker="三个开关" title="…" sets={[{ label: '模板', note: '布局与内容上限' }, …]} overlap="一份演示" />

name: 同心圆
role: 结构 · 从核心到外围
summary: 左边 3–4 个同心圆环，核心最深；右边列表逐条解释每一圈，圆点颜色和圆环对应。
summaryEn: 3–4 concentric rings on the left with the darkest core; a list on the right explains each ring, with dot colors matching the rings.
useWhen: 核心与外围、影响范围、目录分层
每一圈包住里面一圈
useWhenEn: Core versus edge, reach of influence, layers of a contents list
Each ring encloses the one inside it
avoidWhen: 各层是上下堆叠关系：用 ArchLayers
一个核心加若干平级的卫星：用 Orbit
avoidWhenEn: The layers stack vertically: use ArchLayers
One core plus parallel satellites: use Orbit

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <Concentric kicker="项目结构" title="…" rings={[{ label: '模板', note: '…' }, …]} />

name: 决策树
role: 分析 · 什么情况选哪个
roleEn: Analysis · which one to pick when
summary: 从上往下读的是 / 否决策树，最多两层问题、四个结果，结果用强调色框出。
summaryEn: A yes / no decision tree read from the top down, with at most two levels of questions and four results; the results are boxed in the accent color.
useWhen: 根据条件选方案、选工具
每个问题都能用是 / 否回答
useWhenEn: Choosing an option or a tool from conditions
Every question can be answered yes / no
avoidWhen: 问题超过两层：拆成两页
要拆解原因：用 IssueTree
avoidWhenEn: More than two levels of questions: split it over two slides
You need to break down causes: use IssueTree
limits: 最多两层问题、4 个结果
limitsEn: q ≤ 14 chars, leaf ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 14 chars
At most two levels of questions, 4 results

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: root
props.note: { q, yes, no } 或 { leaf, note? }
props.noteEn: { q, yes, no } or { leaf, note? }

example: <DecisionTree kicker="选图表" title="想比的是什么？" root={{ q: '数据跟时间有关吗？', yes: { leaf: 'LineChart' }, no: { leaf: 'BarChart' } }} />

name: 鱼骨图
role: 分析 · 一个问题的成因
summary: 右边是鱼头写问题，鱼骨上下交替伸出 4 或 6 根，每根一个原因类别和 1–3 条具体原因。骨头斜向鱼头，和脊柱相接。
summaryEn: The fish head on the right holds the problem; 4 or 6 bones run in from above and below, each with a cause category and 1–3 specific causes. The bones slant toward the head and meet the spine.
useWhen: 排查问题、复盘事故
原因能归成 4–6 类
useWhenEn: Troubleshooting a problem, reviewing an incident
The causes fall into 4–6 categories
avoidWhen: 原因有层层因果：用 IssueTree
少于 4 类
avoidWhenEn: The causes have cause chains: use IssueTree
Fewer than 4 categories
limits: bones 4 或 6 根：label ≤ 6 字，causes 1–3 条各 ≤ 12 字
limitsEn: bones 4 or 6: label ≤ 6 chars, causes 1–3, each ≤ 12 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <Fishbone kicker="排查" title="…" problem="页面看起来乱" bones={[{ label: '文字', causes: ['…'] }, …]} />

name: 泳道流程图
role: 分工 · 一个流程里谁做哪步
roleEn: Roles · who does which step in a process
summary: 每个角色一条横向泳道，步骤按顺序占一列，箭头依次连接；换人接手的步骤用强调色描边。
summaryEn: Each role gets a horizontal lane, the steps take one column in order and arrows connect them; a step handed to another role gets an accent outline.
useWhen: 跨角色的流程、交接
4–8 个步骤
useWhenEn: A process across roles, a handoff
4–8 steps
avoidWhen: 只有一个角色：用 StepTrack
要表达长期分工：用 Lanes
avoidWhenEn: Only one role: use StepTrack
You need long-term role division: use Lanes

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <Swimlane kicker="分工" title="…" lanes={['作者', 'AI 助手', '检查脚本']} steps={[{ lane: 0, text: '给出事实和出处' }, …]} />

name: 架构分层图
role: 机制 · 系统由哪几层组成
roleEn: Mechanism · which layers make up the system
summary: 3–5 条横向分层，左边层名和等宽标签，右边一排组件块；可以高亮一层。
summaryEn: 3–5 horizontal layers; the layer name and a mono tag sit on the left, a row of component blocks on the right. One layer can be highlighted.
useWhen: 软件架构、组织层级、技术栈
每层有 2–5 个组成部分
useWhenEn: Software architecture, org levels, tech stack
Each layer has 2–5 parts
avoidWhen: 层与层之间是包含关系：用 Concentric
要讲数据怎么流动：用 FlowDiagram
avoidWhenEn: Layers contain one another: use Concentric
Explaining how data flows: use FlowDiagram
limits: layers 3–5 层：name ≤ 8 字，tag ≤ 16 字符，items 2–5 个各 ≤ 10 字符
limitsEn: layers 3–5: name ≤ 8 chars, tag ≤ 16 characters, items 2–5 each ≤ 10 characters

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: layers
props.note: 从最靠近用户的一层写起
props.noteEn: Start from the layer closest to the user

example: <ArchLayers kicker="架构" title="…" focus={0} layers={[{ name: '演示', tag: 'src/decks', items: ['index.tsx'] }, …]} />

name: 优缺点天平
role: 论证 · 两边权衡
summary: 一架天平，两个秤盘各写一组理由，重的一边下沉；秤盘始终竖直下垂。倾斜角由 weight 算出，没有测量依据时要在 source 里标明是示意。
summaryEn: A balance with a set of reasons on each pan; the heavier pan sinks and the pans always hang vertically. The tilt angle comes from weight, so mark the tilt as illustrative in source when there is no measurement.
useWhen: 优缺点、成本与收益、取舍
想表达哪边更重
useWhenEn: Pros and cons, cost and benefit, trade-offs
Showing which side weighs more
avoidWhen: 要逐项对比属性：用 CompareTable
两边分量没有依据又不愿标示意
avoidWhenEn: Comparing attributes item by item: use CompareTable
The two sides have no basis and you do not want to mark the tilt illustrative
limits: left / right：label ≤ 6 字，items 1–3 条各 ≤ 14 字
limitsEn: left / right: label ≤ 6 chars, items 1–3 each ≤ 14 chars
weight only sets the tilt, 9° at most

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <Balance kicker="取舍" title="…" left={{ label: '代价', items: ['…'], weight: 1 }} right={{ label: '好处', items: ['…'], weight: 2 }} source="…；天平倾斜是示意" />

role: 对比 · 两组对象经过同样的阶段
roleEn: Comparison · two groups going through the same stages

summaryEn: Two funnels back to back, the stage names in a middle column, each side's bars scaled by value, with the percentage relative to the first stage.

3–5 个相同的阶段
useWhenEn: Conversion comparison of two groups or two versions
3–5 identical stages
avoidWhen: 只有一组：用 Funnel
阶段不同：分两页
avoidWhenEn: Only one group: use Funnel
Different stages: split into two slides
limits: values 与 stages 一一对应、逐级不增
limitsEn: values match stages one to one and never increase

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <DoubleFunnel kicker="对比" title="…" unit="页" stages={['全部页面', '写了出处', '出处 + 逐条展开']} left={{ name: 'GEO 演示', values: [31, 24, 4] }} right={{ name: 'GTM 演示', values: [30, 23, 10] }} />

name: 渐变标题揭幕

一句话就是主题
useWhenEn: Launch openings, new version reveals
One sentence is the whole theme
avoidWhen: 需要解释细节：用 Cover
句子超过 16 字：用 Statement
avoidWhenEn: Details need explaining: use Cover
The sentence is longer than 16 chars: use Statement
limits: marks 0–2 个，必须是 title 里的子串
facts 0–3 个：value ≤ 6 字符，label ≤ 10 字
limitsEn: marks 0–2, must be substrings of title

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

summary: 一个占满半页的渐变大数字加单位，上方一句观点，下方一句说明和最多 3 个小规格。

useWhen: 产品规格、关键指标
一个数字就是论点
useWhenEn: Product specs, key metrics
One number is the argument

要看变化：用 CountCompare
avoidWhenEn: Comparing several numbers: use StatRow
Showing change: use CountCompare
limits: specs 0–3 个：value ≤ 7 字符，label ≤ 12 字

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

name: 渐变光球封面

有 2–3 个代表数字

There are 2–3 representative numbers
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
只有一个数字：用 FloatCover
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
Only one number: use FloatCover
limits: chips 2–3 个：value ≤ 6 字符，label ≤ 10 字

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

One or two sentences for each item

超过 3 项：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: Order matters: use StepTrack
More than 3 items: use IconGrid

limitsEn: items exactly 3: title ≤ 10 chars, body 24–48 chars, tag ≤ 18 characters

props.name: title

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars
