name: 色块数字格
role: 数据 · 3–4 个硬指标
summary: 3–4 块饱和色块，粗黑描边加硬投影，略微歪斜，每块一个窄体大数字、标签和一句说明。第一块用主题色。
summaryEn: 3–4 saturated blocks with a thick black outline, hard shadow and slight tilt; each block has a large condensed number, a label and one note. The first block uses the theme colour.
useWhen: 3–4 个同样重要的数字
营销、规则宣讲
useWhenEn: 3–4 numbers of equal importance
Marketing, rule walkthroughs
avoidWhen: 要比较大小：用 MetricBars
只有一个数字：用 BigStat
avoidWhenEn: Comparing sizes: use MetricBars
Only one number: use BigStat
limits: stats 3–4 个：value ≤ 5 字符，unit ≤ 3 字符，label ≤ 8 字，note ≤ 24 字
limitsEn: stats 3–4: value ≤ 5 characters, unit ≤ 3 characters, label ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 24 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <BlockStats kicker="硬指标" title="…" stats={[{ value: '17', unit: 'u', label: '最小字号', note: '…' }, …]} />

name: 波普标语海报
role: 开场 / 停顿 · 一句口号
summary: 两三行超大粗体标语，一个词装进歪斜的色块框，右上角一枚圆形贴纸数字，底部一排描边小标签。
summaryEn: Two or three lines of oversized bold slogan, one word inside a tilted colour block, a round sticker number in the top right corner and a row of outlined tags at the bottom.
useWhen: 封面、口号、规则宣讲
一句话里有一个关键词
useWhenEn: Cover, slogan, rule walkthrough
One keyword in the sentence
avoidWhen: 需要论证：用 Statement
句子超过 14 字
avoidWhenEn: You need to argue: use Statement
The sentence is longer than 14 chars
limits: mark 必须是 title 里的子串
limitsEn: mark must be a substring of title

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <PopPoster kicker="交付规则" title={['不出 PASS，', '就不交付']} mark="PASS" badge={{ value: '4', label: '种窗口' }} />

name: 格子全貌
role: 总览 · 一页说清全貌
roleEn: Overview · the whole picture on one slide
summary: 六个大小不一的白色方块：左上大格放标题和导语，右边两格数字、一格竖排文字，底部一格横排图标，右下一格强调色数字。和可展开的 Bento 不同，它是静态的一页总览。
summaryEn: Six white blocks of different sizes: a large block top left for the title and lead, two number blocks and one vertical text block on the right, a horizontal icon block at the bottom and an accent-colour number block bottom right. Unlike the expandable Bento, it is a static one-slide overview.
useWhen: 产品或项目的一页总览
有 3 个数字、一句规则和 4–6 个功能点
useWhenEn: A one-slide overview of a product or project
There are 3 numbers, one rule and 4–6 feature points
avoidWhen: 要点击展开详情：用 Bento
只有一个数字：用 BigStat
avoidWhenEn: Details open on click: use Bento
Only one number: use BigStat
limits: stats 正好 3 个：label ≤ 14 字符，value ≤ 6 字符，unit ≤ 4 字符，note ≤ 20 字
limitsEn: stats exactly 3: label ≤ 14 characters, value ≤ 6 characters, unit ≤ 4 characters, note ≤ 20 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines manually with an array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: stats
props.note: 三个数字格，最后一个用强调色
props.noteEn: Three number blocks, the last one in the accent colour

example: <BentoBoard kicker="全貌" title={['一个文件，', '装下整份演示']} stats={[{ label: 'TEMPLATES', value: '251', unit: '个', note: '…' }, …]} note={{ label: 'RULE', text: '…' }} chips={{ label: 'KEYS', items: [{ icon: 'monitor', label: '全屏 F' }, …] }} />

name: 格子聚焦
role: 说明 · 一个功能讲透
roleEn: Note · one feature explained in full
summary: 标题下一组格子：左边高格是图标、标题和说明，右上两格数字，右下宽格是等宽字的键值行。
summaryEn: A set of blocks under the title: a tall block on the left with icon, title and text, two number blocks top right and a wide block bottom right with mono key-value rows.
useWhen: 介绍一个功能、一个文件、一条命令
有两个关键数字和 3–4 行键值
useWhenEn: Introducing one feature, one file, one command
Two key numbers and 3–4 key-value rows
avoidWhen: 多个并列功能：用 IconGrid
数字是主角：用 StatRow
avoidWhenEn: Several parallel features: use IconGrid
The numbers are the point: use StatRow
limits: cells 正好 2 个：value ≤ 8 字符，note ≤ 18 字
rows.items 3–4 行：k ≤ 16 字符，v ≤ 22 字
limitsEn: cells exactly 2: value ≤ 8 characters, note ≤ 18 chars
rows.items 3–4 rows: k ≤ 16 characters, v ≤ 22 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: cells
props.note: 两个数字格，第一个用强调色
props.noteEn: Two number blocks, the first in the accent colour

example: <BentoSpotlight kicker="构建" title="断网也能放映" hero={{ icon: 'file-check', label: 'dist/index.html', title: '一个离线文件', text: '…' }} cells={[…]} rows={{ label: 'NPM SCRIPTS', items: [{ k: 'npm run check', v: '…' }] }} />

name: 日历时间段
role: 安排 · 日期与时间段
summary: 左边标题，右边一张预约卡：月历标出可选日期，右栏是当天的时间段。日期和时间段都能点击切换。
summaryEn: Title on the left, a booking card on the right: a month calendar marks the available dates and the right column lists that day's time slots. Both dates and time slots switch on click.
useWhen: 评审、培训、答疑这类要约时间的安排
轻柔风格里放一个产品感的小界面
useWhenEn: Scheduling a review, training or Q&A session
A small product-style interface in the soft style
avoidWhen: 真实的长期排期：用 Gantt 或 Timeline
日期不是真的又没标示意
avoidWhenEn: A real long-term schedule: use Gantt or Timeline
The dates are not real and are not marked illustrative
limits: month ≤ 10 字符，days 28–31，start 为 1 号是周几（周一 = 0）
slots 3–5 个：time ≤ 8 字符，note ≤ 8 字
不是真实日程时 source 写“示意”
limitsEn: month ≤ 10 characters, days 28–31, start is the weekday of the 1st (Monday = 0)
when the schedule is not real, write illustrative in source
example: <SlotPicker kicker="评审" title={['约个时间，', '一起逐页看截图']} card={{ title: '截图评审', meta: '30 分钟' }} month="2026 年 11 月" start={6} days={30} open={[3, 4, 5]} day={4} slots={[{ time: '10:00', note: '上午' }, …]} source="示意" />

name: 小界面步骤卡
role: 操作 · 三步上手
roleEn: Procedure · getting started in three steps
summary: 三张圆角步骤卡，每张上半是一个小界面（输入框、选项胶囊或完成提示），下半是步骤号、标题和说明。
summaryEn: Three rounded step cards; the top half of each is a small interface (input field, option pills or a done message) and the bottom half holds the step number, title and text.
useWhen: 上手、设置、新建这类三步流程
每一步都能画成一个简单的界面动作
useWhenEn: Three-step flows such as setup, onboarding or creating something
Each step can be drawn as a simple interface action
avoidWhen: 步骤带命令且超过 3 步：用 StepTrack
步骤没有先后：用 NumberedColumns
avoidWhenEn: Steps carry commands and there are more than 3: use StepTrack
The steps have no order: use NumberedColumns
limits: steps 正好 3 步：title ≤ 8 字，text ≤ 36 字
ui: field（label ≤ 10 字，value ≤ 24 字符）/ options（2–4 个，各 ≤ 8 字符）/ done（≤ 14 字）
limitsEn: steps exactly 3: title ≤ 8 chars, text ≤ 36 chars
ui: field (label ≤ 10 chars, value ≤ 24 characters) / options (2–4, each ≤ 8 characters) / done (≤ 14 chars)

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <UiSteps kicker="新建演示" title="三步，从空目录到 PASS" steps={[{ title: '建目录', text: '…', ui: { kind: 'field', label: '演示文件', value: 'src/decks/demo/index.tsx' } }, …]} />

name: 浮动标签封面
role: 开场 · 产品或功能第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · slide 1 for a product or feature
summary: 居中的安静大标题和导语，下面一张带声波的小卡片，四周漂着 4–6 个略微倾斜的图标标签。
summaryEn: A quiet centred title and lead, a small card with a waveform below, and 4–6 slightly tilted icon tags floating around.
useWhen: AI、语音、工具类产品的开场
有 4–6 个能用一个词说清的功能
useWhenEn: Openings for AI, voice or tool products
4–6 features each describable in one word
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
功能需要解释：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
Features need explaining: use IconGrid
example: <FloatHero kicker="第 4 期 · 浮窗风格" title={['讲的时候，', '只管往下讲']} lead="…" chips={[{ icon: 'monitor', label: '全屏 F' }, …]} card={{ label: 'AUTOPLAY', text: '每 8 秒前进一步' }} />

name: 讲稿卡片
role: 引述 · 一段对话或讲解
roleEn: Citation · a stretch of dialogue or narration
summary: 左边标题，右边一张带声波的讲稿卡，3–4 行发言，其中一行高亮，卡片边上漂着 2–3 个小标签。
summaryEn: Title on the left, a transcript card with a waveform on the right, 3–4 spoken lines with one highlighted, and 2–3 small tags floating beside the card.
useWhen: 引用一段录音、访谈或讲解
想让听众注意其中一句
useWhenEn: Quoting a recording, interview or narration
You want listeners to notice one line
avoidWhen: 只有一句引语：用 QuoteHero
讲稿是编的又没标示意
avoidWhenEn: Only one quotation: use QuoteHero
The transcript is made up and not marked illustrative
limits: lines 3–4 行：who ≤ 6 字，time ≤ 6 字符，text ≤ 34 字
不是真实录音时 source 写“示意”
limitsEn: lines 3–4: who ≤ 6 chars, time ≤ 6 characters, text ≤ 34 chars
when the recording is not real, write illustrative in source

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <TranscriptCard kicker="逐条展开" title={['讲到哪一条，', '就亮到哪一条']} file="讲稿 · 第 5 页" meta="00:24" focus={1} lines={[{ who: '讲者', time: '00:00', text: '…' }, …]} tags={[{ icon: 'keyboard', label: '→ / Space' }]} source="讲稿为示意" />

name: 复古标签窗
role: 分组 · 2–4 组并列清单
summary: 左边标题，右边一个粗黑边框的老式窗口，顶部是可点击的文件夹标签，每个标签里 3–4 行图标条目。
summaryEn: Title on the left, an old-style window with a thick black border on the right, clickable folder tabs along the top and 3–4 icon rows inside each tab.
useWhen: 按角色、阶段、场景分组的清单
现场点标签逐组讲
useWhenEn: Lists grouped by role, stage or scenario
Clicking through the tabs live, group by group
avoidWhen: 只有一组：用 IconGrid
截图时只能看到第一个标签，关键内容放在第一组
avoidWhenEn: Only one group: use IconGrid
A screenshot shows only the first tab, so put the key content in the first group
limits: 每组 rows 3–4 行：title ≤ 10 字，note ≤ 26 字
limitsEn: rows 3–4 per group: title ≤ 10 chars, note ≤ 26 chars
example: <RetroTabs kicker="分工" title={['点开标签，', '看每一步做什么']} file="WORKFLOW.EXE" tabs={[{ label: '写演示', rows: [{ icon: 'folder', title: '新建目录', note: '…' }, …] }, …]} />

name: 复古更新日志
role: 回顾 · 版本或阶段变化
summary: 一个老式窗口里的更新日志：版本、标签、一句说明，最新一条标签用强调色；旁边斜贴一个便签小窗口。
summaryEn: A changelog inside an old-style window: version, tag and one line each, with the newest tag in the accent colour; a small sticky note window sits at an angle beside it.
useWhen: 版本更新、阶段回顾
每一条一句话能说清
useWhenEn: Version updates, stage recaps
One sentence per entry
avoidWhen: 要按真实时间比例：用 Timeline
每条要多段说明：用 Milestones
avoidWhenEn: Needs a true time scale: use Timeline
Several paragraphs per entry: use Milestones
limits: entries 4–6 条，最新在前：ver ≤ 10 字符，tag ≤ 6 字，text ≤ 30 字
note.title ≤ 10 字符，lines 2–3 行各 ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: entries 4–6, newest first: ver ≤ 10 characters, tag ≤ 6 chars, text ≤ 30 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <RetroLog kicker="更新日志" title="四期下来，模板从 67 到 103" file="CHANGELOG.txt" entries={[{ ver: '第 4 期', tag: '风格', text: '…' }, …]} note={{ title: 'NOTE.txt', lines: ['风格只换外观', '…'] }} />

name: 发光大数字
role: 数据 · 一个核心数字加三个旁证
roleEn: Data · one core number and three supporting numbers
summary: 左边标题和导语，右边一个衬线斜体的超大数字浮在暖色光晕上，下方细线分隔的一行三个辅助数字。暖夜风格的招牌数据页。
summaryEn: Title and lead on the left; on the right a huge serif italic number floating on a warm glow, with a hairline-separated row of three supporting numbers below. The signature data slide of the warm dark style.
useWhen: 有一个最想让人记住的数字
还有 3 个支撑它的数字
useWhenEn: One number you most want people to remember
3 more numbers that support it
avoidWhen: 数字要对比：用 CountCompare
没有旁证：用 BigStat
avoidWhenEn: Numbers need comparing: use CountCompare
No supporting numbers: use BigStat
limits: figure ≤ 5 个字符，unit ≤ 4 个字符
subs 正好 3 个：value ≤ 8 个字符，label ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: subs exactly 3: value ≤ 8 characters, label ≤ 16 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: subs
props.noteEn: Three supporting numbers at the bottom

example: <GlowMetric kicker="交付物" title={['整份演示，', '只有一个文件']} figure="6.1" unit="MB" caption="单文件构建的大小" subs={[{ value: '3.6 MB', label: '其中是内嵌字体' }, …]} />

name: 细线功能格
role: 并列 · 4 或 6 个功能
summary: 标题下方 1px 细线分成 2×2 或 3×2 的格子，每格图标、等宽小标签、标题和一句说明；焦点格底部透出暖光。
summaryEn: 1px hairlines under the title split the area into 2×2 or 3×2 cells; each cell has an icon, a mono tag, a title and one note, and warm light glows from the bottom of the focused cell.
useWhen: 4 或 6 个并列的功能、字段、能力
其中一项最重要
useWhenEn: 4 or 6 parallel features, fields or capabilities
One of them matters most
avoidWhen: 每项一个词就够：用 TileWall
要讲先后：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: One word per item is enough: use TileWall
Order matters: use StepTrack
limits: items 4 或 6 个：title ≤ 10 字，body 18–40 字，tag ≤ 16 个字符
limitsEn: items 4 or 6: title ≤ 10 chars, body 18–40 chars, tag ≤ 16 characters

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <HairlineGrid kicker="六个开关" title="一份演示，六个字段定风格" items={[{ icon: 'tuning', title: '风格', tag: 'DeckDef.style', body: '…' }, …]} />

name: 彩带封面
role: 开场 · 活动、培训第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · slide 1 for events and training
summary: 左上角超大圆润标题，右下方蓝色和黑色两条粗彩带斜着交叉，带上重复一个词，再加一条细的青柠色彩带。
summaryEn: An oversized rounded title top left; two thick ribbons, one blue and one black, cross at an angle in the lower right and repeat one word, plus a thin lime ribbon.
useWhen: 培训、活动、对外介绍的封面
想要热闹友好的开场
useWhenEn: Covers for training, events and external introductions
A lively, friendly opening
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
要放数字：用 FloatCover
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
Numbers to show: use FloatCover
limits: band、band2 ≤ 12 个字符，只重复页面上已有的词
limitsEn: band, band2 ≤ 12 characters, only repeat words already on the slide

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: band
props.noteEn: Word repeated on the main ribbon

props.name: band2
props.note: 黑色彩带上的词，默认同 band
props.noteEn: Word on the black ribbon, defaults to band

example: <RibbonCover kicker="第 4 期 · 彩带风格" title={['做演示，', '先守住规则']} band="PCAFE" band2="PASS" />

name: 彩带章节页
role: 节奏 · 每章第一页
roleEn: Rhythm · first slide of each chapter
summary: 一条宽阔的强调色彩带斜穿画面，带上是章节编号圆章和章节标题；下方左边导语，右边本章各页标题。
summaryEn: A wide accent-colour ribbon runs across the slide at an angle, holding the chapter number badge and the chapter title; below it the lead on the left and this chapter's slide titles on the right.
useWhen: 分章的演示，每章开头
彩带风格里替代 SectionBreak
useWhenEn: Chaptered decks, at the start of each chapter
Stands in for SectionBreak in the ribbon style
avoidWhen: 不分章的短演示
需要深色页：用 SectionBreak
avoidWhenEn: Short decks without chapters
A dark slide is needed: use SectionBreak
limits: 没有 source：章节页不陈述事实
limitsEn: no source: a section break states no facts

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Chapter title on the ribbon; the slide title also accepts an array to break lines

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Chapter title on the ribbon; the slide title also accepts an array to break lines

example: <RibbonSection kicker="第一章" index={1} title="按顺序做" contents={['四个关键步骤', '六条文案规则']} />

name: 聊天问答
role: 问答 · 3–6 条对话
summary: 左边标题、导语和一条手绘波浪箭头，右边一串聊天气泡：提问在左、白色；回答在右、强调色。每条气泡是一个展开步骤。
summaryEn: Title, lead and a hand-drawn wavy arrow on the left, a column of chat bubbles on the right: questions on the left in white, answers on the right in the accent colour. Each bubble is one build step.
useWhen: 新手常见问题、用户提问
想让问答读起来像对话
useWhenEn: Beginner questions, user questions
Making Q&A read like a conversation
avoidWhen: 问题超过 3 个且要标出处：用 Faq
回答很长
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 questions that need sources: use Faq
The answers are long
limits: messages 3–6 条：提问 ≤ 24 字，回答 ≤ 44 字

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: names
props.note: 两边的名字，默认 提问 / 回答
props.noteEn: Names for the two sides, default Question / Answer

example: <ChatThread kicker="新手问答" title={['第一次上手，', '先问这三句']} messages={[{ from: 'q', text: '新演示放在哪里？' }, { from: 'a', text: '…' }]} />

name: 歪斜便签
role: 并列 · 3–4 条规则或提示
summary: 3–4 张糖果色便签，各自轻微歪斜，顶上贴一条胶带；每张一个图标、标题和一句说明。
summaryEn: 3–4 candy-coloured sticky notes, each slightly tilted with a strip of tape on top; each has an icon, a title and one line of text.
useWhen: 3–4 条规则、小贴士、注意事项
轻松的分享会
useWhenEn: 3–4 rules, tips or cautions
A relaxed share-out session
avoidWhen: 正式场合：用 NumberedColumns
超过 4 项：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: Formal setting: use NumberedColumns
More than 4 items: use IconGrid

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

example: <NoteCards kicker="视觉规则" title="模板做好的事，别去破坏" notes={[{ icon: 'code', title: '不写 CSS', body: '…' }, …]} />

name: 逐字金句
role: 停顿 · 一句要被记住的话
roleEn: Pause · one line to be remembered
summary: 页面中间一句大字，进入时一个字一个字从下往上浮现（拉丁单词整体出现），之后淡入一行小字。读屏软件读到的是整句。
summaryEn: One large line in the centre of the slide; on entry each character rises from below one by one (Latin words appear whole), then a small line fades in. Screen readers read the whole sentence.
useWhen: 整份演示里最想让人记住的一句话
章节之间的停顿页
useWhenEn: The one line of the deck you most want remembered
A pause slide between chapters
avoidWhen: 一份演示用超过两次
句子需要强调词或图标：用 Statement
avoidWhenEn: More than twice in one deck
The sentence needs emphasis or an icon: use Statement
limits: text ≤ 24 字；分行时 ≤ 2 行 × 12 字
limitsEn: text ≤ 24 chars; when split, ≤ 2 lines × 12 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: text
props.note: 逐字出现的句子，数组即分行
props.noteEn: The sentence that appears character by character, an array splits the lines

props.name: sub
props.note: 句子之后淡入的一行小字
props.noteEn: A small line that fades in after the sentence

example:
<RevealStatement
  kicker="一句话"
  text={['把演示做成', '一个单文件 HTML']}
  sub="离线打开，不需要网络。"
/>

name: 画板封面
role: 开场 · 产品主页或作品集第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · slide 1 for a product home page or portfolio
summary: 一块虹彩大圆角面板，居中两行衬线大标题，第一行的关键词压在倾斜的橙色标签里；下方一张点阵画板，上面用橙笔圈出一行字；面板底部一排红点胶囊。
summaryEn: A large iridescent rounded panel with a two-line serif title in the centre, the keyword of the first line pressed into a tilted orange tag; below it a dotted drawing board with one line circled in orange pen, and a row of red dot pills at the bottom of the panel.
useWhen: 产品主页、工具介绍、个人作品集的开场
有一行能“写在画板上”的命令或口号
useWhenEn: Openings for a product home page, tool introduction or portfolio
There is a command or slogan that can be written on the board
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
标题没有一个能单独压进标签的词：用 HangingCover
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
No word in the title can sit alone in the tag: use HangingCover
limitsEn: pre ≤ 6 chars, tag ≤ 4 chars, line ≤ 12 chars
write source when there are facts

props.name: pre
props.noteEn: Text before the tag on the first line

props.name: tag
props.noteEn: Word pressed into the orange tag

props.name: canvas
props.noteEn: The circled line on the drawing board

example: <SketchCover kicker="开源 · CPAL-1.0" pre="让 AI 做" tag="演示" line="每一页都整整齐齐" lead="…" canvas="npx @pcafe/pcafe init my-talk" chips={['251 个模板', '33 种风格', '自动 QA']} source="…" />

name: 弧形深色卡
role: 并列 · 五个同等重要的机制或服务
roleEn: Parallel · five equally important mechanisms or services
summary: 居中的衬线标题，下面五张深色卡片沿一条浅弧排开，两端向内倾斜；每张卡片有一个装在橙色角框里的图标、标题和一句说明。设 build 后逐张出现。
summaryEn: A centred serif title, with five dark cards along a shallow arc below, tilted inward at both ends. Each card holds an icon in an orange corner frame, a title and one line of text. With a build step, they appear one by one.
useWhen: 正好 5 个并列的机制、服务或功能
每项一句话说得清
useWhenEn: Exactly 5 parallel mechanisms, services or features
Each one fits in a single sentence
avoidWhen: 3–4 项：用 NumberedColumns
6–8 项：用 IconGrid
各项有先后：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: 3–4 items: use NumberedColumns
6–8 items: use IconGrid
The items have an order: use StepTrack
limits: cards 正好 5 张：title ≤ 8 字，text 16–34 字
limitsEn: cards exactly 5: title ≤ 8 chars, text 16–34 chars
Icons do not repeat on one slide

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

example: <ArcCards kicker="怎么做到" title="五条规则，管住每一页" cards={[{ icon: 'layers', title: '固定模板', text: '…' }, …]} />

name: 案例卡
role: 证据 · 一个项目或功能配一张真实截图
roleEn: Evidence · one project or feature with a real screenshot
summary: 一张白色大圆角卡片：左边衬线标题、一段说明和底部灰色小标签；右边一张真实截图，截图下方一条深色跑马灯，写着项目关键词。
summaryEn: One large white rounded card: a serif title, a paragraph and small grey tags at the bottom left; a real screenshot on the right, with a dark ticker under it carrying the project keywords.
useWhen: 用一张真实截图展示一个功能、项目或成果
作品集、案例研究
useWhenEn: Show one feature, project or result with a real screenshot
Portfolio, case study
avoidWhen: 截图需要标注细节：用 Screenshot
多个视图切换：用 TabbedShot
没有真实截图
avoidWhenEn: The screenshot needs callouts: use Screenshot
Switching between several views: use TabbedShot
You have no real screenshot
limitsEn: image must be a real screenshot

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

example: <CaseCard kicker="模板库" title={['251 个模板，', '先看再选']} lead="…" image={shotKit} alt="组件库页面截图" tags={['#/kit', '33 种风格']} ticker={['TEMPLATES', 'STYLES']} />

name: 增长官网首屏
role: 开场 · 产品或方案第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · slide 1 for a product or proposal
summary: 顶部一枚荧光绿小徽章，左边两三行超大紧排黑字（可嵌彩色图标方块），左下黑色状态胶囊，右下导语加胶囊按钮，底部一排淡色名称。
summaryEn: A small neon-green badge on top, two or three tight oversized black lines on the left that may embed coloured icon squares, a black status pill at bottom left, a lead with pill buttons at bottom right, and a row of light names along the bottom.
useWhen: 产品官网式的开场
营销方案、增长提案的封面
useWhenEn: A product-site style opening
Cover for a marketing or growth proposal
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
要放大数字：用 NumberOpener
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
Large numbers to show: use NumberOpener
limits: lines 2–3 行，每行 ≤ 7 字（或 12 个字母），最多 2 行带 icon
actions 1–2 个，每个 ≤ 10 个字符
names 0–6 个，只写文字；namesLabel ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: lines 2–3, each ≤ 7 chars (or 12 letters), at most 2 lines with an icon

props.name: actions
props.note: 胶囊按钮文字，第一个实心
props.noteEn: Pill button labels, the first one solid

example: <AgencyHero badge="开源 · CPAL-1.0" lines={[{ text: '让 AI 做的', icon: 'magic' }, { text: '幻灯片' }]} tag="HTML 演示引擎" lead="…" actions={['开始使用', 'GitHub']} />

name: 编号服务行
role: 内容 · 4–5 件事，一行一件
summary: 大标题配右侧描边胶囊，下面细线分隔的编号行：编号、粗体标题、灰色短注、彩色图标方块和圆形加号。
summaryEn: A big title with an outlined pill on the right, then numbered rows divided by hairlines: number, bold title, short grey note, coloured icon square and a round plus.
useWhen: 我们做什么、做法有哪几条
每项一句标题加一句短注
useWhenEn: What we do, or which practices we follow
Each item is one title plus one short note
avoidWhen: 每项要两句以上：用 NumberedColumns
有先后步骤：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: Each item needs two or more sentences: use NumberedColumns
There are steps in order: use StepTrack
limitsEn: items 4–5 rows: title ≤ 14 chars, note ≤ 22 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; pass an array to break lines manually

example: <AgencyRows kicker="01 做法" title={['模板管排版，', 'AI 只管内容']} items={[{ title: '只组合现成模板', note: '…', icon: 'widget' }, …]} />

name: 观点大段落
role: 节奏 · 一段观点
roleEn: Rhythm · one paragraph of a position
summary: 一枚灰色小胶囊标签，下面一整段超大紧排粗体文字，左侧缩进，0–2 个词用强调色。
summaryEn: A small grey pill label, then a full block of tight oversized bold text, indented on the left, with 0–2 words in the accent colour.
useWhen: 讲问题或立场，一句话说不完
两段密集内容之间的停顿
useWhenEn: State a problem or a position that one line cannot cover
A pause between two dense blocks
avoidWhen: 只有一句短话：用 Statement
有出处的引语：用 QuoteHero
avoidWhenEn: Only one short line: use Statement
A sourced quotation: use QuoteHero
limits: marks 0–2 个，必须是 text 里原样出现的子串
by 可选：name ≤ 8 字，role ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: marks 0–2, each must appear verbatim in text
by optional: name ≤ 8 chars, role ≤ 16 chars
example: <AgencyManifesto label="我们的看法" text="…" marks={['固定的版式']} />

name: 晕光大字封面
role: 开场 / 收尾 · 产品或品牌主页式第一页、最后一页
roleEn: Opening / closing · first or last slide in a product- or brand-home style
summary: 居中的两三行细体大字，第二行一个词换成斜体衬线，第一行末尾一枚条纹胶囊，第三行淡出；背后一团柔和的多色晕光。可加一条命令胶囊和链接做结尾。
summaryEn: Two or three centred light display lines; one word in line 2 turns italic serif; a striped pill sits at the end of line 1 and line 3 fades out; a soft multi-colour halo behind. Optionally a command pill and a link for the closing.
useWhen: 产品主页式的开场，一句价值主张
结尾页放一条上手命令和仓库地址
useWhenEn: Product-home style opening with one value statement
Closing slide with a command to start and the repo address
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Cover
要放关键数字：用 OrbCover 或 Cover
avoidWhenEn: Formal report: use Cover
Key numbers to show: use OrbCover or Cover
limits: lines 2–3 行，每行 ≤ 10 字；3 行时最后一行淡出
serif 必须是第 2 行里原样出现的子串，≤ 4 字
command ≤ 32 个字符，只写 ASCII；link ≤ 40 个字符
limitsEn: lines 2–3, each ≤ 10 chars; with 3 lines the last one fades out
serif must appear verbatim in line 2, ≤ 4 chars
command ≤ 32 characters, ASCII only; link ≤ 40 characters

props.name: kicker
props.noteEn: Small caps line above the title

props.name: serif
props.note: 第 2 行里换成斜体衬线的词
props.noteEn: Word in line 2 set in italic serif

props.name: link
props.noteEn: Link text next to the command

example: <HaloHero kicker="你好，这是 PCafe" lines={['让 AI 做演示', '每一页都整齐', '还能直接放映。']} serif="整齐" lead="…" />

name: 细线条目列表
role: 并列 · 3–6 个功能、规则或快捷键
summary: 左边小标签、标题和导语，右边一列细线分隔的条目：圆形描边图标、标题、右侧一行短说明和加号。
summaryEn: A small label, title and lead on the left; a column of hairline-separated items on the right: round outlined icon, title, one short line of detail and a plus.
useWhen: 3–6 条并列的功能、规则、快捷键
每条一个短标题加一句短说明
useWhenEn: 3–6 parallel features, rules or shortcuts
Each item is one short title plus one short line
avoidWhen: 每条要两句以上：用 NumberedColumns
有先后顺序：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: Each item needs two or more sentences: use NumberedColumns
There is an order: use StepTrack

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines by hand in the array

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two sentences of lead

example: <HaloRows kicker="放映" title={['讲的时候，', '工具都在键盘上']} items={[{ icon: 'presentation', title: '演讲者视图', detail: 'S：备注、计时、下一页' }, …]} />

name: 跑马灯作品页
role: 展示 · 两张截图或作品
roleEn: Showcase · two screenshots or pieces of work
summary: 一行超大字横向循环滚动，下面两张大图卡，每张配标题和灰色小标签。
summaryEn: One oversized line scrolling sideways in a loop, with two large image cards below, each with a title and small grey tags.
useWhen: 展示两张真实截图或作品
想要一个有动感的过渡展示页
useWhenEn: Show two real screenshots or pieces of work
A transition slide that should keep moving
avoidWhen: 截图需要标注：用 Screenshot
超过两项：用 WorkCards
avoidWhenEn: The screenshot needs callouts: use Screenshot
More than two items: use WorkCards
limits: items 正好 2 个：title ≤ 16 字，tags 1–3 个、每个 ≤ 8 字符
src 必须是真实截图或 decor- 装饰插图
limitsEn: items exactly 2: title ≤ 16 chars, tags 1–3 each ≤ 8 characters
src must be a real screenshot or a decor- illustration
example: <HaloMarquee kicker="模板与风格" band="挑一个模板" items={[{ src: shotKit, alt: '…', title: '…', tags: ['#/kit'] }, …]} />

name: 扇形截图封面
role: 开场 · 产品官网式第 1 页
summary: 整页饱和蓝（配 tone: accent），居中胶囊徽标、紧凑大标题和导语，两个带圆形箭头的胶囊按钮，底边升起一排扇形倾斜的截图卡。
summaryEn: A full page of saturated blue with tone: accent, a centred pill badge, a tight big title and lead, two pill buttons with round arrows, and a row of fan-tilted screenshot cards rising from the bottom edge.
useWhen: 产品、工具、开源项目的封面
有 3–5 张真实截图可以展示
useWhenEn: Cover for a product, tool or open-source project
You have 3–5 real screenshots to show
avoidWhen: 没有真实截图：用 OrbCover 或 Cover
正式汇报：用 Cover
avoidWhenEn: No real screenshots: use OrbCover or Cover
Formal report: use Cover
limits: actions 1–2 个，每个 ≤ 28 个字符
cards 3–5 张真实截图，宽高比约 16:10
limitsEn: cards 3–5 real screenshots, aspect ratio about 16:10

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines by hand in the array

props.name: actions
props.note: 胶囊按钮文字，第一个为白底实心
props.noteEn: Pill button labels, the first one solid white

example: <FanCover badge={{ icons: ['code', 'stars'], text: '开源 · CPAL-1.0' }} title={['让 AI 做的演示，', '每一页都整齐']} lead="…" actions={['npx @pcafe/pcafe init my-talk', 'GitHub 源码']} cards={[{ src: shot, alt: '…' }, …]} />

name: 嵌图长句
role: 观点 · 用一句大字讲清问题
roleEn: Point of view · one big line that states the problem
summary: 一整句超大左对齐文字，句中嵌 2–3 个带图标的彩色胶囊；底部两栏：左边一条小注，右边一段说明。
summaryEn: One full oversized left-aligned sentence with 2–3 coloured icon pills inside it; two columns at the bottom: a small note on the left and a line of text on the right.
useWhen: 开场后的问题页、立场页
一句话里有 2–3 个能用图标表示的关键词
useWhenEn: Problem or position slide after the opening
One line holds 2–3 keywords that icons can carry
avoidWhen: 句子很短、要居中停顿：用 Statement
有数据要比较：用图表模板
avoidWhenEn: The line is short and should sit centred as a pause: use Statement
Numbers to compare: use a chart template
limits: parts 文字合计 ≤ 44 字，图标胶囊 2–3 个，每个 1–2 个图标
limitsEn: parts ≤ 44 chars in total, 2–3 icon pills, each with 1–2 icons

props.name: parts
props.note: 句子片段与图标胶囊，按顺序排
props.noteEn: Sentence fragments and icon pills, in order

example: <PillSentence kicker="问题" parts={['常见的结果是', { icons: ['text'] }, '字号乱跳、', …]} note={{ label: '为什么', body: '…' }} aside="…" />

name: 展开列表
role: 清单 · 5–7 项功能或问答
summary: 左边标题、导语和一个胶囊按钮；右边细线分隔的列表，每行可带键帽和加号，其中一行展开显示说明。
summaryEn: Title, lead and one pill button on the left; a hairline-separated list on the right where each row may carry a keycap and a plus, and one row opens to show its answer.
useWhen: 快捷键、命令、功能清单
常见问题里只需要展开回答一题
useWhenEn: Shortcut, command or feature lists
A FAQ where only one answer needs to open
avoidWhen: 每项都要写说明：用 Faq
项目超过 7 个：拆页
avoidWhenEn: Every item needs an answer: use Faq
More than 7 items: split the slide
limits: title ≤ 2 行 × 6 字；lead ≤ 40 字；action ≤ 16 字
rows 5–7 行：key ≤ 8 个字符，q ≤ 16 字，展开行的 a ≤ 44 字
limitsEn: title ≤ 2 lines × 6 chars; lead ≤ 40 chars; action ≤ 16 chars
rows 5–7: key ≤ 8 characters, q ≤ 16 chars, a in the open row ≤ 44 chars

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines by hand in the array

example: <OpenList kicker="放映" title={['讲的时候，', '一个键就够']} rows={[{ key: 'S', q: '演讲者视图', a: '…' }, { key: 'L', q: '激光笔', a: '' }, …]} />

name: 照片封面
role: 开场 · 用一张图定调
roleEn: Opening · one image sets the tone
summary: 一张图铺满整页，暗角加左下渐变压暗，白色大标题、副题和一行元信息放在左下。图片缓慢推近。
summaryEn: One image fills the page, with a vignette and a gradient darkening the bottom left, where a white title, subtitle and one line of meta sit. The image pushes in slowly.
useWhen: 有一张能代表主题的氛围图：风景、场景、物件
公开演讲、科普、品牌故事的第一页
useWhenEn: You have an atmosphere image that carries the topic: landscape, scene, object
First slide of a talk, a science explainer or a brand story
avoidWhen: 没有合适的图：用 Cover
要在封面放数字和关键事实：用 Cover 或 NumberOpener
avoidWhenEn: No suitable image: use Cover
Numbers and key facts on the cover: use Cover or NumberOpener

props.name: image
props.note: import 进来的 decor- 插图或截图；credit 显示在右下
props.noteEn: Imported decor- illustration or screenshot; credit shows at bottom right

props.name: meta
props.noteEn: Small text at the bottom: duration, occasion

example: <PhotoCover image={{ src: reef, alt: '…', credit: '插图：AI 生成（示意）' }} kicker="海洋科普" title={['珊瑚礁：', '海里的城市']} sub="…" meta={['12 分钟']} />

name: 半图半文
role: 讲解 · 一张图配一段说明
roleEn: Explanation · one image with one block of text
summary: 一半是贴边的整幅图片（可放左或右），另一半是标题、导语和 0–3 条编号要点，要点逐条出现。
summaryEn: Half the page is a full-bleed image against the edge, left or right; the other half holds the title, lead and 0–3 numbered points that appear one by one.
useWhen: 介绍一个对象或概念，图片帮助理解
章节里节奏需要一张“透气”的页
useWhenEn: Introduce an object or concept where an image helps
A chapter needs a slide that breathes
avoidWhen: 图片是需要细看的截图：用 Screenshot 或 DeviceFrame
要点超过 3 条：拆页或用 NumberedColumns
avoidWhenEn: The image is a screenshot to read closely: use Screenshot or DeviceFrame
More than 3 points: split the slide or use NumberedColumns
limits: 有 lead 时 points ≤ 3 条，body 都写满时最好 ≤ 2 条
limitsEn: With a lead, use ≤ 3 points; when the bodies are full, prefer ≤ 2
interaction: build：要点逐条出现
interactionEn: build: points appear one by one

props.name: image
props.noteEn: A portrait or square image works better

props.name: side
props.note: 图片在哪一边，默认 left
props.noteEn: Which side the image is on, default left

props.name: points
props.note: 编号要点，每条一个 build 步骤
props.noteEn: Numbered points, one build step each

example: <PhotoSplit image={{ src: coral, alt: '…' }} side="left" kicker="先认识它" title={['珊瑚不是石头，', '是动物']} lead="…" points={[{ title: '水螅体', body: '…' }]} />

name: 照片拼格
role: 展示 · 3–5 张图一起看
summary: 标题下方一组不对称的图片网格，第一张占大格，其余错落排开，每张可带一个胶囊图注，逐张出现。
summaryEn: An asymmetric image grid below the title; the first image takes the large cell and the rest stagger around it, each with an optional pill caption, appearing one at a time.
useWhen: 展示一组同主题的场景、物种、作品
用图片给一个数字做气氛铺垫
useWhenEn: Show a set of scenes, species or work on one theme
Set the mood for a number with images
avoidWhen: 每张图都要配说明文字：用 PolaroidWall 或 PhotoStack
图片是界面截图：用 WindowStack
avoidWhenEn: Every image needs its own text: use PolaroidWall or PhotoStack
The images are interface screenshots: use WindowStack
limits: title ≤ 1 行 × 18 字或 2 行 × 10 字
第一张放最重要的图，它最大
limitsEn: title ≤ 1 line × 18 chars or 2 lines × 10 chars
The first tile holds the most important image and is the largest
interaction: build：图片逐张出现
interactionEn: build: images appear one by one

props.name: tiles
props.note: 3–5 张图，每张一个 build 步骤

example: <PhotoMosaic kicker="生物多样性" title="不到 1% 的海底，约 25% 的物种" tiles={[{ image: { src: fish, alt: '…' }, caption: '鱼群' }, …]} />

name: 拍立得墙
role: 展示 · 几张图各配一句话
roleEn: Showcase · a few images each with one line
summary: 3–5 张方形拍立得排成一排，每张略带旋转、顶部贴胶带，下面一行衬线斜体手记，逐张贴上。
summaryEn: 3–5 square instant photos in a row, each slightly rotated with tape at the top and one line of serif italic handwriting below, stuck up one at a time.
useWhen: 列举 3–5 个用途、地点、回忆，每个用一张图一句话
轻松、讲故事的语气
useWhenEn: List 3–5 uses, places or memories, one image and one line each
A light, storytelling tone
avoidWhen: 严肃的数据汇报
每项需要超过 10 字说明：用 PhotoStack
avoidWhenEn: A serious data report
Each item needs more than 10 chars: use PhotoStack
interaction: build：拍立得逐张出现
interactionEn: build: the photos appear one by one

props.name: items
props.note: 拍立得，每张一个 build 步骤
props.noteEn: Instant photos, each one build step

example: <PolaroidWall kicker="价值" title="…" items={[{ image: { src: fish, alt: '…' }, note: '渔获与食物' }, …]} />

name: 胶片条
role: 时间线 · 3–5 个节点配图
summary: 一条黑色底片横贯页面，上下有齿孔，每格一张图并在角上印年份；格子下方是编号说明。未出现的格子像未显影的底片。
summaryEn: A black film strip runs across the page with sprocket holes above and below; each frame holds an image with the year printed in its corner, and a numbered caption sits below. Frames not yet shown look undeveloped.
useWhen: 按时间或步骤排列的 3–5 个节点，每个都有一张图
回顾、历史、演变
useWhenEn: 3–5 points in time or step order, each with an image
Recap, history, evolution
avoidWhen: 节点超过 5 个：用 Timeline
没有配图：用 Milestones
avoidWhenEn: More than 5 points: use Timeline
No images: use Milestones
limits: frames 3–5 格：label ≤ 8 字，mark ≤ 6 个字符
interaction: build：每一格“显影”并显示说明
interactionEn: build: each frame develops and shows its caption

props.name: frames
props.note: 底片格，图片和说明同一步出现
props.noteEn: Film frames; image and caption appear in the same step

example: <FilmStrip kicker="时间线" title="四次全球白化" frames={[{ image: { src: a, alt: '…' }, label: '约 21% 的礁区', mark: '1998' }, …]} />

name: 杂志跨页
role: 讲解 · 一段需要读的文字
roleEn: Explanation · one block of text to read
summary: 左半页整幅图片，中缝有阴影；右半页是大标题、导语（下有粗线）、首字下沉的正文和一段引语，底部有页脚和出处。
summaryEn: A full image on the left half with a shadow at the gutter; the right half holds the big title, a standfirst over a thick rule, body text with a drop cap and a pull quote, with a folio and source at the bottom.
useWhen: 解释一个概念、讲一段故事，需要两段正文
编辑风格、科普和专题
useWhenEn: Explain a concept or tell a story that needs two paragraphs of body text
Editorial style, explainers and features
avoidWhen: 要点能列成条目：用 PhotoSplit
正文超过 150 字：拆页
avoidWhenEn: The points can be listed: use PhotoSplit
Body over 150 chars: split the slide
interaction: build：引语最后出现
interactionEn: build: the pull quote appears last

props.name: body
props.note: 正文段落，第一段首字下沉
props.noteEn: Body paragraphs, the first one with a drop cap

props.name: pull
props.note: 右栏引语，一个 build 步骤
props.noteEn: Pull quote in the right column, one build step

props.name: folio
props.note: 页脚，如“专题 · 第 6 页”

example: <MagazineSpread image={{ src: polyp, alt: '…' }} kicker="专题" title={['珊瑚为什么', '会变白']} standfirst="…" body={['…', '…']} pull="…" />

name: 案例卡
role: 证据 · 一个案例三个数
roleEn: Evidence · one case with three numbers
summary: 左边一张大圆角主图，右边标题、标签、一段简介，底部三个指标卡逐个出现。
summaryEn: A large rounded hero image on the left; on the right a title, tags and a short intro, with three metric cards at the bottom appearing one by one.
useWhen: 介绍一个具体案例、地点、项目，并给出三个关键数
客户案例（主图用真实截图）
useWhenEn: Introduce one case, place or project with three key numbers
Customer case with a real screenshot as the hero image
avoidWhen: 只有一个数：用 BigStat
多个案例并列：用 WorkCards
avoidWhenEn: Only one number: use BigStat
Several cases side by side: use WorkCards
limits: metrics 正好 3 个：value ≤ 7 个字符，label ≤ 12 字
limitsEn: metrics exactly 3: value ≤ 7 characters, label ≤ 12 chars
interaction: build：指标逐个出现
interactionEn: build: the metrics appear one by one

props.name: metrics
props.note: 三个指标，每个一个 build 步骤
props.noteEn: Three metrics, one build step each

example: <CaseStudy image={{ src: aerial, alt: '…' }} kicker="案例" title="…" tags={['世界遗产']} body="…" metrics={[{ value: '34.8万', label: '平方公里面积' }, …]} />

name: 设备外框
role: 证据 · 产品或网站截图
roleEn: Evidence · a product or site screenshot
summary: 把一张真实截图放进画出来的笔记本、平板或手机外框，右边 0–3 条竖线标注逐条出现。
summaryEn: A real screenshot inside a drawn laptop, tablet or phone frame, with 0–3 hairline callouts on the right appearing one by one.
useWhen: 展示一个网站、App、工具的真实界面
说明“我们从哪里看到这些数据”
useWhenEn: Show the real interface of a site, app or tool
Explain where the data comes from
avoidWhen: 截图里的细节要放大讲：用 Screenshot 或 TabbedShot
只有氛围图没有截图：用 PhotoSplit
avoidWhenEn: A detail in the screenshot needs enlarging: use Screenshot or TabbedShot
Only atmosphere images, no screenshot: use PhotoSplit
limitsEn: image must be a real screenshot
interaction: build：标注逐条出现
interactionEn: build: the callouts appear one by one

props.name: image
props.note: 真实截图；credit 并入来源行
props.noteEn: Real screenshot; credit joins the source line

props.name: points
props.note: 标注，每条一个 build 步骤

example: <DeviceFrame kicker="怎么知道的" title="卫星每天测一次海温" image={{ src: shot, alt: '…', credit: '截图：…' }} points={[{ title: '5 公里分辨率', body: '…' }]} />

name: 前后对比滑块
role: 对比 · 同一画面的前后变化
roleEn: Comparison · before and after in the same view
summary: 两张同构图的图片叠在一起，中间一条带把手的分割线。每按一次 →，分割线滑到下一个位置，下方对应的说明点亮。
summaryEn: Two identically framed images stacked, with a divider and handle between them. Each press of → moves the divider to the next stop and lights the matching note below.
useWhen: 改版前后、治理前后、季节变化等同机位对比
想让观众“拉开帘子”看变化
useWhenEn: Same-position comparisons: redesign, restoration, seasons
The audience should pull the curtain back to see the change
avoidWhen: 两张图构图不同：用 BeforeAfter 或 DuoCards
要比较数字：用图表
avoidWhenEn: The two images are framed differently: use BeforeAfter or DuoCards
Comparing numbers: use a chart
limits: 两张图尺寸和构图必须一致；生成图要在 note 或 credit 里写明“示意”
limitsEn: The two images must match in size and framing; generated images must say "illustrative" in note or credit
interaction: build：分割线逐步滑动，说明逐条点亮
interactionEn: build: the divider slides step by step and the notes light up in turn

props.name: before
props.noteEn: Left side, shown left of the divider

props.name: start
props.note: 第 0 步分割线位置，默认 50

props.name: stops
props.note: 每步的位置和说明；不逐步时停在最后一个位置
props.noteEn: Position and note per step; without steps it rests at the last position

example: <CompareSlider kicker="对照" title="同一片礁，白化前后" before={{ image: a, label: '健康' }} after={{ image: b, label: '白化' }} stops={[{ at: 82, note: '…' }, { at: 18, note: '…' }]} />

name: 照片叠放
role: 列举 · 3–4 项逐张翻开
roleEn: List · 3–4 items revealed one at a time
summary: 右边一摞白边照片，每按一次 → 就有一张新照片斜着落到最上面；左边对应的编号说明同时出现。
summaryEn: A pile of white-bordered photos on the right; each press of → drops a new photo at an angle onto the top, and the matching numbered text appears on the left.
useWhen: 3–4 个并列的地点、案例、发现，每个有图和一句话
想制造“一张接一张”的节奏
useWhenEn: 3–4 parallel places, cases or findings, each with an image and one line
A one-after-another rhythm
avoidWhen: 需要同时比较所有图：用 PhotoMosaic
超过 4 项：拆页
avoidWhenEn: All images should be compared at once: use PhotoMosaic
More than 4 items: split the slide
interaction: build：照片逐张落到最上面
interactionEn: build: each photo drops onto the top in turn

props.name: photos
props.note: 照片和说明同一步出现
props.noteEn: Photo and text appear in the same step

example: <PhotoStack kicker="区域差异" title={['十年损失 14%，', '各地差得很远']} photos={[{ image: { src: a, alt: '…' }, title: '全球：-14%', body: '…' }, …]} />

name: 翻面卡
role: 揭晓 · 先问后答
summary: 2–4 张卡片，正面是一句说法或问题，每按一次 → 一张卡 3D 翻到背面，露出答案。
summaryEn: 2–4 cards with a claim or question on the front; each press of → flips one card in 3D to show the answer on the back.
useWhen: 破除误解：正面写常见说法，背面写事实
先抛问题让听众猜，再翻面揭晓
useWhenEn: Correct a misconception: the common claim on the front, the fact on the back
Pose a question for the audience to guess, then flip to reveal
avoidWhen: 没有“先问后答”的悬念：用 PanelCards
超过 4 张：拆页
avoidWhenEn: No question-then-answer suspense: use PanelCards
More than 4 cards: split the slide
limits: 配 build: reveal 才有翻面
interaction: build: reveal 时每步翻一张；未逐步或打印时全部显示背面
interactionEn: build: reveal flips one card per step; without steps or in print every card shows its back

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: cards
props.note: 正面 tag + front，背面 title + body
props.noteEn: Front tag and front text, back title and body

props.name: backTag
props.note: 背面的小标签，默认“答案”
props.noteEn: Small label on the back, default "answer"

example: <FlipCards kicker="先翻三张牌" title="关于纸，常见的三个说法" backTag="其实" cards={[{ tag: '说法一', front: '纸是蔡伦从零发明的', title: '更早就已有纸', body: '…' }, …]} source="…" />

name: 叠卡推出
role: 顺序 · 3–4 个阶段
summary: 卡片先叠成一摞放在右侧，每按一次 → 下一张从牌堆里滑出，落到自己在一排中的位置。
summaryEn: The cards start as one pile on the right; each press of → deals the next card out of the pile into its place in the row.
useWhen: 3–4 个依次发生的阶段、年份
想让每一项“从一叠里抽出来”
useWhenEn: 3–4 stages or years that happen in order
Each item should be drawn from the pile
avoidWhen: 阶段之间没有先后：用 PanelCards
超过 4 项：用 Timeline
avoidWhenEn: The stages have no order: use PanelCards
More than 4 items: use Timeline
interaction: build: reveal 时第 0 步是一摞，之后每步推出一张
interactionEn: build: reveal starts as one pile at step 0, then deals one card per step

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source

props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

example: <CardStack kicker="一台机器" title="…" cards={[{ mark: '1799', title: '连续造纸机', body: '…' }, …]} source="…" />

name: 扇形卡片
role: 并列 · 4–6 个要点逐个讲
roleEn: Parallel · 4–6 points taken one by one
summary: 卡片像一手牌一样沿圆弧展开；每按一次 → 扇面转动，下一张立到正中并抬起。
summaryEn: The cards spread along an arc like a hand of cards; each press of → turns the fan, and the next card stands up in the centre.
useWhen: 4–6 个并列的小知识、数字
想让一页更像“道具”而不是表格
useWhenEn: 4–6 parallel small facts or numbers
The slide should feel like a prop rather than a table
avoidWhen: 要同时比较所有项：用 StatRow 或 PanelCards
每项文字超过 30 字
avoidWhenEn: All items should be compared at once: use StatRow or PanelCards
Each item runs past 30 chars
limits: mark ≤ 6 个字符；title ≤ 8 字；body ≤ 30 字
limitsEn: mark ≤ 6 characters; title ≤ 8 chars; body ≤ 30 chars
interaction: build: reveal 时第 0 步扇面收拢，之后每步转到下一张；完成态停在最后一张
interactionEn: build: reveal starts with the fan closed at step 0, then turns to the next card each step; the final state rests on the last card

props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title

props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

example: <FanCarousel kicker="尺寸" title="一张 A4 背后的五个数字" cards={[{ icon: 'letter', mark: '1786', title: '最早的设想', body: '…' }, …]} source="…" />

name: 纵深轮播
role: 路线 · 3–6 站依次讲
summary: 卡片排在一条向远处退去的 3D 轨道上；每按一次 → 下一站来到最前面，其余后退变淡。底部一排小标记显示当前位置。
summaryEn: The cards sit on a 3D track that recedes into the distance; each press of → brings the next stop to the front and pushes the rest back and dimmer. A row of small marks at the bottom shows the position.
useWhen: 路线、站点、版本这类有顺序的 3–6 项
每项一个大数字（年份、编号）
useWhenEn: 3–6 ordered items such as route, stops or versions
Each item has one large number (year, index)
avoidWhen: 要一眼看全部：用 Timeline
项目超过 6 个
avoidWhenEn: Everything should be visible at once: use Timeline
More than 6 items
limits: mark ≤ 6 个字符；title ≤ 8 字；body ≤ 40 字
limitsEn: mark ≤ 6 characters; title ≤ 8 chars; body ≤ 40 chars
interaction: build: reveal 时每步换到下一站；完成态停在最后一站
interactionEn: build: reveal moves to the next stop each step; the final state rests on the last stop

props.name: kicker

props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

example: <DepthCarousel kicker="西传" title="纸走过的五站" items={[{ mark: '105', title: '东汉洛阳', body: '…' }, …]} source="…" />

name: 信封
role: 揭晓 · 一封信、一段公告
roleEn: Reveal · a letter or an announcement
summary: 左边标题和导语，右边一个用 CSS 画的信封：第一步打开封口，第二步把信纸抽出来。可选纸纹贴图和邮票。
summaryEn: Title and lead on the left, a CSS-drawn envelope on the right: step 1 opens the flap, step 2 pulls the letter out. Optional paper texture and stamp.
useWhen: 原文引用一封信、通知、公告
想营造“拆开来看”的揭晓感
useWhenEn: Quoting a letter, a notice or an announcement
You want the reveal feel of opening something up
avoidWhen: 信的内容超过 72 字：用 QuoteHero
内容是虚构的却没标明：必须在 sign 或 source 里写“示意”
avoidWhenEn: The letter text is over 72 chars: use QuoteHero
The content is invented and unmarked: mark it illustrative in sign or source
limits: texture 只用 decor- 纸纹
limitsEn: greeting ≤ 12 chars; body ≤ 72 chars; sign ≤ 14 chars
texture only takes a decor- paper texture
interaction: build: reveal 时第 1 步开封口，第 2 步抽出信纸
interactionEn: build: on reveal, step 1 opens the flap and step 2 pulls out the letter

props.name: texture
props.note: import 进来的 decor- 纸纹

example: <Envelope kicker="一封信" title={['一枚邮票，', '让信变便宜']} greeting="致每一位寄信人：" body="…" sign="示意信件" stamp="1d" texture={paper} source="…" />

name: 翻书
role: 叙事 · 2–4 个跨页
summary: 一本摊开的书，每页一个大数字、标题和说明；每按一次 → 右页绕书脊 3D 翻过去，露出下一个跨页。
summaryEn: An open book; each page holds one big number, a title and a note. Each → press turns the right page around the spine in 3D to show the next spread.
useWhen: 讲一本书、一份档案、一段史料
4–8 个数字按两两一组讲
useWhenEn: Telling a book, an archive or a piece of history
4–8 numbers told two at a time
avoidWhen: 只有 1 个跨页：用 DuoCards
数字要互相比较：用图表
avoidWhenEn: Only 1 spread: use DuoCards
Numbers must be compared: use a chart
limits: texture 只用 decor- 纸纹
limitsEn: texture only takes a decor- paper texture
interaction: build: reveal 时每步翻一页；完成态显示最后一个跨页
interactionEn: build: each step turns one page; the final state shows the last spread

name: 挂绳胸牌
role: 人物 · 讲者或主角介绍
roleEn: People · introduces the speaker or main character
summary: 右侧一张挂在织带上的胸牌，入场时轻轻摆动后停稳；胸牌上是活动名、字母圆章、姓名和身份。左边 2–4 条要点逐条出现。
summaryEn: A badge on a fabric strap on the right, swinging gently on entry then settling; the badge shows the event name, letter monogram, name and role. 2–4 points on the left appear one by one.
useWhen: 介绍讲者本人
介绍一位历史人物或故事主角（不放真人照片）
useWhenEn: Introducing the speaker
Introducing a historical figure or story protagonist (no real photo)
avoidWhen: 介绍 2 人以上：用 Team
要放真人照片：本模板只用字母圆章
avoidWhenEn: Introducing 2 or more people: use Team
A real photo is needed: this template only uses a letter monogram
limits: badge.event ≤ 12 字；initials 1–2 个字符；name ≤ 6 字；role ≤ 14 字；code ≤ 10 个字符
limitsEn: badge.event ≤ 12 chars; initials 1–2 characters; name ≤ 6 chars; role ≤ 14 chars; code ≤ 10 characters
interaction: 入场摆动（减少动态效果时不摆）；build: reveal 时逐条出现要点
interactionEn: Swings on entry (no swing with reduced motion); build: points appear one by one on reveal

props.name: points
props.note: 左侧要点，每条一个 build 步骤
props.noteEn: Left points, one build step each

example: <Lanyard kicker="今天的向导" title="…" badge={{ event: '纸的旅程 · 人物卡', initials: '蔡', name: '蔡伦', role: '东汉 · 尚方令' }} points={[{ label: '身份', text: '…' }, …]} strap="PAPER ROUTE" source="…" />

name: 进度卡
role: 数据 · 2–4 个百分比
summary: 每张卡一个圆环、一个大百分比、标签、进度条和一句说明；每按一次 → 一张卡的圆环和进度条填满到数值。
summaryEn: Each card has a ring, a big percentage, a label, a bar and one note; each → press fills one card's ring and bar to its value.
useWhen: 2–4 个 0–100 的比例：完成度、回收率、占比
每个数字要配一句解释
useWhenEn: 2–4 ratios from 0–100: completion, recovery rate, share
Each number needs one line of explanation
avoidWhen: 数值不是百分比或会超过 100：用 StatRow
要比较很多项：用 BarChart
avoidWhenEn: Values are not percentages or go over 100: use StatRow
Many items must be compared: use BarChart
limits: label ≤ 10 字；display ≤ 6 个字符；note ≤ 30 字
limitsEn: label ≤ 10 chars; display ≤ 6 characters; note ≤ 30 chars
interaction: build: reveal 时每步填满一张卡
interactionEn: build: each step fills one card

props.name: cards
props.note: value 决定圆环和进度条
props.noteEn: value sets the ring and the bar

example: <ProgressCards kicker="回收" title="美国的纸，回收了多少" cards={[{ label: '纸和纸板总体', value: 68.2, note: '…' }, …]} source="US EPA（2018）" />

name: 流程手风琴
role: 流程 · 4–6 步逐项展开
roleEn: Process · 4–6 steps opened one at a time
summary: 一排竖向面板，折叠时只显示编号和竖排标题；每按一次 → 下一步展开成宽面板（强调色底）显示说明，上一步折回。
summaryEn: A row of vertical panels; collapsed panels show only the number and a vertical title. Each → press expands the next step into a wide panel (accent background) with its note and folds the previous one back.
useWhen: 4–6 步的工艺、流程，每步一段说明
讲一步时希望其他步骤收起来
useWhenEn: A 4–6 step craft or process, one note per step
You want the other steps folded away while you talk about one
avoidWhen: 要同时看全部说明：用 StepTrack
步骤名超过 6 字（竖排会太长）
avoidWhenEn: All notes must be visible at once: use StepTrack
Step names over 6 chars (vertical text gets too tall)
limits: open 未逐步时展开的面板，默认最后一个
limitsEn: title ≤ 6 chars; sub ≤ 16 chars; body ≤ 60 chars
open is the panel expanded when not stepped, default the last one
interaction: build: reveal 时每步展开一项
interactionEn: build: each step expands one item

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: open
props.note: 完成态展开的面板序号
props.noteEn: Index of the panel open in the final state

example: <ProcessAccordion kicker="古法" title="竹纸的五道工序" steps={[{ title: '斩竹漂塘', sub: '取料', body: '…' }, …]} source="…" />

name: 笔记本章节页
role: 章节 · 分隔页
summary: 右边一本略微倾斜的硬皮笔记本（强调色封面、缝线、松紧带和纸标签），标签上写章节名；左边超大章节号和 2–4 条本章内容。
summaryEn: A slightly tilted hardcover notebook on the right (accent cover, stitching, elastic band and paper label) with the chapter name on the label; on the left a very large chapter number and 2–4 items for this chapter.
useWhen: 章节分隔页
想让分隔页有手作、笔记的感觉
useWhenEn: A chapter divider page
You want the divider to feel handmade and note-like
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 SectionBreak
没有章节结构的短演示
avoidWhenEn: A formal report: use SectionBreak
A short deck with no chapter structure
limits: texture 只用 decor- 皮纹
limitsEn: texture only takes a decor- leather texture

props.name: texture
props.note: import 进来的 decor- 皮纹

example: <NotebookCover number="01" kicker="第一章" title={['纸从哪里', '出发']} sub="…" items={['…', '…']} texture={leather} />

name: 半调滤镜图
role: 氛围 · 图片转成网点或抖动
roleEn: Atmosphere · photo turned into dots or dither
summary: 左边标题、导语和 0–3 个小数字；右边一张图被 SVG 滤镜重印成主题色的报纸网点（dots）或 1 位抖动（dither），图片本身不用另做处理。
summaryEn: Title, lead and 0–3 small numbers on the left; on the right one image reprinted by an SVG filter as newspaper dots in the theme color (dots) or 1-bit dither (dither); the image itself needs no extra work.
useWhen: 想用图片营造质感，又不想让照片抢走注意力
装饰图和主题色要统一
useWhenEn: You want image texture without the photo taking the attention
The decorative image should match the theme color
avoidWhen: 图片是证据、需要看清细节：用 Screenshot
图很暗或很平：网点会糊成一片
avoidWhenEn: The image is evidence and detail must show: use Screenshot
The image is dark or flat: the dots blur into one mass
limits: facts 0–3 个：value ≤ 6 个字符，label ≤ 12 字
有 facts 时配 build: reveal 逐个出现
limitsEn: with facts, add build: reveal to show them one by one

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Title; break lines by hand in the array

props.name: image
props.note: import 进来的 decor- 图或截图

props.name: credit
props.note: 图片来源，如“图：AI 生成装饰图”

example: <Halftone kicker="什么是白化" title={['颜色来自藻，', '白色是骨骼']} lead="…" image={bleached} alt="…" mode="dots" facts={[{ value: '共生藻', label: '珊瑚颜色的来源' }]} credit="图：AI 生成装饰图" />

name: 渐进模糊大图
role: 氛围 · 整页图片加标题
roleEn: Atmosphere · full-page image with a title
summary: 整页图片，下半部分分 6 层逐渐加深模糊并压暗，标题、导语放在模糊区上，右下角放 0–3 个标签和出处。配 tone: dark。
summaryEn: A full-page image; the lower half is blurred and darkened in 6 growing layers; title and lead sit on the blurred area, with 0–3 tags and the source at the bottom right. Use tone: dark.
useWhen: 章节开场、场景引入
图片上半部分有好看的主体
useWhenEn: A chapter opening or a scene lead-in
The upper half of the image holds the subject
avoidWhen: 图片主体在下半部分：会被模糊掉
要讲多条要点：用内容模板
avoidWhenEn: The subject sits in the lower half: it gets blurred out
Several points must be made: use a content template
limits: 配 tone: dark，backdrop 设为 none
limitsEn: use tone: dark and set backdrop to none

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: Lead, shown as one build step

example: <ProgressiveBlur kicker="先认识珊瑚礁" title={['不到 1% 的海底，', '养着约四分之一的海洋生物']} lead="…" tags={['动物', '共生藻']} image={coral} alt="…" credit="图：AI 生成装饰图" />

name: 遮罩揭示
role: 过程 · 边讲边揭开图片
roleEn: Journey · uncover the image as you talk
summary: 左边 2–4 个编号要点；右边一张变灰的图，每讲一步，遮罩打开一点（圆形从中心扩大，或百叶窗逐组拉开），图片露出原色。
summaryEn: 2–4 numbered points on the left; on the right a greyed image; each step opens the mask a little more (a circle growing from the center, or blinds opening group by group) and the image shows its original colors.
useWhen: 分阶段讲一个过程，最后看到全貌
想让一张氛围图随讲解逐步出现
useWhenEn: Telling a process in stages and showing the whole at the end
One atmosphere image should appear gradually with the talk
avoidWhen: 要点超过 4 个：拆页或用 StepTrack
图片本身是证据：用 Screenshot
avoidWhenEn: More than 4 points: split the slide or use StepTrack
The image itself is evidence: use Screenshot
example: <MaskReveal kicker="三个阶段" title={['从受热，', '到恢复或死去']} steps={[{ label: '热应激', text: '…' }, …]} image={coral} alt="…" shape="circle" />

name: 标识墙
role: 信任 · 合作方或参与方
summary: 标题下一面细线方格墙，每格一个占位几何标识（模板自带 12 种，不放真实品牌）加名称和角色；每行作为一步出现，底下一行注明“标识为示意”。
summaryEn: Below the title, a thin-line grid wall; each cell holds a placeholder geometric mark (12 built in, no real brands) with a name and role; each row appears as one step, and a line below states that the marks are illustrative.
useWhen: 列出参与方类型、合作网络
需要“很多方参与”的视觉感
useWhenEn: Listing participant types or a partner network
You need the visual of many parties involved
avoidWhen: 要放真实品牌标识：本模板不支持
每方都要说明：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: Real brand marks must be shown: not supported
Every party needs a note: use IconGrid
limits: items 6–12 个：name ≤ 8 字，role ≤ 8 字；≤ 6 个时每行 3 格，否则 4 格
note ≤ 30 字，必须说明标识为示意
配 build: reveal 按行出现
limitsEn: items 6–12: name ≤ 8 chars, role ≤ 8 chars; ≤ 6 items gives 3 per row, otherwise 4
note ≤ 30 chars and must say the marks are illustrative
use build: reveal to show it row by row
example: <LogoWall kicker="谁在监测" title="一张多方合作的观测网" items={[{ name: '卫星海温', role: '大范围预警' }, …]} note="标识为占位图形，均为示意。" />

name: 图片结尾
role: 结尾 · 整页图片收束
summary: 整页图片缓慢推近，左侧黑色渐变压暗，一句大字结束语、一段导语和 0–3 条编号的下一步。配 tone: dark。
summaryEn: A full-page image pushes in slowly; a black gradient darkens the left; one large closing line, a lead and 0–3 numbered next steps. Use tone: dark.
useWhen: 演讲最后一页，留一个画面
有明确的下一步行动
useWhenEn: The last slide of a talk, leaving one image
There is a clear next step
avoidWhen: 没有合适的图：用 Closing
要回顾要点：用 Recap
avoidWhenEn: No suitable image: use Closing
Points must be recapped: use Recap
limits: 图片主体在右侧；配 tone: dark，backdrop 设为 none
limitsEn: the subject sits on the right; use tone: dark and set backdrop to none

props.name: actions
props.noteEn: Next steps, appearing one by one

example: <PhotoClosing kicker="最后" title={['白色还不是', '终点']} lead="…" actions={['…', '…']} image={dusk} alt="…" credit="图：AI 生成装饰图" />

name: 排名赛跑
role: 数据 · 名次随时间变化
summary: 横向条形排名，每按一次 → 换到下一期，条形重新排序、长度随数值变化，右下角显示当前年份。
summaryEn: Horizontal bar ranking; each → press moves to the next period, the bars re-sort and change length with their values, and the current year shows at the bottom right.
useWhen: 同一组对象在 3–8 个时间点的名次变化
想让观众一步步看到“谁超过了谁”
useWhenEn: The same set of objects ranked at 3–8 points in time
You want the audience to see “who passed whom” step by step
avoidWhen: 只有两个时间点：用 SlopeRank
要看精确趋势：用 LineChart
avoidWhenEn: Only two points in time: use SlopeRank
Exact trends matter: use LineChart
limits: periods 3–8 期，每期 ≤ 6 个字符
需要 build: 'reveal'；不逐步时直接显示最后一期
limitsEn: needs build: 'reveal'; without steps it shows the last period
interaction: → 前进一期
interactionEn: → advances one period

name: 气泡簇
role: 数据 · 比较体量
summary: 一簇紧密排列的圆，面积与数值成正比，大圆里写名称和数值；右侧可放 1–3 条解读。
summaryEn: A tight cluster of circles whose area is proportional to the value; large circles show the name and value; 1–3 readings can sit on the right.
useWhen: 5–14 个对象比体量，差距大但不需要坐标轴
想强调某一项在整体里的位置
useWhenEn: 5–14 objects compared by size, far apart but with no axes
You want to stress where one item sits in the whole
avoidWhen: 要精确比较数值：用 BarChart
有两个维度：用 Scatter
avoidWhenEn: Exact values must be compared: use BarChart
Two dimensions: use Scatter
limits: items 5–14 项，name ≤ 6 字；最小值 ≥ 最大值的 1/16，否则小圆放不下名字
limitsEn: items 5–14, name ≤ 6 chars; smallest value ≥ 1/16 of the largest, or the small circles cannot hold the name

name: 节点关系图
role: 结构 · 谁和谁相连
summary: 一个中心节点和环绕它的节点，用线相连，线上可写关系；逐条展开时每个节点带着它的连线出现。
summaryEn: One center node and the nodes around it, joined by lines that can carry a relation; when stepped, each node appears with its lines.
useWhen: 4–10 个对象之间的关系：依赖、流向、合作
讲一个系统由哪些部分组成、怎么互相影响
useWhenEn: Relations between 4–10 objects: dependency, flow, cooperation
Explaining what a system is made of and how the parts affect each other
avoidWhen: 有先后步骤：用 FlowDiagram
有数量流动：用 Sankey
avoidWhenEn: There is a sequence of steps: use FlowDiagram
Quantities flow: use Sankey
limits: 默认第一个节点居中；所有节点都给 x/y（0–100）时按手动位置
limitsEn: the first node is centered by default; when every node has x/y (0–100) the manual positions are used

name: 桑基图
role: 数据 · 总量怎么分流
summary: 2–4 列节点，带宽与数值成正比的流带把它们连起来；逐条展开时一列一列流过去。
summaryEn: 2–4 columns of nodes joined by flow bands whose width is proportional to the value; when stepped, the flow runs column by column.
useWhen: 一个总量由哪些部分组成、又流向哪里
预算、能源、流量的去向
useWhenEn: What a total is made of and where it goes
Where a budget, energy or traffic goes
avoidWhen: 只有一层构成：用 Donut 或 Treemap
没有数量的关系：用 NodeGraph
avoidWhenEn: Only one layer of parts: use Donut or Treemap
Relations without quantities: use NodeGraph
limits: nodes 4–14 个，label ≤ 6 字；每列 ≤ 8 个
数值标签含单位 ≤ 10 个字符

name: 矩形树图
role: 数据 · 整体的构成
summary: 一整块矩形按数值切成小块，块越大数值越大，大块写名称、数值和占比。
summaryEn: One rectangle is cut into blocks by value; a bigger block means a bigger value, and large blocks show name, value and share.
useWhen: 6–12 个部分组成一个整体
份额差距大，想一眼看出谁占大头
useWhenEn: 6–12 parts making up a whole
Shares differ a lot and the largest should stand out at a glance
avoidWhen: 只有 2–5 个部分：用 Donut
要比较时间变化：用 StackedArea
avoidWhenEn: Only 2–5 parts: use Donut
Change over time must be compared: use StackedArea
limits: 太小的块不写字：最小项 ≥ 总量的 1.5% 才有标签
limitsEn: blocks too small carry no text: the smallest item needs ≥ 1.5% of the total to get a label

summary: 5–8 条轴的蛛网图，第一组用强调色填充，第二组为灰色虚线，逐条展开时第二组后出现。
summaryEn: A web chart with 5–8 axes; the first series is filled with the accent color, the second is a grey dashed line and appears after the first when stepped.

各维度单位相同（例如都是百分比或评分）
useWhenEn: Profiles of two objects over 5–8 dimensions
All dimensions share a unit (for example percent or a score)
avoidWhen: 维度单位不同：用 CompareTable
对象超过两个：用 BarChart 分组
avoidWhenEn: Dimensions have different units: use CompareTable
More than two objects: use grouped BarChart

想按“高/低 × 高/低”把它们分组
useWhenEn: Where 6–60 objects sit on two metrics
You want to group them by “high/low × high/low”

要看时间变化：用 LineChart
avoidWhenEn: Fewer than 6 points: use Quadrant with cards

limits: points 6–60 个，带名字的 ≤ 8 个，name ≤ 6 字

props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: quadrants
props.type: [左上, 右上, 左下, 右下]

example: <Scatter kicker="追赶" title="…" points={[{ name: '中国', x: 0.7, y: 11.1, label: true }, …]} xLabel="2015 年占比（%）" yLabel="2025 年占比（%）" split={{ x: 1.1, y: 8.7 }} quadrants={['后来居上', '一直领先', '仍在起步', '被平均追上']} />

name: 堆叠面积图
role: 数据 · 构成随时间变化
summary: 2–6 层面积叠成总量（或 100%），右端标每层名称与最新值；逐条展开时从底层往上一层层加。
summaryEn: 2–6 layers stack into the total (or 100%); the right end labels each layer with its name and latest value; when stepped, layers add from the bottom up.
useWhen: 总量的构成怎样随时间变化
某一层在变厚或变薄
useWhenEn: How the composition of a total changes over time
One layer is getting thicker or thinner
avoidWhen: 只看一两条趋势：用 LineChart
只有一个时间点：用 Treemap 或 Donut
avoidWhenEn: Only one or two trends: use LineChart
Only one point in time: use Treemap or Donut
limits: x 4–30 个点，标签 ≤ 6 个字符；多于 12 个时用 ticks 只标一部分
limitsEn: x 4–30 points, labels ≤ 6 characters; above 12, use ticks to label only some

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: ticks
props.note: 要标注的 x 下标

example: <StackedArea kicker="结构" title="…" x={years} series={[{ name: '煤电', values: […] }, …]} mode="share" focus="太阳能" />

name: 点阵地图
role: 数据 · 在哪里
summary: 离线的点阵世界地图（Natural Earth 陆地，公有领域），上面按经纬度放编号圆点，面积与数值成正比，右侧是对应列表。
summaryEn: An offline dot-matrix world map (Natural Earth land, public domain) with numbered dots placed by longitude and latitude and sized by value, plus a matching list on the right.
useWhen: 1–8 个国家或城市的位置和数值
想让观众先看到“分布在哪”
useWhenEn: Location and value of 1–8 countries or cities
You want the audience to see where things are spread first
avoidWhen: 要按地区着色比较：用 Heatmap 或 BarChart
地点集中在一个城市内：点阵太粗
avoidWhenEn: Comparison by colored region: use Heatmap or BarChart
Places sit inside one city: the dot grid is too coarse
limits: 数值含单位 ≤ 10 个字符
地图精度为 2°，只适合国家级位置
limitsEn: the map is 2° precise, so country-level locations only

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

example: <DotMap kicker="地图" title="…" markers={[{ name: '中国', lon: 104, lat: 35, value: 1175 }, …]} unit=" TWh" />

name: 发光指标卡
role: 数据 · 开场的关键数字
roleEn: Data · key numbers in the opening
summary: 2–4 张深色卡片，大数字带强调色光晕并从 0 数上来，可加小折线和变化说明；适合深色风格。
summaryEn: 2–4 dark cards; the big number carries an accent glow and counts up from 0, with an optional small line chart and change note; made for dark styles.
useWhen: 整场演示依赖的 2–4 个数字
深色风格（studio-dark 等）里的数据开场
useWhenEn: The 2–4 numbers the whole deck rests on
A data opening in a dark style (studio-dark and others)
avoidWhen: 数字超过 4 个：用 KpiBoard
浅色正式汇报：用 StatRow
avoidWhenEn: More than 4 numbers: use KpiBoard
A light formal report: use StatRow
limits: 数值含单位 ≤ 8 个字符；unit ≤ 4 个字符
label ≤ 10 字，delta ≤ 12 个字符，note ≤ 24 字
limitsEn: value with unit ≤ 8 characters; unit ≤ 4 characters
label ≤ 10 chars, delta ≤ 12 characters, note ≤ 24 chars

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: metrics
props.type: { value, decimals?, unit?, label, note?, delta?, trend? }[]

example: <GlowMetrics kicker="2025 年" title="先记住三个数" metrics={[{ value: 2779, unit: 'TWh', label: '全球太阳能发电量', delta: '+30%' }, …]} />

name: 打字机
role: 引语 · 一句原话逐字打出
roleEn: Quotation · one quote typed out letter by letter
summary: 等宽大字逐字打出 1–3 行原话，末尾有闪烁光标；下方一行译文或出处，底部 0–3 组标签和值。每行是一个 build 步骤。
summaryEn: Monospace large text types out 1–3 lines of a quote letter by letter with a blinking cursor; one line below holds the translation or source, and 0–3 label and value pairs sit at the bottom. Each line is one build step.
useWhen: 电报、无线电、命令行里的原话
想让观众跟着一个字一个字读完的短句
useWhenEn: A quote from a telegram, radio or command line
A short line the audience should read one character at a time
avoidWhen: 长段引文：用 Quote
句子没有“正在输入”的意味：用 Statement
avoidWhenEn: A long quotation: use Quote
The sentence does not feel like it is being typed: use Statement
limits: lines 1–3 行，每行 ≤ 32 个拉丁字符或 ≤ 16 字
limitsEn: lines 1–3, each ≤ 32 Latin characters or ≤ 16 chars
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 打出一行；直接跳到本页时进入即打字，最后停在完整文字
interactionEn: in build mode each → press types one line; entering the slide directly starts typing and ends on the full text
example: <Typewriter kicker="第一句话" lines={['Houston, Tranquility Base here.', 'The Eagle has landed.']} caption="…" meta={[{ label: '着陆地点', value: '静海' }]} />

name: 轮换词
role: 观点 · 一句话里换 2–4 个词
roleEn: Point of view · swap 2–4 words in one sentence
summary: 大标题里留一个词位，每一步换进下一个词，下方对应卡片同时点亮；卡片可带一个数字和一行说明。
summaryEn: The headline leaves one word slot; each step swaps in the next word and lights the matching card below; a card can carry one number and one note.
useWhen: “靠的是 X / Y / Z”这类并列答案
同一句式要依次套 2–4 个对象
useWhenEn: Parallel answers like “it comes down to X / Y / Z”
One sentence frame takes 2–4 objects in turn
avoidWhen: 词之间没有共同句式：用 IconGrid 或卡片
要比较数值：用图表
avoidWhenEn: The words share no sentence frame: use IconGrid or cards
Values must be compared: use a chart
limits: words 2–4 个：word ≤ 4 字，value ≤ 8 个字符，note ≤ 30 字
limitsEn: words 2–4: word ≤ 4 chars, value ≤ 8 characters, note ≤ 30 chars
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 换下一个词并点亮卡片；完整状态显示最后一个词
interactionEn: in build mode each → press moves to the next word and lights its card; the final state shows the last word
example: <RotatingWord kicker="三样东西" before="登月靠的是" words={[{ word: '火箭', value: '110.6 m', note: '…' }, …]} />

name: 变形标题
role: 转折 · 一句话变成另一句
summary: 同一位置的两句超大字：第一句逐字模糊散开，第二句在原处凝聚出来；底部两栏分别注释前后两句。
summaryEn: Two very large lines in the same place: the first blurs apart letter by letter, the second condenses in place; two columns at the bottom note the before and after lines.
useWhen: 前后对照的名句、口号
“从 A 到 B”的立场转变
useWhenEn: A famous line or slogan shown before and after
A stance turning “from A to B”
avoidWhen: 两句都要同时被读到：用 Compare 类模板
句子超过 12 字
avoidWhenEn: Both lines must be read at once: use a Compare template
The sentence is over 12 chars
limits: notes 正好 2 条：label ≤ 6 字，body ≤ 40 字
limitsEn: notes exactly 2: label ≤ 6 chars, body ≤ 40 chars
interaction: build 模式下按 → 变形；直接进入本页时停顿约 1.6 秒后自动变形，打印只显示第二句
interactionEn: in build mode → morphs; entering the slide directly morphs automatically after about 1.6 s, and print shows only the second line

props.name: notes
props.noteEn: Notes for the before and after lines

example: <MorphHeadline kicker="那句话" from="一个人的一小步" to="人类的一大步" notes={[{ label: '前半句', body: '…' }, { label: '后半句', body: '…' }]} />

name: 环形排字
role: 氛围 · 一句话绕成圆环
roleEn: Atmosphere · one line bent into a ring
summary: 左侧标题、导语和 0–3 条要点；右侧一句文字沿圆环排列（SVG 真实文字），转入定位，圆心是一个大字或数字，可衬一张装饰图。
summaryEn: Title, lead and 0–3 points on the left; on the right one line set along a ring (real SVG text) that rotates into place; the center holds one large word or number and can sit on a decorative image.
useWhen: 有一句可以反复念的短语、口号
编辑感的章节页或印象页
useWhenEn: A phrase or slogan worth repeating
An editorial section break or impression slide
avoidWhen: 环上的文字需要仔细阅读：放进正文
没有能放在圆心的词或数字
avoidWhenEn: The ring text must be read closely: put it in the body
No word or number fits the center
limits: title ≤ 2 行 × 8 字；lead ≤ 60 字；points 0–3 条，每条 ≤ 24 字
ring 16–44 个单位（拉丁字符算 1，汉字算 2），用 “ · ” 重复补满一圈；拉丁大写效果最好，汉字沿弧线会侧转
limitsEn: title ≤ 2 lines × 8 chars; lead ≤ 60 chars; points 0–3, each ≤ 24 chars
ring 16–44 units (a Latin character counts 1, a Chinese character counts 2), padded to a full circle with repeated “ · ”; Latin uppercase works best, Chinese characters turn sideways along the arc
interaction: 圆环是一个 build 步骤，出现时转入定位，之后静止
interactionEn: the ring is one build step; it rotates into place on appear, then holds still

props.name: image
props.note: 圆内装饰图，decor- 或截图
props.noteEn: Decorative image inside the ring, decor- or a screenshot

props.name: credit
props.note: 图片说明，AI 生成图要写明
props.noteEn: Image credit; AI-generated images must be marked

example: <TextArc kicker="月面印象" title="壮丽的荒凉" ring="MAGNIFICENT DESOLATION · MAGNIFICENT DESOLATION · " center="静海" centerLabel="着陆地点" image={disc} alt="…" />

name: 数字滚轮
role: 数据 · 1–3 个大数字
summary: 1–3 个大数字，每一位像里程表一样滚到终值；数字下有标签和一行说明。DOM 里始终是真实的终值文字，滚轮只是叠在上面的装饰。
summaryEn: 1–3 big numbers, each digit rolling to its final value like an odometer; each number has a label and one line of note below. The DOM always holds the real final text; the rolling digits are decoration layered on top.
useWhen: 少数几个需要“数出来”的大数字
距离、人数、时长这类量级数字
useWhenEn: A few big numbers that need to be counted out
Magnitude numbers such as distance, headcount or duration
avoidWhen: 数字之间要比较大小：用 BarChart
超过 3 个数字：用 StatRow
avoidWhenEn: Numbers must be compared in size: use BarChart
More than 3 numbers: use StatRow
limits: stats 1–3 个：value ≤ 7 个字符，unit ≤ 4 个字符，label ≤ 12 字，note ≤ 28 字
limitsEn: stats 1–3: value ≤ 7 characters, unit ≤ 4 characters, label ≤ 12 chars, note ≤ 28 chars
interaction: 每个数字是一个 build 步骤，出现时滚动到终值
interactionEn: Each number is a build step; it rolls to its final value when it appears
example: <Odometer kicker="三个数字" title="远、久、看的人多" stats={[{ value: '384,400', unit: 'km', label: '地月平均距离' }, …]} />

name: 荧光笔
role: 解读 · 一段话里划重点
roleEn: Interpretation · mark key points in a passage
summary: 一段大字正文，荧光笔依次划过 2–4 个关键短语，每处带编号，底部对应一条旁注。
summaryEn: One large-type passage; a highlighter sweeps over 2–4 key phrases in turn, each numbered, with a matching margin note at the bottom.
useWhen: 一段话里有 2–4 个要讲的点
逐句解读一段原文或说明
useWhenEn: 2–4 points to make inside one passage
Walk through a quoted passage or explanation sentence by sentence
avoidWhen: 正文超过 110 字：拆页
要点之间是并列清单：用列表模板
avoidWhenEn: Body longer than 110 chars: split the slide
The points form a parallel list: use a list template
limits: marks 2–4 个，必须是 body 里的原文；note ≤ 22 字
limitsEn: marks 2–4, must be text from body; note ≤ 22 chars
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 划下一处并显示对应旁注
interactionEn: In build mode each press → highlight the next spot and show its margin note
example: <MarkerSweep kicker="分工" title="两人在月面，一人在轨道" body="…" marks={[{ text: '21 小时 36 分', note: '…' }, …]} />

name: 镂空大字
role: 开场 · 封面或章节页
summary: 一个超大单词做镂空，图片只从字形里透出来并缓缓定位；下方标题、一句副标题和 0–3 个数字。
summaryEn: One huge word acts as a cut-out; the image shows only through the letterforms and slowly settles; below are a title, one subtitle and 0–3 numbers.
useWhen: 封面、章节页，主题能用一个短词概括
有一张纹理感强的图
useWhenEn: Cover or section break where the topic fits one short word
There is an image with strong texture
avoidWhen: 图片本身是证据或要看清内容：用图片版式
词超过 5 个拉丁字母
avoidWhenEn: The image is evidence or must be read closely: use an image layout
The word is longer than 5 Latin letters
limits: word 2–5 个拉丁大写字母或 1–2 个汉字
facts 0–3 个：value ≤ 8 个字符，label ≤ 10 字
limitsEn: word 2–5 Latin capitals or 1–2 Chinese characters

props.name: image
props.noteEn: Image showing through, decor- or screenshot

props.name: credit
props.note: 图片说明，AI 生成图要写明
props.noteEn: Image credit; state it for AI-generated images

example: <TextMask kicker="阿波罗 11 号 · 1969" word="MOON" title={['八天往返，', '人第一次站上月球']} image={surface} alt="…" />

name: 翻牌板
role: 时间线 · 3–6 个时刻
summary: 机场翻牌板：每行日期、可选时间、事件和状态，翻牌逐字翻到终值；每行是一个 build 步骤。
summaryEn: An airport split-flap board: each row has a date, an optional time, an event and a status, and the flaps turn character by character to their final value; each row is a build step.
useWhen: 有准确时刻的日程、任务时间线
发车、发布、上线这类“到点”的事件
useWhenEn: A schedule or task timeline with exact times
Point-in-time events such as departure, release or go-live
avoidWhen: 事件需要长说明：用 Timeline
超过 6 行：拆页
avoidWhenEn: Events need long descriptions: use Timeline
More than 6 rows: split the slide
limits: rows 3–6 行：time 和 at 各正好 5 个字符，label ≤ 8 字或 ≤ 14 个拉丁字符，status ≤ 4 字
limitsEn: rows 3–6: time and at are each exactly 5 characters, label ≤ 8 chars or ≤ 14 Latin characters, status ≤ 4 chars
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 翻出一行
interactionEn: In build mode each press → flip in one row
example: <SplitFlap kicker="时刻表" title="…" heads={['日期', '时间 UTC', '事件', '状态']} rows={[{ time: '07-16', at: '13:32', label: '土星五号发射', status: '起飞' }, …]} />

name: 新闻滚动条
role: 事件 · 头版大标题
summary: 头版式大标题、日期线和导语，底部一条新闻滚动条从右侧驶入后停住（不循环），显示 2–4 条快讯。
summaryEn: A front-page headline, dateline and lead; a news ticker at the bottom drives in from the right and stops (no loop), showing 2–4 items.
useWhen: 宣布一个事件或结果
一个主消息加几条次要消息
useWhenEn: Announce one event or result
One main message plus a few secondary ones
avoidWhen: 快讯需要出处各不相同且要细读：用列表
没有一个主标题
avoidWhenEn: Items need separate sources and close reading: use a list
There is no single main headline
limits: label ≤ 4 字；items 2–4 条，每条 ≤ 18 字，合计 ≤ 50 字
limitsEn: label ≤ 4 chars; items 2–4, each ≤ 18 chars, total ≤ 50 chars
interaction: 滚动条是一个 build 步骤，驶入后停住
interactionEn: The ticker is a build step; it drives in and stops
example: <NewsTicker kicker="返回" dateline="1969-07-24" headline={['哥伦布号溅落，', '三人平安返回']} label="快讯" items={['…', '…']} />

name: 讲稿高亮
role: 引语 · 逐行读一段讲稿
roleEn: Quotation · read a script line by line
summary: 3–6 行讲稿，未读的行是浅灰，每一步点亮下一行（强调色加下划线扫过），读过的行回到正文色；右栏放原文和出处。
summaryEn: 3–6 script lines; unread lines are light grey, each step lights the next line (accent colour and a sweeping underline), and read lines return to body colour; the right column holds the original text and the source.
useWhen: 一段演讲、誓词、歌词式的句子
想让观众跟着节奏一行行读
useWhenEn: A speech, oath or lyric-like passage
You want the audience to read line by line with the rhythm
avoidWhen: 只有一句话：用 Quote 或 Statement
每行超过 14 字
avoidWhenEn: Only one sentence: use Quote or Statement
Any line longer than 14 chars
limits: aside ≤ 120 个拉丁字符或 ≤ 60 字
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 点亮下一行；完整状态最后一行为强调色
interactionEn: In build mode each press → light the next line; in the complete state the last line stays in the accent colour
example: <KaraokeLines kicker="我们选择登月" lines={['我们选择在这十年里登月，', …]} by="肯尼迪 · 1962" />

name: 模型对照卡
role: 对比 · 2–3 种做法的结构
summary: 2–3 张并排卡片，每张顶部有一个小结构示意（目录树 / 块格 / 扁平桶），下面是对齐的属性行；每按一次 → 出现一张，可强调其中一张。
summaryEn: 2–3 cards side by side, each with a small structure sketch at the top (directory tree / blocks / flat) and aligned attribute rows below; each press → one card appears, and one card can be emphasised.
useWhen: 比较 2–3 种组织数据或做事的模型
每种模型用同样的几个维度描述
useWhenEn: Compare 2–3 models for organising data or doing the work
Every model is described with the same few dimensions
avoidWhen: 维度超过 4 个或要打分：用 CompareTable
结构示意和内容无关：用 PanelCards
avoidWhenEn: More than 4 dimensions or scores are needed: use CompareTable
The structure sketch is unrelated to the content: use PanelCards
limits: rows 2–4 行：label ≤ 4 字，value ≤ 16 字；各卡的 label 顺序一致
shape 只能是 tree / blocks / flat
limitsEn: rows 2–4: label ≤ 4 chars, value ≤ 16 chars; the label order is the same on every card
shape is only tree / blocks / flat
interaction: build: reveal 时每步出现一张卡
interactionEn: build: reveal — each step shows one card

props.name: kicker
props.note: 标题上方的小节名，2–8 字
props.noteEn: Small section label above the title, 2–8 chars

props.name: title
props.note: 页面标题；传数组可手动断行，每项一行
props.noteEn: Slide title; pass an array to break lines manually, one item per line

props.name: lead
props.noteEn: One or two lead sentences, ≤ 60 chars

props.name: source
props.note: 事实出处；页面上有任何数据或事实时必填
props.noteEn: Source for the facts; required when the slide contains data or claims

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉中间的操作提示，可用 <kbd>
props.noteEn: Action hint in the header centre; may use <kbd>

props.name: cards
props.type: { shape, name, tagline, rows: { label, value }[] }[]

example: <ParadigmCards kicker="先分清三种" title="块、文件、对象" focus={2} cards={[{ shape: 'blocks', name: '块存储', tagline: '…', rows: [{ label: '组织', value: '…' }] }, …]} source="…" />

name: 解剖卡
role: 结构 · 一个东西由几部分组成
roleEn: Structure · what one thing is made of
summary: 左边一张大卡被切成 2–4 条（等宽字体写示例值），右边是对应的说明；每按一次 → 点亮一条和它的说明。
summaryEn: A large card on the left is cut into 2–4 strips (example values in monospace); matching notes sit on the right; each press → light one strip and its note.

roleEn: AI · how text is cut into tokens
summary: 一句话被切成带序号的 token 小块，按组逐步出现，右上角显示总数；每组一种底色，下方一句说明。
