name: 上下文窗口
role: AI · 容量与长度标记
summary: 一条很长的容量条加刻度，几段长度从左边起逐步填进来（例如训练长度、最大输出、窗口上限），下方每段一个大数字和说明。
summaryEn: A long capacity bar with ticks; several spans fill in from the left step by step (for example training length, max output, window limit), each with a big number and a note below.
useWhen: 介绍上下文长度、最大输出、训练长度这些“从 0 起算”的长度
比较几种长度相差多少倍
useWhenEn: Introduce lengths measured from 0 such as context length, max output or training length
Compare how many times longer one span is than another
avoidWhen: 长度之间是并列而不是包含关系：用 BarChart
超过 4 段
avoidWhenEn: The lengths are parallel rather than nested: use BarChart
More than 4 spans
limits: spans 1–4 段，label ≤ 8 个字符，note ≤ 20 字
interaction: 每按一次 → 填入一段长度
interactionEn: Each press → fill in one more span

name: 评测矩阵
role: AI · 多个模型 × 多项评测
summary: 行是评测、列是模型，每格一个分数和一条按本行最高分缩放的细条；重点模型整列着色，每行最高分后面有一个圆点。逐行出现。
summaryEn: Rows are benchmarks and columns are models; each cell holds a score and a thin bar scaled to that row's top score; the focus model's column is coloured in, and the row's top score gets a dot. Rows appear one by one.
useWhen: 模型卡、技术报告里的对比表
同一组模型在 3–7 项评测上的高低
useWhenEn: Comparison tables from model cards or technical reports

avoidWhen: 只比两个模型：用 Dumbbell 或 DeltaBars
分数口径不同（子集、不同指标）却放在一行：先拆开或记为 —
avoidWhenEn: Only two models: use Dumbbell or DeltaBars
Scores with different definitions (subsets, different metrics) in one row: split them first or record them as —
limits: models 3–7 个，每个 ≤ 10 个字符
rows 3–7 行，name ≤ 16 个字符，metric ≤ 10 个字符
默认 1 位小数，可按行设 decimals
分数必须来自官方表格，source 里写明“自测”或评测方
limitsEn: 1 decimal place by default, decimals can be set per row
scores must come from the official table; source must state “self-run” or the evaluator
interaction: 每按一次 → 出现一行
interactionEn: Each press → one row appears

params.total、active 各 ≤ 4 位数字；activeLabel ≤ 6 字

interaction: 每按一次 → 出现一行规格

summary: 行是 token 类型（缓存命中、未命中、输出），列是档位或模型；每格一个价格和一条按对数刻度的条，相差百倍也看得清。重点列着色。

价格 ≤ 6 个字符（含小数点）
interaction: 每按一次 → 出现一行价格

avoidWhenEn: Real attention weights must be shown: this is an illustrative diagram, not a heatmap (use Heatmap)

需要 build: 'reveal'；不逐步时显示最后一种
limitsEn: size 8–16; window and stride are small integers
requires build: 'reveal'; without steps it shows the last pattern
interaction: → 换下一种掩码

limitsEn: windows 1–4, hours are numbers from 0 to 24

要比较各地数值：用 DotMap 或 BarChart
avoidWhenEn: Places spread over both sides of the globe: use DotMap

limits: 所有地点要在 center 朝向的半球，否则弧线绕到背面

limitsEn: All places must lie in the hemisphere that center faces, or the arcs run round the back

useWhen: 讲一段配置、SQL、脚本里的关键几行
每条说明对应明确的行
useWhenEn: The key lines of a config, SQL statement or script
Each note maps to a specific line
avoidWhen: 要对比改动：用 CodeDiff
要演示命令和输出：用 Terminal
avoidWhenEn: Comparing a change: use CodeDiff
Showing a command and its output: use Terminal
limits: code 4–12 行，每行 ≤ 52 个字符
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 点亮下一条说明和它对应的行；未讲到的行仍可读
interactionEn: In build mode, each press → the next note and its lines light up; lines not yet covered stay readable

name: 请求与响应
role: 技术 · 一次往返
summary: 左右两个代码窗：左边是发出的请求，右边是返回的响应，中间一条带标签的箭头，上面有光点从左跑到右。
summaryEn: Two code windows: the outgoing request on the left, the returned response on the right, with a labeled arrow between them and a light dot running left to right.
useWhen: 讲一次 API 调用、SQL 语句和返回、协议往返
请求和响应都能用几行文本表示
useWhenEn: One API call, an SQL statement and its return, a protocol round trip
Both request and response fit in a few lines of text
avoidWhen: 有多次往返或多方参与：用 SessionSequence
只有命令和输出、没有“两端”之分：用 Terminal
avoidWhenEn: Several round trips or several parties: use SessionSequence
Only a command and its output, with no two ends: use Terminal
limits: lines 2–9 行，每行 ≤ 36 个字符
interaction: 箭头和响应是一个 build 步骤；光点动画在减少动态效果和打印时关闭
interactionEn: The arrow and the response are one build step; the light dot stops under reduced motion and in print

name: 光束流向图
role: 技术 · 架构 · 多进一出
roleEn: Technology · Architecture · many in, one out
summary: 左列输入、中间一个枢纽、右列输出，用曲线相连，线上有光点沿方向流动，表示数据或请求的走向。
summaryEn: Inputs in the left column, one hub in the middle, outputs on the right, joined by curves with light dots moving along them to show where data or requests go.
useWhen: 讲一个枢纽连接多个来源和去处：网关、数据库进程、消息总线
方向比层级更重要
useWhenEn: One hub connecting several sources and destinations: a gateway, a database process, a message bus
Direction matters more than hierarchy
avoidWhen: 有分层关系：用 ArchLayers
有先后步骤：用 FlowDiagram
节点间是任意网状关系：用 NodeGraph
avoidWhenEn: There is a layered relation: use ArchLayers
There are sequential steps: use FlowDiagram
Nodes form an arbitrary mesh: use NodeGraph
limits: inputs、outputs 各 2–4 个；label ≤ 10 字或 ≤ 18 个字符；sub ≤ 14 字
limitsEn: inputs and outputs 2–4 each; label ≤ 10 chars or ≤ 18 characters; sub ≤ 14 chars
interaction: build 模式下依次出现：输入列、枢纽、输出列；光点动画在减少动态效果和打印时关闭
interactionEn: In build mode the input column, the hub and the output column appear in turn; the light dots stop under reduced motion and in print

name: 版本时间线
role: 技术 · 并发 · 一行数据的多个版本
roleEn: Technology · Concurrency · several versions of one row
summary: 一条事务号坐标轴上，每个版本是一段从 xmin 到 xmax 的横条，仍有效的版本用强调色；快照是一条竖虚线，下方注明它看到哪个版本。
summaryEn: On a transaction number axis each version is a bar from xmin to xmax, with versions still valid in the accent color; a snapshot is a dashed vertical line labeled below with the version it sees.
useWhen: 讲 MVCC、多版本、快照隔离
讲任何“同一对象在不同时段有不同值”的有效期
useWhenEn: MVCC, multiple versions, snapshot isolation
Any valid-time span where one object holds different values over time
avoidWhen: 版本超过 4 个
时间是真实日期且需要刻度精确：用 Gantt
avoidWhenEn: More than 4 versions
Time is real dates and the scale must be exact: use Gantt
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 出现一个版本，最后出现快照
interactionEn: In build mode, each press → one version appears, then the snapshot last

name: B 树查找
role: 技术 · 索引 · 查找路径
summary: 按层画出索引页和键，查找经过的页加强调色描边，命中的键反色；右栏每层一句说明。
summaryEn: Index pages and keys are drawn by level; pages on the lookup path get an accent outline and the matching key is inverted, with one note per level on the right.
useWhen: 讲 B-tree、跳表、分层目录这类逐层缩小范围的查找
要讲清“为什么快”
useWhenEn: Lookups that narrow the range level by level: B-tree, skip list, hierarchical directory
Explaining why it is fast
avoidWhen: 超过 3 层或每层超过 4 页
不是查找过程，只是层级：用 Pyramid 或 IssueTree
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 levels or more than 4 pages per level
Not a lookup but plain hierarchy: use Pyramid or IssueTree
limits: levels 2–3 层；每层 ≤ 4 页；每页 1–4 个键，每个 ≤ 5 个字符
limitsEn: levels 2–3; ≤ 4 pages per level; 1–4 keys per page, each ≤ 5 characters
notes one line per level, ≤ 30 chars
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 往下走一层
interactionEn: In build mode, each press → the lookup goes one level deeper

name: 文档与路径
role: 技术 · 数据 · 文档查询
summary: 左边深色窗里是缩进好的 JSON 文档，右边是几条路径表达式和它们的返回值；每一步标出该表达式取到的那几行。
summaryEn: An indented JSON document sits in a dark window on the left; on the right are a few path expressions with their returned values, and each step marks the lines that expression picks.
useWhen: 讲 JSON、YAML 配置的取值方式
讲 JSONB 运算符、JSONPath、jq 之类的路径语法
useWhenEn: How values are read from JSON or YAML config
Path syntax such as JSONB operators, JSONPath or jq
avoidWhen: 文档超过 13 行：只保留相关部分
要比较两份文档：用 CodeDiff
avoidWhenEn: The document exceeds 13 lines: keep only the relevant part
Comparing two documents: use CodeDiff
limits: queries 2–4 条：expr ≤ 40 个字符，result ≤ 24 个字符，note ≤ 20 字
limitsEn: queries 2–4: expr ≤ 40 characters, result ≤ 24 characters, note ≤ 20 chars
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 下一条查询出现，并点亮它取到的行
interactionEn: In build mode, each press → the next query appears and the lines it selects light up

name: 会话时序图
role: 技术 · 并发 · 谁先谁后
summary: 2–3 个会话各占一列，事件按时间从上往下排，左侧标 t1、t2…；等待用虚线框，最终结果用强调色。
summaryEn: 2–3 sessions each get a column, events run top to bottom in time order with t1, t2… on the left; waits use dashed boxes and the final result uses the accent color.
useWhen: 讲事务隔离、锁等待、竞态
讲两三方之间的调用先后
useWhenEn: Transaction isolation, lock waits, races
Call ordering between two or three parties
avoidWhen: 事件超过 7 个
只有一方：用 StepTrack 或 Timeline
要讲跨部门流程：用 Swimlane
avoidWhenEn: More than 7 events
Only one party: use StepTrack or Timeline
A process spanning teams: use Swimlane
limits: events 3–7 个：text ≤ 30 个字符，note ≤ 12 字
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 出现下一个事件
interactionEn: In build mode, each press → the next event appears

name: 徽标首屏
role: 开场 · 官网式首屏
summary: 居中的胶囊徽标（小节名 + 一句状态）、大标题、导语和 1–2 个画出来的按钮；一张宽图装在窗口里，从页面底边升起。
summaryEn: A centered pill badge (section name plus one status line), a large title, a lead and 1–2 drawn buttons; a wide image sits in a window that rises from the bottom edge.
useWhen: 介绍一个产品、项目或发行版的开场
有一张宽幅装饰插图或真实截图可放
useWhenEn: Opening a deck that introduces a product, project or release
A wide decorative illustration or real screenshot is available
avoidWhen: 没有图：用 Cover 或 Statement
按钮只是装饰，现场不能点；需要真实链接时写进 note 或结尾页
avoidWhenEn: No image: use Cover or Statement
The buttons are drawn only and cannot be clicked live; put a real link in note or on the closing slide
limits: title 1 行 ≤ 12 字（最多 2 行）
actions 1–2 个，label ≤ 10 字或 ≤ 18 个拉丁字符
image 宽图，上部是重点（只露出约 290u 高），credit ≤ 20 字
limitsEn: title 1 line ≤ 12 chars (2 lines at most)
actions 1–2, label ≤ 10 chars or ≤ 18 Latin characters
image a wide image whose top matters (about 290u of height shows), credit ≤ 20 chars

props.name: kicker
props.note: 徽标里的强调色小标签
props.noteEn: Small accent label inside the badge

props.name: note
props.noteEn: Small monospace text under the buttons

props.name: image
props.note: import 的 decor- 插图或真实截图
props.noteEn: An imported decor- illustration or a real screenshot

example: <BadgeHero kicker="介绍" badge="当前稳定版 · Fedora Linux 44" title="认识 Fedora Linux" lead="…" actions={[{ label: '从这里开始' }, { label: 'fedoraproject.org', kind: 'ghost' }]} image={{ src: hero, alt: '…', credit: '插图：AI 生成（装饰）' }} />

name: 标签切换区块
role: 展开 · 同一主题的几个侧面
roleEn: Expansion · several sides of one topic
summary: 一条横向标签栏，当前标签下有强调色下划线；下面一张大卡片显示当前标签的标题、说明、0–3 条要点，可在右侧放一个数字。每按一次 → 切到下一个标签。
summaryEn: A horizontal tab bar with an accent underline under the current tab; below it one large card shows the current tab's title, body and 0–3 points, with room for one number on the right. Each press → switch to the next tab.
useWhen: 一个过程或一个主题有 3–5 个并列侧面，想一次只讲一个
每个侧面内容差不多多
useWhenEn: A process or topic has 3–5 parallel sides and you want to cover one at a time
Each side has about the same amount of content
avoidWhen: 需要同时比较各项：用 Matrix 或 CompareTable
每个标签要配截图：用 TabbedShot
打印 / 总览只显示 open 指定的那一个标签，其他标签内容看不到
avoidWhenEn: Items must be compared at once: use Matrix or CompareTable
Each tab needs a screenshot: use TabbedShot
In print and in the overview only the tab set by open shows; the other tabs stay hidden
limits: tabs 3–5 个；tab ≤ 6 字或 ≤ 12 个拉丁字符
stat.value ≤ 8 个字符，stat.label ≤ 12 字；有 stat 时 points 最多 2 条
limitsEn: tabs 3–5; tab ≤ 6 chars or ≤ 12 Latin characters
stat.value ≤ 8 characters, stat.label ≤ 12 chars; with stat, points is at most 2
interaction: 配 build: 'focus'：每按一次 → 选中下一个标签并换内容
interactionEn: With build: 'focus', each press → the next tab is selected and the content changes

name: 版本挑选器
role: 选项 · 几个版本 / 方案逐个介绍
roleEn: Options · introducing a few editions or plans one by one
summary: 3–6 张单选卡片（每行 3 张）：图标、小标签、名称、说明和底部“适合”一行；右上角是单选圆点。选中的卡片描强调色边并打勾，每按一次 → 选中下一张。
summaryEn: 3–6 single-choice cards (3 per row): icon, tag, name, description and a fit line at the bottom, with a radio dot in the top right. The selected card gets an accent outline and a check; each press → the next card is selected.
useWhen: 产品的几个版本、套餐、发行版本，各有用途
想逐个讲“这一个适合谁”
useWhenEn: A product's editions, plans or releases, each with its own use
Going through them one by one, saying who each one fits
avoidWhen: 有价格要比：用 PricingTiers
选项超过 6 个：拆页或用 FilterChips
avoidWhenEn: Prices must be compared: use PricingTiers
More than 6 options: split the slide or use FilterChips
limits: name ≤ 12 个拉丁字符或 ≤ 8 字；tag ≤ 6 字
desc ≤ 40 字（6 个时 ≤ 30 字）
fit ≤ 24 字（6 个时 ≤ 14 字）
limitsEn: name ≤ 12 Latin characters or ≤ 8 chars; tag ≤ 6 chars
interaction: 配 build: 'focus'：每按一次 → 选中框移到下一张卡片
interactionEn: With build: 'focus', each press → the selection moves to the next card

name: 发布列车
role: 时间 · 版本生命周期重叠
summary: 每个版本一行：左边版本号、状态胶囊（已停止 / 维护中 / 最新版 / 测试版 / 开发中）和日期；右边一条从发布到停止维护的横条，按真实时间比例排；一条竖线标出今天。估计的结束日期用渐隐表示。
summaryEn: One row per version: version number, state pill (end of life / maintained / latest / beta / in development) and dates on the left; on the right a bar from release to end of maintenance on a true time scale, and a vertical line marks today. Estimated end dates fade out.
useWhen: 软件版本、产品代际的支持期重叠
想说明“现在有几个版本在维护”
useWhenEn: Support periods of software versions or product generations overlap
Showing how many versions are maintained right now
avoidWhen: 只有日期没有区间：用 Milestones
跨度超过 6 年：横条会太短，拆页
avoidWhenEn: Dates but no spans: use Milestones
A span over 6 years: the bars get too short, so split the slide
limits: version ≤ 10 个字符；note ≤ 20 个字符
start / end / from / until / today 写 YYYY-MM；跨度 18–48 个月最合适
估计的日期要标 estimate 并在 source 里说明
limitsEn: start / end / from / until / today are written YYYY-MM; a span of 18–48 months fits best
Dates that are estimates need estimate set and a note in source
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 出现一行

name: 导航大菜单
role: 总览 · 一个家族的分类
roleEn: Overview · the categories of one family
summary: 一条网站导航栏（左边文字品牌名、几个菜单项，其中一项展开），下面是展开的大菜单：2–4 列，每列一个等宽小标题和 2–5 个条目（名称 + 一行说明）。
summaryEn: A website navigation bar (a text brand name on the left, a few menu items, one of them expanded), with the expanded mega menu below: 2–4 columns, each column a monospaced heading and 2–5 entries (name + one-line description).
useWhen: 产品线、版本家族、文档目录这类“有几个大类、每类几项”的总览
想让观众像看官网菜单一样一眼看到全貌
useWhenEn: An overview with a few top categories and a few items in each, such as a product line, a version family or a documentation index
You want the audience to see the whole picture at a glance, the way a website menu shows it
avoidWhen: 每项要详细说明：用 IconGrid 或拆页
只有一层分类：用 Agenda 或 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: Each item needs a detailed explanation: use IconGrid or split the slide
There is only one level of categories: use Agenda or IconGrid

menu 3–6 项，每项 ≤ 6 字或 ≤ 10 个拉丁字符
items 每列 2–5 个；name ≤ 14 个字符，desc ≤ 16 字（4 列时 ≤ 10 字）
limitsEn: brand ≤ 10 characters, text only, no logo drawn
menu 3–6 items, each ≤ 6 chars or ≤ 10 Latin characters
items 2–5 per column; name ≤ 14 characters, desc ≤ 16 chars (4 columns: ≤ 10 chars)

interactionEn: In build mode, each press reveals one column

name: 路径面包屑
role: 关系 · 上下游与流转
summary: 一排箭头形面包屑（名称 + 等宽小字），最后一节（或 focus 指定的一节）填强调色；每节下方一张说明卡，用细线连着。
summaryEn: A row of arrow-shaped breadcrumbs (name + small monospaced text), with the last section (or the one set by focus) filled in the accent colour; a note card sits under each section, joined by thin lines.
useWhen: 上游到下游、源头到成品这种单向链条
3–5 个环节，每个环节一两句话
useWhenEn: A one-way chain such as upstream to downstream, or source to finished product
3–5 stages, one or two sentences each
avoidWhen: 有分叉或回路：用 FlowDiagram 或 NodeGraph
每步要写很多：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: The chain forks or loops: use FlowDiagram or NodeGraph
Each step needs a lot of text: use StepTrack
limits: label ≤ 8 字或 ≤ 14 个拉丁字符（5 个时 ≤ 10 个拉丁字符）
limitsEn: label ≤ 8 chars or ≤ 14 Latin characters (5 crumbs: ≤ 10 Latin characters)
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 一节面包屑和它的卡片一起出现
interactionEn: In build mode, each press reveals one breadcrumb section and its card together

name: 筛选胶囊
role: 分类 · 一组东西按标签筛
roleEn: Classification · filter one set by tag
summary: 上方一排筛选胶囊（带计数），下方 4–12 张小卡片；每按一次 → 选中下一个胶囊，属于它的卡片描边保留，其余变灰。一张卡可以属于多个胶囊。
summaryEn: A row of filter chips (with counts) above, 4–12 small cards below; each press selects the next chip, cards that belong to it keep their outline and the rest turn grey. One card can belong to several chips.
useWhen: 一组条目有交叉分类，想逐个说明“这一类有哪些”
条目多但每个只要一句话
useWhenEn: A set of items has overlapping categories and you want to go through them one group at a time
There are many items but each needs only one sentence
avoidWhen: 分类互不重叠且只有两三类：用 Matrix 或 IconGrid 分组
条目要详细说明：拆页
avoidWhenEn: Categories do not overlap and there are only two or three: use Matrix or group them with IconGrid
Items need a detailed explanation: split the slide
limits: chips 2–6 个，每个 ≤ 6 字或 ≤ 10 个拉丁字符
cards 4–12 张（每行 4 张）；title ≤ 16 个拉丁字符或 ≤ 8 字；desc ≤ 22 字（12 张时 ≤ 16 字）
in 写胶囊下标，至少 1 个
limitsEn: chips 2–6, each ≤ 6 chars or ≤ 10 Latin characters
cards 4–12 (4 per row); title ≤ 16 Latin characters or ≤ 8 chars; desc ≤ 22 chars (12 cards: ≤ 16 chars)
in holds the chip indexes, at least 1
interaction: 配 build: 'focus'：每按一次 → 切到下一个筛选，非本类卡片变灰
interactionEn: With build: 'focus': each press switches to the next filter and cards outside that group turn grey

name: 行动号召区块
role: 收尾 · 下一步做什么
summary: 整页一块强调色浅底的大圆角区块：左边小节名、大标题、导语、一个“复制框”（等宽地址或命令）和按钮；右边 2–4 个编号步骤卡，逐个出现。
summaryEn: One large rounded block in a light accent tint across the slide: on the left the kicker, the big title, the lead, a copy box (monospaced address or command) and buttons; on the right 2–4 numbered step cards that appear one by one.
useWhen: 讲完之后告诉听众怎么开始、去哪里、敲什么命令
有一个明确的地址或命令
useWhenEn: After the talk, tell the audience how to start, where to go and which command to run
There is one clear address or command
avoidWhen: 只想总结观点：用 Closing 或 Recap
步骤超过 4 个：用 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: You only want to sum up the point: use Closing or Recap
There are more than 4 steps: use StepTrack
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 出现一个步骤
interactionEn: In build mode, each press reveals one step

name: 页脚结束页
role: 结尾 · 资源与链接
summary: 像网站页脚的结束页：左上标题、导语和按钮，右上 2–4 列链接，底部一条细线（备注 + 出处）和一行贴着页面底边、渐隐的巨大文字。
summaryEn: A closing slide shaped like a website footer: title, lead and buttons at the top left, 2–4 link columns at the top right, a thin rule at the bottom (note + source) and a line of huge fading text sitting on the bottom edge of the slide.
useWhen: 最后一页列出文档、社区、下载等去处
主题有一个简短的西文名字可做底部大字
useWhenEn: The last slide lists places to go: documentation, community, downloads
The subject has a short Latin-script name for the big text at the bottom
avoidWhen: 要放提问或联系人：用 Thanks 或 ContactPanel
链接超过 15 条：只留最常用的
avoidWhenEn: You need questions or contacts: use Thanks or ContactPanel
There are more than 15 links: keep only the most used
limits: title 1–2 行，每行 ≤ 10 字；lead ≤ 40 字
columns 2–4 列：heading ≤ 8 字，links 2–5 条，每条 ≤ 26 个拉丁字符或 ≤ 13 字（4 列时 ≤ 18 个拉丁字符）
wordmark 3–10 个拉丁字符，只作装饰文字，不画 logo
limitsEn: title 1–2 lines, ≤ 10 chars per line; lead ≤ 40 chars
columns 2–4: heading ≤ 8 chars, links 2–5, each ≤ 26 Latin characters or ≤ 13 chars (4 columns: ≤ 18 Latin characters)
wordmark 3–10 Latin characters, decorative text only, no logo drawn
interaction: build 模式下每按一次 → 出现一列链接
interactionEn: In build mode, each press reveals one link column

name: 折叠问答
role: 问答 · 逐条展开
roleEn: Q&A · open one at a time
summary: 左边小节名、标题、导语和可选按钮；右边一列细线分隔的问题，每行编号、问题和圆形 +/− 按钮。一次只展开一条答案，每按一次 → 收起上一条、展开下一条。
summaryEn: Kicker, title, lead and optional buttons on the left; a column of questions divided by thin rules on the right, each row with a number, the question and a round +/− button. Only one answer is open at a time; each press closes the previous one and opens the next.
useWhen: 3–6 个常见问题，想一条一条讲
答案都短，一两句话
useWhenEn: 3–6 common questions you want to go through one by one
The answers are short, one or two sentences
avoidWhen: 想一次看全部问答：用 Faq
问题是步骤：用 ProcessAccordion 或 StepTrack
avoidWhenEn: You want all questions and answers at once: use Faq
The questions are steps: use ProcessAccordion or StepTrack
limits: items 3–6 个；q ≤ 24 字（一行 ≤ 18 字）
title 1–2 行，每行 ≤ 8 字；lead ≤ 50 字
打印 / 总览只展开 open 指定的一条
limitsEn: items 3–6; q ≤ 24 chars (≤ 18 chars on one line)
title 1–2 lines, ≤ 8 chars per line; lead ≤ 50 chars
Print and overview show only the one item set by open
interaction: 配 build: 'focus'：每按一次 → 展开下一条，上一条收起
interactionEn: With build: 'focus': each press opens the next item and closes the previous one

name: 小窗放大
role: 动效 · 一张截图或照片从小窗放大到整页
roleEn: Motion · a screenshot or photo grows from a small window to the full slide
summary: 截图先以小窗出现在标题旁，配 build: 'reveal' 时按一次 → 放大占满画面，标题让开，图上出现一句说明。跳页、截图和减少动态效果时直接显示放大后的画面。
summaryEn: The screenshot first appears as a small window next to the title; with build: 'reveal', one press expands it to fill the slide, the title steps aside and a caption appears over the image. When jumping to the slide, printing or with reduced motion, the expanded view is shown directly.
useWhen: 产品演示、案例：先让人认出画面，再看细节
一张图本身就是这一页的重点
useWhenEn: Product demos and cases: let people recognise the screen first, then look at the details
One image is the point of the slide
avoidWhen: 截图需要标注细节：用 Screenshot
主体贴近图片边缘：放大时会被裁掉
avoidWhenEn: The screenshot needs annotations: use Screenshot
The subject sits near the image edge and would be cropped when expanded
limits: src 是真实截图或标明来源的照片
limitsEn: src is a real screenshot or a photo with its source stated
interaction: 按 → 放大画面
interactionEn: Press → expand the image

props.name: caption
props.noteEn: One line over the image once it is expanded

<MediaExpand
  kicker="小窗放大"
  title={['先认出画面，', '再看清细节']}
  src={overview}
  alt="总览视图截图"
  caption="总览视图：所有页面按顺序排开"
/>

name: 散点成序
role: 动效 · 散乱的卡片逐个归位成一条路径
roleEn: Motion · scattered cards fall into place one by one along a path
summary: 4–6 张卡片先散乱倾斜地放着，配 build: 'reveal' 时每按一次 → 一张落到自己的位置，全部归位后连线出现。跳页时直接显示排好的路径。
summaryEn: 4–6 cards start scattered and tilted; with build: 'reveal', each press drops one card into its place, and once all are in place the connecting line appears. When jumping to the slide, the arranged path is shown directly.
useWhen: 把零散的事项理成有顺序的步骤
流程、方法论、准备清单
useWhenEn: Turn scattered items into ordered steps
A process, a method or a preparation checklist
avoidWhen: 步骤之间是循环：用 Cycle
每步需要详细说明：用 Process 类模板
avoidWhenEn: The steps loop: use Cycle
Each step needs a detailed explanation: use a Process template
interaction: 按 → 逐个归位
interactionEn: Press → cards fall into place one by one
example:
<ScatterOrder
  kicker="散点成序"
  title="一份演示从散乱的笔记开始"
  steps={[{ title: '收集事实', body: '…' }, { title: '写故事线', body: '…' }, { title: '配模板', body: '…' }, { title: '检查看图', body: '…' }]}
/>

name: 倾斜摆正
role: 动效 · 带透视的截图转正后逐条讲要点
roleEn: Motion · a screenshot in perspective straightens, then the points are covered one by one
summary: 左边标题和 2–3 条要点，右边一张截图带透视角度出场。配 build: 'reveal' 时第一次按 → 截图转正，之后每按一次出现一条要点。跳页时直接显示转正后的截图和全部要点。
summaryEn: Title and 2–3 points on the left, a screenshot entering at a perspective angle on the right. With build: 'reveal', the first press straightens the screenshot, and each press after that reveals one point. When jumping to the slide, the straightened screenshot and all points are shown directly.
useWhen: 软件、工具、控制台的界面介绍
先给整体印象，再讲 2–3 个看点
useWhenEn: Introducing the interface of software, a tool or a console
Give the overall impression first, then cover 2–3 highlights
avoidWhen: 要在截图上标位置：用 Screenshot
没有真实截图
avoidWhenEn: You need to mark positions on the screenshot: use Screenshot
There is no real screenshot
limitsEn: src must be a real screenshot
interaction: 按 → 摆正截图，再逐条出现要点
interactionEn: Press → straighten the screenshot, then reveal the points one by one
example:
<TiltShot
  kicker="倾斜摆正"
  title={['组件库：', '先看全貌再细读']}
  src={kit}
  alt="组件库页面截图"
  points={[{ title: '按位置分组', body: '…' }, { title: '每个模板带上限', body: '…' }]}
/>

name: 多图汇聚
role: 动效 · 几张图并排，汇聚成一张焦点图
roleEn: Motion · several images stand side by side, then converge into one focus image
summary: 3–4 张图先并排展示、各带一个标签。配 build: 'reveal' 时第一次按 → 它们向中间汇聚，焦点图放大到前面，其余叠在后面；第二次按出现说明。跳页时直接显示汇聚后的画面。
summaryEn: 3–4 images stand side by side, each with a label. With build: 'reveal', the first press brings them together, the focus image grows to the front and the others stack behind it; the second press shows the caption. When jumping to the slide, the converged view is shown directly.
useWhen: 几个页面或视图最后都落到一个结果
先展示范围，再聚焦到要讲的那一张
useWhenEn: Several screens or views all end in one result
Show the range first, then focus on the one to talk about
avoidWhen: 每张图都要细讲：用 Screenshot 或拆页
图片比例差别很大
avoidWhenEn: Every image needs detail: use Screenshot or split the slide
The images differ a lot in aspect ratio
limits: 截图当证据，照片只营造氛围
limitsEn: Screenshots are evidence; photos only set the mood
interaction: 按 → 汇聚到焦点图，再按出现说明
interactionEn: Press → converge on the focus image; press again to show the caption

props.name: focus
props.note: 最后放在前面的那张，默认 0
props.noteEn: Image placed in front at the end, default 0

props.name: caption
props.noteEn: Caption that appears on the second press

example:
<ConvergeShots
  kicker="多图汇聚"
  title="四个入口，一份演示"
  shots={[{ src: slide, alt: '…', label: '放映' }, { src: overview, alt: '…', label: '总览' }, { src: kit, alt: '…', label: '组件库' }]}
  caption="…"
/>

name: 逐段播放
role: 动效 · 视频按一次播一段，停在要讲的画面
roleEn: Motion · each press plays one segment and stops on the frame to talk about
summary: 左边一段视频，右边 2–4 个停点说明。配 build: 'reveal' 时每按一次 → 视频播到下一个停点暂停，对应说明出现。往回翻或跳页时直接显示停点画面；跳页、打印和减少动态效果时停在最后一个停点。
summaryEn: A video on the left, 2–4 stop notes on the right. With build: 'reveal', each press plays up to the next stop and pauses there, and the matching note appears. Going back or jumping to the slide shows the stop frame directly; when jumping to the slide, printing or with reduced motion it stops at the last stop.
useWhen: 操作录屏、动画图表，需要边放边讲
一段变化里有 2–4 个值得停下来的时刻
useWhenEn: A screen recording or an animated chart you want to talk over while it plays
A change with 2–4 moments worth stopping at
avoidWhen: 视频很长或很大：会内联进单个 HTML 文件
需要声音：视频固定静音
avoidWhenEn: The video is long or large: it is inlined into a single HTML file
You need sound: the video is always muted
limits: 视频建议 ≤ 15 秒、≤ 1 MB（先用 ffmpeg 截短压缩）
limitsEn: video ideally ≤ 15 s and ≤ 1 MB (trim and compress with ffmpeg first)
interaction: 按 → 播放到下一个停点，点击画面可重播当前段
interactionEn: Press → play to the next stop; click video to replay current segment

props.name: start
props.note: 第一次按之前显示的秒数，默认 0
props.noteEn: Seconds shown before the first press, default 0

props.name: muted
props.note: 默认静音（可点击切换有声）
props.noteEn: Start muted (toggleable via HUD), default true

example:
<StepVideo
  kicker="逐段播放"
  title="十年里，差距怎么拉开"
  src={race}
  label="各国太阳能发电量排名动画"
  stops={[{ at: 1, title: '2015 年', body: '…' }, { at: 4.4, title: '2021 年', body: '…' }]}
/>

name: 视频放映台
role: 动效 · 居中大画面完整播放带播控栏的产品录屏或解说视频
roleEn: Motion · full-width 16:9 video player with editorial controls
summary: 在单页居中呈现 16:9 完整视频，自带风格统一的播控栏：点击播放/暂停、进度条拖动、0.75×–2× 倍速、声音切换与全屏；离开页面或切后台自动暂停。
summaryEn: A centered 16:9 video stage with built-in play/pause, scrub bar, 0.75×–2× speed toggle, audio mute switch, and fullscreen. Automatically pauses when leaving the slide or switching tabs.
useWhen: 播放完整的产品演示录屏、带人声解说的视频或循环背景画面
演讲者需要现场随时暂停、拖动或切换倍速
useWhenEn: Full product walkthroughs, narrated demos, or looping ambient clips
Presenters who want live play/pause, scrubbing, and speed controls
avoidWhen: 需要按步骤逐段停顿讲解：改用 StepVideo
超大高清视频直接打包单文件 HTML（建议先用 ffmpeg 压缩或托管企业库流式播放）
avoidWhenEn: Step-by-step pauses synced to bullet notes: use StepVideo instead
Large multi-minute videos in offline single-file HTML (compress with ffmpeg or stream via Enterprise Vault)
interaction: 点击画面或底栏控制播放、拖动、倍速与全屏
interactionEn: Click frame or control bar to play/pause, scrub, adjust speed, or go fullscreen

props.name: src
props.note: 视频文件（import 或同源 URL）

props.name: autoplay
props.note: 进入本页自动播放，默认 false
props.noteEn: Autoplay on slide open, default false

props.name: muted
props.note: 初始静音状态（autoplay 时默认 true）
props.noteEn: Initial mute state (defaults to true when autoplay is set)

props.name: controls
props.note: 显示自定义播控栏，默认 true
props.noteEn: Show custom control bar, default true

example:
<VideoStage
  kicker="产品演示"
  title="十秒看懂核心工作流"
  src={demoMp4}
  label="产品端到端操作录屏"
  caption="支持点击暂停、进度条拖动、倍速与全屏放映"
/>

name: 展览封面
role: 开场 · 超大窄衬线标题加角落日期块
roleEn: Opening · a huge narrow serif title with a date block in the corner
summary: 超大标题占满左半页，右上角一块浅色日期块，底部 3–4 栏细线分隔的小字信息。为双年展风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: A huge title fills the left half, a light date block sits at the top right, and 3–4 columns of small text divided by thin rules run along the bottom. Designed for the biennale style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 展览、文化项目、年度回顾的第一页
主题是一个时间段或一届活动
useWhenEn: The first slide of an exhibition, a cultural project or an annual review
The subject is a period of time or one edition of an event
avoidWhen: 需要一个代表数字：用 Cover
标题超过 3 行
avoidWhenEn: You need one representative number: use Cover
The title is longer than 3 lines
limits: badge 1–2 行，每行 ≤ 10 个字符

props.name: badge
props.noteEn: Date block at the top right

example:
<ExhibitCover
  kicker="年度回顾"
  title={['太阳能的', '十年']}
  badge={['2015 —', '2025']}
  meta={[{ label: '数据', value: 'Our World in Data' }, …]}
/>

name: 数字配年份条
role: 数据 · 两个大数字配按年份的细条
roleEn: Data · two big numbers with thin bars by year
summary: 左边 1–2 个大数字（单位上标），右边 3–7 条按年份排的细横条，最新一年用强调色。为双年展风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: 1–2 big numbers on the left (unit as superscript), 3–7 thin horizontal bars ordered by year on the right, the latest year in the accent colour. Designed for the biennale style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 一个指标逐年增长，再配一两个结论数字
年度回顾、参观人数、营收
useWhenEn: One metric grows year by year, with one or two takeaway numbers
An annual review, visitor numbers or revenue
avoidWhen: 要比较多个系列：用 LineChart
年份超过 7 个：用 LineChart
avoidWhenEn: You are comparing several series: use LineChart
There are more than 7 years: use LineChart
limits: stats 1–2 个：value ≤ 5 字符，unit ≤ 3，label ≤ 12 字，body ≤ 24 字
limitsEn: stats 1–2: value ≤ 5 characters, unit ≤ 3, label ≤ 12 chars, body ≤ 24 chars

props.name: format
props.noteEn: Format of the number at the end of each bar

example:
<YearBars
  kicker="全球太阳能发电"
  title="十年涨到约 11 倍"
  stats={[{ value: '2,779', unit: 'TWh', label: '2025 年发电量' }]}
  bars={[{ year: '2015', value: 256 }, …]}
  source="…"
/>

name: 数字色块
role: 内容 · 3–4 块高色块，各带一个超大编号
roleEn: Content · 3–4 tall colour blocks, each with a huge number
summary: 一排高色块，每块上方一个超大编号，下方标题和一句说明。模印风格下是赭、品红、橙、青四色；其他风格用卡片色和强调色编号。配 build: 'reveal' 逐块出现。
summaryEn: A row of tall colour blocks, each with a huge number above and a title and one-line description below. In the stencil style the four colours are ochre, magenta, orange and cyan; other styles use the card colour and accent-coloured numbers. With build: 'reveal' the blocks appear one by one.
useWhen: 原则、规矩、阶段，3–4 条
每条一句话就能说清
useWhenEn: Principles, rules or phases, 3–4 of them
One sentence is enough for each
avoidWhen: 每条要展开讲：用 NumberedColumns
超过 4 条
avoidWhenEn: Each one needs a longer explanation: use NumberedColumns
There are more than 4
interaction: 按 → 逐块出现
interactionEn: Press → blocks appear one by one
example:
<NumberTiles
  kicker="规矩"
  title="先守规矩，再谈好看"
  tiles={[{ title: '只组合模板', body: '…' }, …]}
/>

name: 评分表
role: 对比 · 黑表头，每格一个彩色标签
roleEn: Comparison · a black header row, a coloured tag in every cell
summary: 2–4 个方案并列，3–5 条标准，每格是一个带色的短标签：good、mid、bad、plain 四种。为模印风格设计，其他风格也能用。配 build: 'reveal' 逐行出现。
summaryEn: 2–4 options side by side against 3–5 criteria, each cell a short coloured tag in one of four tones: good, mid, bad or plain. Designed for the stencil style; other styles work too. With build: 'reveal' the rows appear one by one.
useWhen: 几个方案按同一组标准打分
结论能写成两三个字
useWhenEn: Score a few options against the same criteria
The verdict fits in two or three characters
avoidWhen: 格子里要写一句话：用 CompareTable
只比较两项：用 Contrast
avoidWhenEn: A full sentence is needed in each cell: use CompareTable
Only two things are compared: use Contrast
interaction: 按 → 逐行出现
interactionEn: Press → rows appear one by one
example:
<ScoreTable
  kicker="三种出口"
  title="放映、PDF、PPTX 怎么选"
  columns={['HTML 放映', 'PDF', 'PPTX']}
  rows={[{ label: '离线打开', cells: [{ text: '可以', tone: 'good' }, …] }]}
/>

name: 数字拼格
role: 数据 · 长条、标题块、小数字块和大数字块拼成一页
roleEn: Data · a tall bar, a title block, small number tiles and a big number tile fit into one slide
summary: 左边一条竖长的强调色块放一个数字，中间是标题块，右上 2–3 个小数字块，右下一块大数字。为荧光格风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: A tall accent-coloured bar holding one number on the left, the title block in the middle, 2–3 small number tiles at the top right and one big number at the bottom right. Designed for the fluorescent grid style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 一页讲清一组相关数字
发布会、增长复盘的数据页
useWhenEn: Explain one set of related numbers on a single slide
A data slide for a launch or a growth review
avoidWhen: 数字之间没有主次：用 KpiBoard
需要趋势：用 LineChart
avoidWhenEn: The numbers have no main and secondary: use KpiBoard
You need a trend: use LineChart
limits: small 2–3 个：value ≤ 6 字符，label ≤ 14 字
example:
<MetricMosaic
  kicker="全球太阳能 · 2025"
  title={['十年，', '约十一倍']}
  side={{ value: '11×', label: '…' }}
  small={[{ value: '8.7%', label: '占全球发电' }]}
  hero={{ value: '2,779', label: '…' }}
  source="…"
/>

name: 下一步拼格
role: 收尾 · 大标题块加三块步骤
roleEn: Closing · a large title block plus three step blocks
summary: 上排一大块强调色标题和一块图案块，下排三块步骤（时间、标题、说明、小注），最后一块用深色。为荧光格风格设计，其他风格也能用。配 build: 'reveal' 逐块亮起。
summaryEn: The top row holds one large accent-coloured title block and one pattern block; the bottom row holds three step blocks (time, title, description, small note), the last one in dark. Designed for the fluorescent grid style; other styles work too. With build: 'reveal' the blocks light up one by one.
useWhen: 结尾的下一步、行动计划
三件事有先后
useWhenEn: Next steps or an action plan at the end
Three things that happen in order
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 3 个：用 Roadmap
只是总结要点：用 Closing
avoidWhenEn: There are more than 3 steps: use Roadmap
You are only summing up the points: use Closing
limits: when ≤ 8 字，title ≤ 10 字，body ≤ 40 字，meta ≤ 16 字符
limitsEn: when ≤ 8 chars, title ≤ 10 chars, body ≤ 40 chars, meta ≤ 16 characters
interaction: 按 → 逐块亮起
interactionEn: Press → blocks light up one by one
example:
<StepGrid
  kicker="下一步"
  title="三步做一份"
  steps={[{ when: '今天', title: '建一个项目', body: '…', meta: 'pcafe init' }, …]}
/>

name: 粗框数字
role: 数据 · 3–4 个粗边框数字盒
roleEn: Data · 3–4 number boxes with heavy borders
summary: 一排粗黑边框、硬投影的数字盒，右上角一个主题色圆点。为粗框风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: A row of number boxes with thick black borders and hard shadows, each with a theme-coloured dot in the top-right corner. Designed for the block frame style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 3–4 个并列的关键数字
活动、产品、项目的规模一览
useWhenEn: 3–4 key numbers side by side
An overview of the size of an event, a product or a project
avoidWhen: 数字需要解释：用 KpiBoard
只有一个数字：用 BigStat
avoidWhenEn: The numbers need explanation: use KpiBoard
There is only one number: use BigStat
example:
<FramedStats
  kicker="一眼看全"
  title="这个引擎里有什么"
  stats={[{ value: '251', label: '个模板' }, …]}
  source="…"
/>

name: 分栏索引
role: 内容 · 两栏编号条目，细线分隔
roleEn: Content · numbered entries in two columns, divided by thin rules
summary: 4–6 条编号条目分成左右两栏，每条有标题和一句说明，条目之间用细线分隔，标题用主题色。为索引风格设计，其他风格也能用。配 build: 'reveal' 逐条出现。
summaryEn: 4–6 numbered entries split into two columns, each with a title and a one-line description, separated by thin rules, with the titles in the theme colour. Designed for the index style; other styles work too. With build: 'reveal' the entries appear one by one.
useWhen: 目录、索引、六个入口
几个并列的主题，每个一句话
useWhenEn: A contents list, an index or six entry points
A few parallel topics, one sentence each
avoidWhen: 条目有先后顺序：用 Process 类模板
每条要展开：拆页
avoidWhenEn: The entries have an order: use a Process template
Each entry needs more room: split the slide
interaction: 按 → 逐条出现
interactionEn: Press → entries appear one by one

props.name: entries
props.noteEn: Entries, left column first, then the right

example:
<IndexList
  kicker="文档目录"
  title="文档里的六个入口"
  entries={[{ title: '写作流程', body: '…' }, …]}
/>

name: 议程拼块
role: 开场 · 五个议题拼成大小不一的色块
roleEn: Opening · five topics as colour blocks of different sizes
summary: 一块深色高块放第一个议题，其余四个分成主题色、纸色和浅主题色小块，每块有编号、标题和小标签。为林间风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: One tall dark block holds the first topic; the other four are smaller blocks in the theme colour, the paper colour and a light theme colour, each with a number, a title and a small tag. Designed for the forest style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 开场后的议程页，正好五个议题
useWhenEn: An agenda slide right after the opening, with exactly five topics
avoidWhen: 议题不是五个：用 Agenda 或 PillAgenda
议题需要说明：用 Agenda
avoidWhenEn: There are not five topics: use Agenda or PillAgenda
The topics need descriptions: use Agenda

props.name: aside
props.noteEn: Small text right of the title

example:
<AgendaMosaic
  kicker="议程"
  title="今天讲五件事"
  items={[{ title: '为什么用模板写演示', tag: '背景' }, …]}
/>

name: 方法步骤
role: 流程 · 深浅交替的编号步骤卡
roleEn: Process · numbered step cards alternating dark and light
summary: 3–4 张步骤卡，深色和纸色交替，每张一个大编号、标题、说明，底部一行写谁来做、产出什么。为翡翠风格设计，其他风格也能用。配 build: 'reveal' 逐张亮起。
summaryEn: 3–4 step cards alternating dark and paper colour, each with a big number, a title and a description, and a bottom line saying who does it and what it produces. Designed for the emerald style; other styles work too. With build: 'reveal' the cards light up one by one.
useWhen: 固定的工作方法、协作流程
每一步要写清谁负责
useWhenEn: A fixed way of working or a collaboration process
Each step needs to name who owns it
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 4 个：用 Roadmap
步骤之间是循环：用 Cycle
avoidWhenEn: There are more than 4 steps: use Roadmap
The steps loop: use Cycle
interaction: 按 → 逐张亮起
interactionEn: Press → cards light up one by one
example:
<MethodSteps
  kicker="工作方法"
  title="做一份演示的四步"
  steps={[{ title: '列故事线', body: '…', who: '作者', when: '大纲' }, …]}
/>

name: 三栏重点
role: 内容 · 三根通栏，超大编号，一栏用主题色
roleEn: Content · three full-height columns, huge numbers, one column in the theme colour
summary: 大标题下一条粗线，下面三根通到底的栏，每栏一个超大编号、标签、标题和说明，其中一栏整块用主题色。为宣言风格设计，其他风格也能用。配 build: 'reveal' 逐栏出现。
summaryEn: A thick rule under the big title, then three full-height columns below, each with a huge number, a tag, a title and a description, with one column filled in the theme colour. Designed for the manifesto style; other styles work too. With build: 'reveal' the columns appear one by one.
useWhen: 三条优先事项、底线、承诺
动员、宣言、季度重点
useWhenEn: Three priorities, bottom lines or commitments
A rallying talk, a manifesto or quarterly priorities
avoidWhen: 不是正好三条：用 NumberedColumns
需要数据支撑：用 KpiBoard
avoidWhenEn: There are not exactly three: use NumberedColumns
Numbers are needed: use KpiBoard
limitsEn: tag ≤ 6 chars, title ≤ 10 chars, body ≤ 40 chars
interaction: 按 → 逐栏出现
interactionEn: Press → columns appear one by one

props.name: focus
props.note: 主题色那一栏，默认 1（中间）
props.noteEn: Column in the theme colour, default 1 (middle)

example:
<PriorityColumns
  kicker="底线"
  title={['写演示的', '三条底线']}
  items={[{ tag: '版式', title: '只组合模板', body: '…' }, …]}
/>

name: 章节大数字
role: 分隔 · 超大章节号配短标题
roleEn: Section break · a huge chapter number with a short title
summary: 左边一个发光的超大章节号，右边短标题和一段说明，底部左右各一行小字。为夜粉风格设计（深色），其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: A glowing huge chapter number on the left, a short title and a paragraph on the right, and one line of small text at each bottom corner. Designed for the night pink style (dark); other styles work too.
useWhen: 章节开头
长演示里给听众一个位置感
useWhenEn: The start of a chapter
Give the audience a sense of place in a long deck
avoidWhen: 章节没有编号：用 SectionBreak
需要列出本章要点：用 ChapterProgress
avoidWhenEn: The chapter has no number: use SectionBreak
You need to list the chapter's key points: use ChapterProgress
limits: foot 两项，各 ≤ 16 个字符

props.name: foot
props.noteEn: Two lines of small text at the bottom

example:
<ChapterNumber
  kicker="第二章"
  num="02"
  title={['一个文件，', '到哪都能放']}
  body="…"
/>

name: 阶梯层级
role: 结构 · 一层层错开的横条
roleEn: Structure · horizontal bars offset layer by layer
summary: 3–6 条横条从上到下逐层向右错开，颜色从主题色逐渐变深，每条左边名称、右边一句说明。为号外风格设计，其他风格也能用。配 build: 'reveal' 逐层出现。
summaryEn: 3–6 horizontal bars offset to the right layer by layer from top to bottom, the colour deepening from the theme colour, each with a name on the left and one line of description on the right. Designed for the broadside style; other styles work too. With build: 'reveal' the layers appear one by one.
useWhen: 分层结构：技术栈、组织层级、优先级
上层依赖下层的关系
useWhenEn: A layered structure: a technology stack, an organisation hierarchy or priorities
Layers that depend on the ones below
avoidWhen: 层与层之间有数量关系：用 Funnel 或 Pyramid
每层要详细说明：用 LayerStack
avoidWhenEn: The layers have a quantity relationship: use Funnel or Pyramid
Each layer needs a detailed explanation: use LayerStack
interaction: 按 → 逐层出现
interactionEn: Press → layers appear one by one
example:
<StackBars
  kicker="分层"
  title="一份演示由五层叠成"
  layers={[{ name: '内容', note: 'src/decks 里的 deck 文件' }, …]}
/>

name: 对话演示
role: 拟真界面 · 用一段对话展示怎么用
roleEn: Realistic UI · show how it works through a short conversation
summary: 左边标题、导语和 0–3 条小注，右边一个手搓的聊天窗口，最后一条回复可以带结果卡片。窗口上始终标着「示意界面」。配 build: 'reveal' 时每按一次 → 出现一条消息。
summaryEn: Title, lead and 0–3 notes on the left; a hand-built chat window on the right, where the last reply can carry a result card. The window always carries the label 'illustrative interface'. With build: 'reveal', each press reveals one message.
useWhen: 工具、助手、客服类产品：展示一次典型的交互
比列功能更直观的场合
useWhenEn: A tool, an assistant or a support product: show one typical interaction
When that is clearer than listing features
avoidWhen: 有真实截图：用 Screenshot 或 TiltShot
对话超过 5 条：拆页
avoidWhenEn: You have a real screenshot: use Screenshot or TiltShot
There are more than 5 messages: split the slide
limits: app 不用真实品牌名，除非是你自己的产品
limitsEn: app does not use a real brand name unless it is your own product
source states that it is illustrative
interaction: 按 → 逐条出现对话
interactionEn: Press → messages appear one by one

props.name: messages
props.type: { from: 'user' | 'bot', text, card?: { title, rows: [label, value][] } }[]

props.name: label
props.note: 窗口标签，默认「示意界面」

example:
<ChatDemo

quota optional: label ≤ 6 chars, value ≤ 10 characters, pct 0–100
interaction: 点击：切换计费周期，价格一起变
interactionEn: Click: switches the billing period and every price

props.name: save
props.note: 第二个周期旁的优惠说明
props.noteEn: Saving note next to the second period

props.name: plans
props.type: { name, price, body, items, quota?, cta, hot?, badge? }[]
props.note: 三档套餐；price 对应两个周期，quota 是按钮上方的额度条
props.noteEn: Three plans; price holds one value per period, quota is an allowance bar above the button

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉提示，例如“点按月 / 按年切换”
props.noteEn: Header hint, e.g. "Click monthly / yearly to switch"

example: <GlowPricing kicker="价格" title="按需选择，随时升级" periods={['按月', '按年']} save="省 20%" plans={[{ name: '入门', price: ['¥99', '¥79'], body: '…', items: ['…'], cta: '选择入门' }, …]} />

name: 三步演示卡
role: 操作 · 三步上手
summary: 三张步骤卡，每张上半部分演示这一步：照片像相纸一样一张张发下来；风格选择器可以当场点选；最后是成片。下面写步骤号、标题和一句话。
summaryEn: Three step cards whose top half acts out the step: photos dealt like prints, a style picker you can tap on the slide, and the finished picture. Step number, title and one line underneath.
useWhen: 产品上手只需要三步
想让观众看到每一步长什么样
useWhenEn: Getting started takes three steps
The audience should see what each step looks like
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 3 个：用 StepTrack 或 UiSteps
步骤没有画面：用 NumberedColumns
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 steps: use StepTrack or UiSteps
Steps have no visuals: use NumberedColumns
limits: steps 正好 3 个：label ≤ 8 个字符，title ≤ 9 字，body ≤ 24 字
picked ≤ 10 字，{n} 换成已选数量
limitsEn: steps exactly 3: label ≤ 8 characters, title ≤ 9 chars, body ≤ 24 chars
picked ≤ 10 chars, {n} becomes the number picked
interaction: 点击：第二张卡里的选项可以选中或取消
interactionEn: Click: options in the second card toggle on and off

props.name: picked
props.note: 选择卡上的实时计数，例如“已选 {n} 种”
props.noteEn: Live count on the picker, e.g. "{n} picked"

example: <StepTrio kicker="三步完成" title="上传、选风格、拿成片" steps={[…]} inputs={{ images: [a, b, c] }} options={[{ image: x, label: '光影', on: true }, …]} result={{ image: y, chip: '4K' }} />

name: 拖动前后对比
role: 对比 · 处理前后
summary: 左边标题、导语和 2–4 行参数；右边一张竖幅对比图，中间的把手可以拖动（也能用方向键），看处理前后的差别。
summaryEn: A title, a lead and 2–4 spec rows on the left; a portrait comparison on the right whose middle handle can be dragged (or moved with the arrow keys) to see before and after.
useWhen: 同一画面处理前后的对比
要观众亲手拖一下才有说服力
useWhenEn: Before and after of the same frame
It convinces best when someone drags it themselves
avoidWhen: 两张图不是同一构图：用 BeforeAfter
横图对比：用 CompareSlider
avoidWhenEn: The two images are framed differently: use BeforeAfter
Landscape comparison: use CompareSlider
limits: specs 2–4 行：label ≤ 8 字，value ≤ 12 个字符
两张图构图一致，用竖图
limitsEn: Both images framed the same, portrait
interaction: 拖动或方向键：移动分隔线
interactionEn: Drag or arrow keys: moves the divider

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉提示，例如“拖动把手对比”

example: <RevealCompare kicker="前后对比" title={['还是你，', '只是更好看。']} before={{ src: a, alt: '…' }} after={{ src: b, alt: '…' }} labels={['原图', '处理后']} />

name: 照片墙收尾
role: 收尾 · 行动号召
summary: 满屏倾斜的照片墙，一列向上、一列向下缓缓滚动；中央压暗，放标题、一句话、按钮和小字。
summaryEn: A tilted wall of photos filling the slide, columns drifting slowly up and down; the centre is darkened for the title, one line, buttons and a small note.
useWhen: 最后一页，用大量成果给人“已经很多人在用”的感觉
作品、头像、海报这类适合成墙的图
useWhenEn: Last slide, showing lots of results to suggest many people already use it
Work, portraits or posters that make a good wall
avoidWhen: 图片少于 6 张：用 PhotoClosing
要留联系方式：用 ContactPanel
avoidWhenEn: Fewer than 6 images: use PhotoClosing
You need contact details: use ContactPanel
limits: ctas 每个 ≤ 8 字；note ≤ 20 字
interaction: 照片墙持续上下滚动
interactionEn: The wall keeps drifting up and down
example: <WallClose title={['下一张头像，', '交给夜拍。']} ctas={['生成我的照片', '看价格']} images={[a, b, c, d, e, f]} />

name: 晨光开场
role: 开场 · SaaS 首页
summary: 页面顶部一团暖黄晨光：上面一条模拟导航，中间居中的大标题、导语和两个按钮，两位协作者的光标在左右页边漂动，底边升起一块仪表盘（完成度圆弧、柱状趋势、团队头像和任务）。
summaryEn: A warm yellow sunrise glow across the top: a mock nav bar, a centred title, lead and two buttons, two teammates' cursors drifting in the side margins, and a dashboard rising from the bottom edge (completion arc, bar trend, team faces and tasks).
useWhen: SaaS、模板、协作工具的第一页
想一开场就让人看到产品界面
useWhenEn: First slide for a SaaS product, template kit or collaboration tool
You want the product UI visible from the start
avoidWhen: 没有产品界面可展示：用 Cover
要放真实截图：用 HeroPanel 或 DeviceFrame
avoidWhenEn: No product UI to show: use Cover
You have real screenshots: use HeroPanel or DeviceFrame
limits: brand ≤ 10 个字符；links ≤ 4 个 × ≤ 4 字；navCta ≤ 6 字
lead ≤ 30 字；ctas 每个 ≤ 6 字
dash.gauge.value 0–100；trend.values 6–12 个；team.faces ≤ 5 张，tasks 2 条（title ≤ 8 字，status ≤ 3 字）
limitsEn: brand ≤ 10 characters; links ≤ 4 × ≤ 4 chars; navCta ≤ 6 chars
dash.gauge.value 0–100; trend.values 6–12; team.faces ≤ 5, tasks 2 (title ≤ 8 chars, status ≤ 3 chars)
interaction: 光标在页边持续漂动；悬停柱子和头像有反馈
interactionEn: Cursors keep drifting in the margins; bars and faces react on hover

props.name: brand
props.noteEn: Product name in the mock nav

props.name: cursors
props.note: 左右两个协作者光标的名字
props.noteEn: Names on the two teammate cursors

props.name: dash
props.noteEn: The three dashboard cards along the bottom

example: <SunriseHero brand="拾页" title={['几天，而不是几周，', '上线你的 SaaS 官网']} ctas={['获取模板', '看全部示例']} cursors={['小周', '你']} dash={{ gauge: { label: '本周完成度', value: 68 }, trend: { label: '任务完成趋势', values: [40, 62, 48, 80] }, team: { label: '团队', faces: [a, b], tasks: [{ title: '首页动效', status: '待评审' }] } }} />

name: 数字便当格
role: 产品 · 内容清单
summary: 三格便当：上面两张大数字卡，右半边分别画着叠起的页面和区块拼版；下面一张通栏卡，左边说明，右边是一块深色设计画布，排着几个页面画板。
summaryEn: A three-cell bento: two big-figure cards on top whose right halves sketch stacked pages and a block layout, and a full-width card below with copy at the left and a dark design canvas of page frames at the right.
useWhen: 讲清一套产品“里面有什么”
模板、组件库、设计系统的内容总览
useWhenEn: Showing what a product contains
Content overview for a template kit, component library or design system
avoidWhen: 数字超过 2 个：用 NumberTiles 或 StatRow
要放真实截图：用 Bento
avoidWhenEn: More than 2 figures: use NumberTiles or StatRow
You have real screenshots: use Bento
limits: title 可选，1 行 ≤ 14 字
stats 正好 2 个：value ≤ 4 个字符，label ≤ 6 字，body ≤ 22 字
wide.title ≤ 10 字，body ≤ 30 字，frames 4–6 个 × ≤ 4 字
limitsEn: stats exactly 2: value ≤ 4 characters, label ≤ 6 chars, body ≤ 22 chars
wide.title ≤ 10 chars, body ≤ 30 chars, frames 4–6 × ≤ 4 chars
interaction: 悬停：页面草图散开，画板上浮
interactionEn: Hover: page sketches spread out, frames lift

props.name: wide
props.note: 通栏卡和画布上的画板名
props.noteEn: Full-width card and the frame names on its canvas

example: <KitBento stats={[{ value: '19', label: '独立页面', body: '…' }, { value: '62+', label: '区块与组件', body: '…' }]} wide={{ title: '附带设计源文件', body: '…', frames: ['首页', '定价', '博客', '关于'] }} />

name: 三套首页
role: 产品 · 方案并列
summary: 居中标题下三张卡，每张里是一幅首页草图（图表、日历、深色页脚三种），下面写名称和一句说明。悬停时草图像网页一样往下滚，点击选中一张。
summaryEn: Three cards under a centred title, each holding a homepage sketch (chart, calendar or dark footer) with a name and one line underneath. Hover and the sketch scrolls like a web page; click to pick one.
useWhen: 同一产品的三种版本或三套方案
模板、主题、套餐的外观对比
useWhenEn: Three versions or plans of one product
Comparing the look of templates, themes or packages
avoidWhen: 要放真实截图：用 Screenshot 或 ShelfGallery
超过 3 个方案：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: You have real screenshots: use Screenshot or ShelfGallery
More than 3 options: use IconGrid
limits: items 正好 3 个：name ≤ 10 字，note ≤ 18 字，variant 为 chart / calendar / dark
limitsEn: items exactly 3: name ≤ 10 chars, note ≤ 18 chars, variant chart / calendar / dark
interaction: 悬停：草图滚动；点击：选中这一张
interactionEn: Hover: the sketch scrolls; click: picks that card

props.name: picked
props.note: 一开始选中第几张，默认 0

props.name: pickedLabel
props.note: 选中卡片右上角的小标签
props.noteEn: Small label on the picked card

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉提示，例如“悬停看整页，点击选中”
props.noteEn: Header hint, e.g. "Hover to scroll, click to pick"

example: <HomeTrio title="3 套首页" items={[{ name: '首页 1 · 任务管理', variant: 'chart' }, { name: '首页 2 · 团队协作', variant: 'calendar' }, { name: '首页 3 · 远程团队', variant: 'dark' }]} pickedLabel="已选" />

name: 可玩的看板
role: 产品 · 交互演示
summary: 左边小标签、标题、导语和几条打勾要点；右边一块任务看板：顶部视图切换和成员头像，协作者光标在视图标签上滑动；三列任务卡，点一下卡片就移到下一列，计数跟着变；每列底部是虚线“添加任务”位。
summaryEn: A pill, title, lead and ticked points on the left; a task board on the right with view tabs and member faces on top, a teammate cursor gliding over the tabs, and three columns of cards. Click a card and it moves to the next column while the counts update; each column ends in a dashed "add task" slot.
useWhen: 演示任务、工单、流程类产品的核心操作
想让观众现场点一点
useWhenEn: Showing the core action of a task, ticket or workflow product
The audience should be able to click it live
avoidWhen: 流程是线性的步骤：用 StepTrack
要放真实截图：用 DeviceFrame
avoidWhenEn: The process is linear steps: use StepTrack
You have real screenshots: use DeviceFrame
limits: columns 正好 3 列：name ≤ 4 字，每列 1–3 张卡
卡片：tag ≤ 4 字，title ≤ 12 字，due ≤ 8 个字符，progress 0–100
limitsEn: columns exactly 3: name ≤ 4 chars, 1–3 cards each
cards: tag ≤ 4 chars, title ≤ 12 chars, due ≤ 8 characters, progress 0–100
interaction: 点击：任务卡移到下一列，计数更新；视图标签可切换
interactionEn: Click: a card moves to the next column and counts update; view tabs switch

props.name: columns
props.note: 三列任务；count 是初始显示的数量，最后一列是“完成”
props.noteEn: Three columns; count is the starting number shown, the last column is "done"

props.name: cursor
props.note: 在视图标签上滑动的协作者光标
props.noteEn: Teammate cursor gliding over the tabs

props.name: doneLabel
props.note: 完成卡片上的字，默认“✓ 已完成”
props.noteEn: Text on finished cards; the default is a Chinese "done" label

props.name: addLabel
props.note: 每列底部空位的字，默认“+ 添加任务”
props.noteEn: Text in each column's empty slot; the default is a Chinese "add task" label

props.name: faces
props.note: 看板右上角的成员头像
props.noteEn: Member faces at the top right of the board

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉提示，例如“点任务卡，它会移到下一列”
props.noteEn: Header hint, e.g. "Click a card to move it"

example: <KanbanDemo title={['拖一下，', '进度就更新了']} points={['…']} views={['看板', '列表', '日历']} cursor="小周" columns={[{ name: '待办', cards: [{ tag: '设计', title: '定价页改版', due: '11 月 12 日' }] }, { name: '进行中', cards: [{ tag: '开发', title: '接入支付回调', progress: 40 }] }, { name: '完成', count: 12, cards: [] }]} />

name: 口碑拼图
role: 客户 · 评价与口碑
summary: 居中标题下的拼图：左边一张深色大引言卡，右半是人像；右侧上方一块晨光黄的大数字，下面两张短评卡，每张带星级、一个量化结果小标签和头像署名。
summaryEn: A mosaic under a centred title: a large dark quote card with a portrait in its right half; on the right, a sun-yellow headline figure above two short quote cards, each with a star rating, a measured result chip and a signed face.
useWhen: 客户评价、用户口碑页
既有一句重磅引言、又有一个总量数字
useWhenEn: Customer quotes and reviews
You have one strong quote and one headline total
avoidWhen: 只有一条引言：用 QuoteHero 或 QuoteArc
评价超过 3 条：用 QuoteWall
avoidWhenEn: Only one quote: use QuoteHero or QuoteArc
More than 3 quotes: use QuoteWall
limits: quote.text ≤ 48 字，name ≤ 6 字，role ≤ 16 个字符，人像竖图
stat.value ≤ 7 个字符，label ≤ 2 行 × 6 字
items 正好 2 条：text ≤ 30 字，name ≤ 4 字，role ≤ 16 个字符；result 可选（value ≤ 6 个字符，label ≤ 8 字）
limitsEn: quote.text ≤ 48 chars, name ≤ 6 chars, role ≤ 16 characters, portrait image
items exactly 2: text ≤ 30 chars, name ≤ 4 chars, role ≤ 16 characters; result optional (value ≤ 6 characters, label ≤ 8 chars)
interaction: 悬停：人像微放大，短评卡上浮
interactionEn: Hover: the portrait zooms a little, short cards lift

props.name: stars
props.noteEn: Star rating on the short cards, 1–5, default 5

example: <ProofMosaic title="用过的团队都说好" quote={{ text: '…', name: '许宁', role: '联合创始人', image: p }} stat={{ value: '2,400+', label: ['团队用它', '上线了官网'] }} items={[{ text: '…', name: '韩东', role: '前端负责人', result: { value: '-60%', label: '对稿时间' } }, …]} />

name: 买断价格
role: 定价 · 两档加收尾
roleEn: Pricing · two plans and a close
summary: 两张套餐卡加一张晨光黄收尾卡：套餐卡里有价格、一句话、勾选清单和两格关键数字，点一下切换选中；收尾卡写一句号召、说明、一排头像和使用人数，底部黑色按钮。
summaryEn: Two plan cards and a sun-yellow closing card: each plan has a price, one line, a ticked list and two key facts in boxes, and clicking switches the picked plan; the closing card carries a call to action, a note, a row of faces with a user count and a black button.
useWhen: 一次性买断、两档套餐的价格页
想把价格和最后的号召放在同一页
useWhenEn: One-time purchase with two plans
Price and final call to action on the same slide
avoidWhen: 订阅制、要切换月付年付：用 GlowPricing 或 PricingTiers
超过 2 档：用 PricingTiers
avoidWhenEn: Subscription with monthly / yearly: use GlowPricing or PricingTiers
More than 2 plans: use PricingTiers
limits: plans 正好 2 个：name ≤ 4 字，price ≤ 6 个字符，unit ≤ 4 字，body ≤ 20 字，items 3–4 条 × ≤ 10 字，facts 2 格（label ≤ 4 字，value ≤ 6 字），cta ≤ 6 字，badge ≤ 3 字
close.title ≤ 2 行 × 6 字，body ≤ 36 字，points 2–3 条 × ≤ 12 字，count.value ≤ 7 个字符，count.label ≤ 6 字，cta ≤ 6 字
limitsEn: plans exactly 2: name ≤ 4 chars, price ≤ 6 characters, unit ≤ 4 chars, body ≤ 20 chars, items 3–4 × ≤ 10 chars, facts 2 (label ≤ 4 chars, value ≤ 6 chars), cta ≤ 6 chars, badge ≤ 3 chars
close.title ≤ 2 lines × 6 chars, body ≤ 36 chars, points 2–3 × ≤ 12 chars, count.value ≤ 7 characters, count.label ≤ 6 chars, cta ≤ 6 chars
interaction: 点击：切换选中的套餐，按钮变成主题色
interactionEn: Click: switches the picked plan, its button turns the theme colour

props.name: plans
props.type: { name, price, unit?, body?, items, facts?, cta, badge? }[]
props.note: 两档套餐；有 badge 的一档初始选中
props.noteEn: Two plans; the one with a badge starts picked

props.name: close
props.type: { title, body?, points?, faces?, count?, cta }

props.name: hint
props.note: 页眉提示，例如“点套餐卡切换选中”
props.noteEn: Header hint, e.g. "Click a plan to pick it"

example: <BuyoutPricing title="一次买断，永久使用" plans={[{ name: '个人版', price: '¥299', unit: '一次性', items: ['…'], cta: '购买个人版' }, { name: '团队版', price: '¥899', badge: '推荐', items: ['…'], cta: '购买团队版' }]} close={{ title: ['今天开始，', '周末上线。'], cta: '免费预览' }} />

name: 作品轨开场
role: 开场 · 个人作品集首页
summary: 左边一栏：绿点状态胶囊、头像和邮箱、灰黑两行的大标题、导语和两枚按钮，底边一排技能胶囊；右边一列白框作品图，第二张从下边露出一截。点右侧刻度，整列图像胶片一样上下滑到那一张。为作品轨风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: A text column on the left with a status pill and green dot, avatar and email, a two-tone grey and black title, a lead, two buttons and a row of skill chips; a rail of white-framed work on the right, the second frame peeking in at the bottom. Clicking a tick slides the rail like film to that frame. Made for the folio style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 产品设计师、独立设计师、自由职业者作品集的第一页
想让人一开场就看到人和作品
useWhenEn: First slide of a product designer, freelancer or solo portfolio
You want the person and the work visible from the start
avoidWhen: 没有 2 张以上作品图：用 Cover 或 PhotoCover
团队或机构介绍：用 AtelierHero
avoidWhenEn: Fewer than 2 work images: use Cover or PhotoCover
A team or agency: use AtelierHero
limits: pre 和 title 各 ≤ 6 字
interaction: 点击：右侧刻度让作品列上下滑动；状态绿点呼吸；悬停按钮和图片有反馈
interactionEn: Click: ticks slide the work rail; the status dot breathes; buttons and images react on hover

props.name: status
props.noteEn: Status pill with a green dot

props.name: ctas
props.note: 黑色主按钮和普通按钮
props.noteEn: Black main button and a plain button

example: <FolioHero status="接受新项目 · 12 月起" person={{ avatar: me, name: '林屿', note: 'hello@linyu.example' }} pre="你的下一位" title="产品设计师" ctas={['聊聊项目', '看作品']} frames={[{ image: a, tag: '01', caption: '透明相机' }, { image: b }]} />

name: 作品轨案例
role: 证据 · 单个项目详情
summary: 左边：等宽小字编号、项目名加灰色副标题、一张两三行的事实表（客户、角色、周期）和两三个结果数字，单位用主题色上标；右边作品列把这个项目的图停在正中，上下相邻的作品各露出一截，点刻度或露出的图可以切换。
summaryEn: Left: a mono case number, the project name with a grey subtitle, a two-to-four row fact table (client, role, timeline) and two or three results with accent superscript units. Right: the rail holds this project's picture in the middle with its neighbours peeking in above and below; ticks or a peeking frame switch it.
useWhen: 作品集里讲一个项目：做了什么、多久、结果如何
有 2–3 个能量化的结果
useWhenEn: One portfolio project: what, how long, what changed
You have 2–3 measurable results
avoidWhen: 要讲改版前后对比：用 CaseStudy
只是展示多张作品：用 ProjectPair
avoidWhenEn: Before / after of a redesign: use CaseStudy
Just showing several pieces: use ProjectPair
limits: stats 2–3 个：value ≤ 4 个字符，unit ≤ 2 个字符，label ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: meta 2–4 rows: label ≤ 5 chars, value ≤ 20 chars
stats 2–3: value ≤ 4 characters, unit ≤ 2 characters, label ≤ 8 chars
interaction: 点击：刻度或露出的作品图让作品列滑动；悬停放大正中的图
interactionEn: Click: ticks or a peeking frame slide the rail; hover zooms the centred picture

props.name: focus
props.noteEn: Frame in view at the start, default 1

example: <FolioCase kicker="CASE 02 / 04 · 2026" title="琥珀" sub="一块会发光的路由器" meta={[{ label: '客户', value: '远山网络' }, { label: '周期', value: '14 周' }]} stats={[{ value: '3', unit: '×', label: '配网成功率提升' }]} frames={[{ image: a }, { image: b, tag: '02', caption: '琥珀' }, { image: c }]} focus={1} />

name: 作品轨流程
role: 方法 · 分步折叠
summary: 左边一列编号步骤，像手风琴一样一次展开一步，展开的那步编号变主题色、加号转成叉；右边作品列跟着滑到这一步对应的图，图上写着步骤名。
summaryEn: A numbered list of steps on the left that opens one at a time like an accordion: the open step's number turns the accent colour and its plus turns into a cross. The rail on the right slides to that step's picture, captioned with the step name.
useWhen: 讲合作流程、设计方法、项目阶段
每一步都有一张能拿出来的过程图
useWhenEn: How you work, a design method or project phases
Each step has a process picture to show
avoidWhen: 步骤没有配图：用 ProcessQuote 或 Steps
超过 5 步：用 Timeline
avoidWhenEn: Steps without pictures: use ProcessQuote or Steps
More than 5 steps: use Timeline
limits: steps 3–5 步：name ≤ 6 字，time ≤ 6 字，body ≤ 36 字，caption ≤ 14 字
limitsEn: steps 3–5: name ≤ 6 chars, time ≤ 6 chars, body ≤ 36 chars, caption ≤ 14 chars
interaction: 点击：展开一步，右侧作品列滑到对应的图
interactionEn: Click: opens a step and slides the rail to its picture
example: <FolioSteps kicker="PROCESS · 6–14 周" title="四步做完" steps={[{ name: '现场观察', time: '第 1 周', body: '…', image: a }, { name: '草图打样', time: '第 2–4 周', body: '…', image: b }, …]} />

name: 作品轨评价
role: 证据 · 客户原话
summary: 左边一次只放一条客户原话，大字号，下面一条细线隔开头像、名字职位和一个主题色结果数字；左下角两枚圆形箭头翻页。翻到哪条，右边作品列就滑到那条评价说的项目。
summaryEn: One client quote at a time in large type on the left; under a hairline sit the avatar, name and role, and one result figure in the accent colour. Two round arrows bottom left flip the quote, and the rail on the right slides to the project that quote is about.
useWhen: 作品集或服务介绍里放 2–4 条客户评价
每条评价能对上一个具体项目
useWhenEn: 2–4 client quotes in a portfolio or service pitch
Each quote maps to a specific project
avoidWhen: 评价很多、想一页铺开：用 ProofMosaic
只有一条：用 Quote
avoidWhenEn: Many quotes on one slide: use ProofMosaic
Only one quote: use Quote
limits: words 2–4 条：text ≤ 56 字，name ≤ 6 字，role ≤ 16 字，metric.value ≤ 5 个字符，metric.label ≤ 8 字，caption ≤ 14 字
limitsEn: words 2–4: text ≤ 56 chars, name ≤ 6 chars, role ≤ 16 chars, metric.value ≤ 5 characters, metric.label ≤ 8 chars, caption ≤ 14 chars
interaction: 点击：箭头翻到下一条，文字淡入，作品列同步滑动
interactionEn: Click: arrows flip the quote with a fade and slide the rail in step

props.name: words
props.type: { text, name, role, avatar?, metric?, image, caption? }[]
props.note: 每条评价配一张项目图
props.noteEn: Each quote with a project picture

example: <FolioWords kicker="客户怎么说" words={[{ text: '…', name: '许棠', role: '产品负责人 · 远山网络', metric: { value: '3×', label: '配网成功率' }, image: a }, …]} />

name: 作品轨报价
role: 定价 · 合作方式
summary: 左边 2–4 种合作方式排成带价格的清单，点哪一行，那行左边升起一道主题色竖条、编号变色；右边作品列停在一格虚线边框的空位上，写着“你的项目，放这里”，选中的方式和价格会写进这格空位，虚线缓慢流动。
summaryEn: Two to four ways to work together as a priced list on the left; clicking a row raises an accent bar beside it and colours its number. The rail on the right rests on an empty dashed slot reading "your project here", which takes the picked offer and price; the dashes drift slowly.
useWhen: 独立设计师或小工作室的服务和报价
想用一个留白的位置邀请对方开始
useWhenEn: Services and prices for a freelancer or small studio
You want an empty spot to invite the next project
avoidWhen: 订阅套餐要逐项对比：用 PricingTiers
只有一个价格：用 BookingClose
avoidWhenEn: Subscription plans compared line by line: use PricingTiers
A single price: use BookingClose
limits: offers 2–4 个：name ≤ 6 字，note ≤ 22 字，price ≤ 6 个字符，unit ≤ 3 字
slot.title ≤ 8 字，note ≤ 18 字，cta ≤ 8 字，label ≤ 18 个字符
limitsEn: offers 2–4: name ≤ 6 chars, note ≤ 22 chars, price ≤ 6 characters, unit ≤ 3 chars
slot.title ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 18 chars, cta ≤ 8 chars, label ≤ 18 characters
interaction: 点击：选中一种方式，空位里的方式和价格随之更新；虚线边框缓慢流动
interactionEn: Click: picks an offer and writes it into the slot; the dashed border drifts
example: <FolioOffers kicker="SERVICES · 2026" title="三种合作方式" offers={[{ name: '设计冲刺', note: '…', price: '¥28k' }, { name: '长期合伙', note: '…', price: '¥36k', unit: '/ 月' }]} slot={{ title: '你的项目，放这里', cta: '一起做点什么' }} frames={[{ image: a }]} />

name: 作品轨问答预约
role: 收尾 · 常见问题与预约
summary: 左边 3–4 个常见问题，点开一个看回答；右边作品列中间停着一张白色预约卡：头像、名字、绿点“可预约”、日期和 3–6 个时间格，点一个时间，底部主题色按钮上的时间跟着变。
summaryEn: Three or four common questions on the left, each opening to its answer; in the middle of the rail sits a white booking card with avatar, name, a green "available" dot, a date and 3–6 time slots. Picking a time updates the accent button below.
useWhen: 作品集或服务介绍的最后一页
想把顾虑和预约放在一起
useWhenEn: Last slide of a portfolio or service pitch
Answer doubts and book a call on the same slide
avoidWhen: 要一个完整的月历：用 BookingClose
只是留联系方式：用 Closing
avoidWhenEn: A full month calendar: use BookingClose
Just contact details: use Closing
limits: card.name ≤ 8 字，note ≤ 14 字，status ≤ 8 字，day ≤ 14 字，slots 3–6 个 × ≤ 5 个字符，cta ≤ 8 字，mail ≤ 26 个字符
limitsEn: card.name ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 14 chars, status ≤ 8 chars, day ≤ 14 chars, slots 3–6 × ≤ 5 characters, cta ≤ 8 chars, mail ≤ 26 characters
interaction: 点击：展开问题；点时间格，按钮上的时间随之更新
interactionEn: Click: opens a question; picking a slot updates the time on the button

props.name: card
props.type: { avatar, name, note?, status?, day?, slots, cta, mail? }

props.name: frames
props.note: 预约卡上下露出的作品

example: <FolioContact kicker="FAQ" title="开始之前" faqs={[{ q: '远程怎么合作？', a: '…' }, …]} card={{ avatar: me, name: '林屿', status: '可预约', slots: ['10:00', '14:00', '17:00'], cta: '预约' }} frames={[{ image: a }, { image: b }]} />

name: 对页开场
role: 开场 · 个人作品集首页
summary: 左边一整张高图卡，左上角一行手写体西文签名，作品图自动交叉淡入、缓慢推近，底边进度条跟着走满，右下圆形箭头切到下一张；右边绿点状态胶囊、三行粗体大标题（其中几个字变灰）、导语和两枚按钮，最下面一行客户名缓缓横向漂移。为对页风格设计，其他风格也能用。
summaryEn: A full-height picture card on the left with a handwritten Latin signature in the corner; work cross-fades with a slow push-in, progress bars along the foot fill as each shot plays, and a round arrow skips ahead. On the right: a status pill with a green dot, a three-line bold title with a few words in grey, a lead, two buttons, and a row of client names drifting along the foot. Made for the diptych style; other styles work too.
useWhen: 独立设计师、摄影师、插画师作品集的第一页
作品是竖图，想一开场就放大看
useWhenEn: First slide of a solo designer, photographer or illustrator portfolio
The work is portrait-shaped and should be seen big from the start
avoidWhen: 作品是横图或界面截图：用 FolioHero 或 AtelierHero
没有作品图：用 Cover
avoidWhenEn: Landscape work or UI screenshots: use FolioHero or AtelierHero
No work images: use Cover
limits: title 2–3 行 × ≤ 7 字；soft ≤ 4 字且出现在 title 里
shots 2–5 张竖图：title ≤ 8 字，meta ≤ 14 字
limitsEn: title 2–3 lines × ≤ 7 chars; soft ≤ 4 chars and inside title
shots 2–5 portrait images: title ≤ 8 chars, meta ≤ 14 chars
interaction: 左图自动轮播，进度条走满后切换；点箭头或进度条手动切换；客户名横向漂移，悬停暂停
interactionEn: The left card autoplays with filling progress bars; the arrow or bars switch by hand; client names drift and pause on hover

props.name: status
props.noteEn: Status pill with a green dot

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Big title, one item per line

props.name: soft
props.noteEn: Words in the title set in grey

props.name: ctas
props.note: 黑色主按钮和普通按钮
props.noteEn: Black main button and a plain button

props.name: clients
props.noteEn: Client names drifting along the foot

props.name: shots
props.noteEn: Work cycling on the left card

props.name: signature
props.note: 图卡左上角的西文签名
props.noteEn: Latin signature in the card corner

props.name: autoplay
props.note: 每张停留毫秒数，0 关闭，默认 5200
props.noteEn: Milliseconds per shot, 0 turns it off, default 5200

example: <DiptychHero status="接受预约中" title={['我设计并搭建', '让人心动', '的产品']} soft="心动" ctas={['约个时间聊聊', '看看项目']} signature="Baiyi" shots={[{ image: a, title: '焰', meta: '视觉设计 · 2026' }, { image: b }]} />

name: 对页项目列表
role: 证据 · 精选项目
summary: 右边灰色小字、两行标题和一列带编号的项目名，当前那行变黑、右端出现主题色箭头；鼠标移到哪一行，左边大图卡就淡入那个项目的图，图上写着项目名和类型年份。
summaryEn: On the right a grey kicker, a two-line title and a numbered list of project names; the current row turns black and grows an accent arrow. Hovering a row fades the big left card to that project's picture, captioned with its name, kind and year.
useWhen: 3–6 个项目，每个有一张好图
想让人自己挑着看
useWhenEn: 3–6 projects, each with one strong picture
Let people pick what to look at
avoidWhen: 只有两个项目：用 ProjectPair
项目要讲细节：用 FolioCase
avoidWhenEn: Only two projects: use ProjectPair
A project needs detail: use FolioCase
limits: works 3–6 个：name ≤ 6 字，kind ≤ 6 字，year ≤ 6 个字符
limitsEn: works 3–6: name ≤ 6 chars, kind ≤ 6 chars, year ≤ 6 characters
interaction: 悬停或点击项目，左图交叉淡入对应作品，箭头滑入
interactionEn: Hover or click a project: the left card cross-fades to it and the arrow slides in

props.name: soft
props.noteEn: Words in the title set in grey

example: <DiptychWorks kicker="精选项目 · 2023—2026" title={['做得不多，', '每一个都做透。']} soft="每一个都做透。" works={[{ name: '焰', kind: '视觉设计', year: '2026', image: a }, …]} />

name: 对页服务
role: 服务 · 分标签介绍
summary: 右边标题下一排胶囊标签（品牌 / 网站 / 产品），点一个，下面换成这项服务的一句话、两列交付清单和周期、预算两个大数字，左边图卡同时换成对应的图。
summaryEn: Under the title a row of pill tabs (brand / website / product); picking one swaps in that service's line, a two-column list of deliverables and two big figures for timeline and budget, while the left card changes to its picture.
useWhen: 2–4 项服务，每项有交付物和大致报价
不想把所有服务挤在一页里
useWhenEn: 2–4 services with deliverables and rough prices
You don't want every service crammed onto one slide
avoidWhen: 要并排比较价格：用 PricingTiers
服务就是一个流程：用 FolioSteps
avoidWhenEn: Prices side by side: use PricingTiers
The service is a process: use FolioSteps
limits: services 2–4 个：name ≤ 4 字，body ≤ 40 字，items 3–5 条 × ≤ 10 字，time 和 price 各 ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: services 2–4: name ≤ 4 chars, body ≤ 40 chars, items 3–5 × ≤ 10 chars, time and price ≤ 8 chars each
interaction: 点击标签：内容淡入切换，左图同步交叉淡入
interactionEn: Click a tab: the content fades over and the left card cross-fades in step

props.name: soft
props.noteEn: Words in the title set in grey

props.name: services
props.type: { name, body, items, time?, price?, image }[]

props.name: labels
props.note: 周期和预算的小标签，默认“周期”“预算”
props.noteEn: Small labels for timeline and budget

example: <DiptychServices kicker="我能帮你做" title={['三件事，', '从头到尾一个人。']} services={[{ name: '品牌', body: '…', items: ['标志与字标', '视觉规范'], time: '4–6 周', price: '¥60k 起', image: a }, …]} />

name: 对页评价
role: 证据 · 客户原话
summary: 右边一排编号小胶囊，一次放一条大字号客户原话和署名；点编号换一条，左边图卡同时换成那条评价说的项目。底部一条细线下面是两三个大数字。
summaryEn: A row of small numbered pills on the right and one large client quote with its name at a time; clicking a number flips the quote and the left card to the project it is about. Two or three big figures sit under a hairline at the foot.
useWhen: 2–4 条评价，每条对应一个作品
想把评价和数字放在同一页
useWhenEn: 2–4 quotes, each tied to a piece of work
Quotes and figures on the same slide
avoidWhen: 评价没有对应作品：用 Quote
评价很多：用 ProofMosaic
avoidWhenEn: Quotes without matching work: use Quote
Many quotes: use ProofMosaic
limits: words 2–4 条：text ≤ 50 字，name ≤ 6 字，role ≤ 16 字，project ≤ 8 字
stats 2–3 个：value ≤ 5 个字符，label ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: words 2–4: text ≤ 50 chars, name ≤ 6 chars, role ≤ 16 chars, project ≤ 8 chars
interaction: 点击编号：原话淡入切换，左图同步交叉淡入
interactionEn: Click a number: the quote fades over and the left card cross-fades in step

props.name: words
props.note: 评价，每条配一张作品图
props.noteEn: Quotes, each with a work picture

example: <DiptychWords kicker="合作过的人说" words={[{ text: '…', name: '许岚', role: '主理人 · 素瓶', image: a, project: '素瓶' }, …]} stats={[{ value: '40+', label: '完成的项目' }]} />

name: 对页关于
role: 关于 · 个人经历
summary: 左边一张半身照，右边两行标题、一列经历（职位、说明、年份），下面一行带下划线的大号邮箱，点一下复制并弹出“已复制”，最后两枚按钮。
summaryEn: A half-length portrait on the left; on the right a two-line title, a list of roles (title, note, years), a big underlined email that copies on click and flashes "copied", and two buttons.
useWhen: 作品集里的自我介绍
想把经历和联系方式放在一起
useWhenEn: Self-introduction in a portfolio
Career and contact on the same slide
avoidWhen: 团队介绍：用 TeamBanner
经历超过 4 段：用 Timeline
avoidWhenEn: A team: use TeamBanner
More than 4 roles: use Timeline
limits: roles 2–4 段：role ≤ 14 字，note ≤ 14 字，years ≤ 11 个字符
limitsEn: roles 2–4: role ≤ 14 chars, note ≤ 14 chars, years ≤ 11 characters
interaction: 点击邮箱：复制并弹出提示；悬停经历行轻推
interactionEn: Click the email: copies it and shows a note; role rows nudge on hover

props.name: soft
props.noteEn: Words in the title set in grey

props.name: copied
props.note: 复制后的提示，默认“已复制”

example: <DiptychAbout kicker="关于我" title={['九年，从印刷品', '做到屏幕里。']} roles={[{ role: '独立设计师', note: '品牌、网站与产品', years: '2022 — 至今' }, …]} mail="hi@baiyi.example" shots={[{ image: me }]} />

name: 对页需求单
role: 收尾 · 选项式联系
summary: 右边两行标题下两三组胶囊选项（想做什么、预算、何时开始），点选后变黑；底部黑色大按钮上的主题色小圆标显示一共选了几项，每次变化会弹一下。左边图卡放作品。
summaryEn: Under a two-line title on the right, two or three rows of pill options (what, budget, when) that turn black when picked; a small accent badge on the big black button counts the picks and pops when it changes. The left card shows work.
useWhen: 作品集或服务介绍的最后一页
想让对方几秒钟说清需求
useWhenEn: Last slide of a portfolio or service pitch
Let people state their need in seconds
avoidWhen: 要约具体时间：用 FolioContact 或 BookingClose
只留联系方式：用 Closing
avoidWhenEn: Booking a time: use FolioContact or BookingClose
Just contact details: use Closing
limits: groups 2–3 组：label ≤ 10 字，options 2–5 个 × ≤ 6 字
interaction: 点击胶囊选择，按钮上的计数弹跳更新
interactionEn: Click pills to pick; the count on the button pops as it updates

props.name: soft
props.noteEn: Words in the title set in grey

example: <DiptychContact kicker="开始一个项目" title={['先告诉我', '你想做什么。']} groups={[{ label: '想做什么', options: ['品牌', '官网', 'App'], multi: true }, { label: '预算', options: ['5 万以内', '5–15 万'] }]} cta="发给我" shots={[{ image: a }]} />

name: 记号笔开场
role: 开场 · 一句话自我介绍
summary: 白底中间一栏：一个双菱形小标记、一句大字号的自我介绍，里面用 ==…== 圈出的词会像荧光笔一样依次从左到右刷上黄、绿、紫三色底；下面一句灰色的补充，最下面一排等宽小链接。页脚左边一句落款，右边城市加一只走动的时钟。
summaryEn: A centred column on white: a small double-diamond mark and one large sentence of introduction whose ==…== phrases get yellow, green and purple highlighter strokes sweeping in one after another; a grey second sentence below and a row of mono links at the foot. The page foot carries a sign-off on the left and a city with a ticking clock on the right.
useWhen: 个人主页、设计师、写作者的第一页
想用一句话而不是一个标题来介绍自己
useWhenEn: First slide of a personal site, designer or writer
Introduce yourself with a sentence rather than a title
avoidWhen: 要放作品图：用 FolioHero 或 DiptychHero
要讲产品卖点：用 Statement
avoidWhenEn: You want work pictures: use FolioHero or DiptychHero
Product selling points: use Statement
limits: say ≤ 2 行 × 14 字，标记 1–3 处
interaction: 荧光笔底色依次刷入；悬停标记词微微倾斜；右下角时钟每秒走动
interactionEn: Highlighter strokes sweep in one by one; marked words tilt on hover; the corner clock ticks every second

props.name: say
props.note: 主句，==词== 标记，\n 换行
props.noteEn: Main sentence, ==words== to mark, \n for a break

props.name: corners
props.note: 页脚落款和时钟，zone 用 IANA 时区
props.noteEn: Foot sign-off and clock; zone is an IANA time zone

example: <MarkerIntro say={'我是 周拾，一个做 ==安静的界面==\n和 ==小工具== 的设计师。'} aside="说个秘密？我收集 ==没用过的速写本==。" links={['精选作品', '现在']} corners={{ left: '回头见', city: '杭州', zone: 'Asia/Shanghai' }} />

name: 记号笔作品卡
role: 证据 · 精选作品
summary: 三张浅灰大圆角卡并排，每张顶上写作品名和编号，中间一张竖图被四个取景角框住、带一点投影，底下一行年份。悬停时取景角向外张开、图片上浮；作品多于三件时，左下角箭头三张一页横向翻。
summaryEn: Three soft grey rounded cards side by side, each with the name and number on top, a portrait picture held by four bracket corners with a soft shadow, and the year at the foot. On hover the corners open out and the picture lifts; with more than three pieces, arrows bottom left page through in threes.
useWhen: 3–9 件小而精的作品：产品、物件、App
作品图是干净的产品照
useWhenEn: 3–9 small, well-made pieces: products, objects, apps
Clean product photos
avoidWhen: 作品是横图截图：用 ProjectPair
要逐个讲细节：用 FolioCase
avoidWhenEn: Landscape screenshots: use ProjectPair
One piece in depth: use FolioCase
limits: works 3–9 件，三件一页：name ≤ 6 字，no ≤ 4 个字符，year ≤ 10 个字符
limitsEn: works 3–9, three per page: name ≤ 6 chars, no ≤ 4 characters, year ≤ 10 characters
interaction: 悬停：取景角张开、图片上浮；点击箭头三张一页翻动
interactionEn: Hover: the corners open and the picture lifts; arrows page in threes
example: <MarkerWorks kicker="精选作品" works={[{ name: '港口笔记', no: '001', year: '2024', image: a }, …]} />

name: 记号笔能力卡
role: 能力 · 我做什么与近况
roleEn: Capabilities · what I do and what's now
summary: 上半页三张浅灰卡，每张一个线描等轴小图标（屏幕、积木、字母、叠层、柱子、笔六选一），悬停时图标的几层会向上分开；下半页一个取景角框住的“现在”，一句带荧光笔标记的近况。
summaryEn: Three soft grey cards across the top, each with a line-drawn isometric icon (screen, blocks, letter, stack, bars or pen) whose layers lift apart on hover; below, a "now" box in bracket corners with one sentence about what you are on, phrases marked by highlighter.
useWhen: 介绍自己做哪三类事
想顺便讲讲最近在忙什么
useWhenEn: The three kinds of work you do
Add a note on what you are up to lately
avoidWhen: 服务要配价格：用 FolioOffers
超过三类：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: Services with prices: use FolioOffers
More than three: use IconGrid
limits: skills 正好 3 个：name ≤ 5 字，no ≤ 4 个字符，note ≤ 8 字，icon 六选一
limitsEn: skills exactly 3: name ≤ 5 chars, no ≤ 4 characters, note ≤ 8 chars, icon one of six
interaction: 悬停：图标分层上浮，取景角张开
interactionEn: Hover: icon layers lift and the corners open

props.name: skills
props.note: icon：screen / blocks / type / stack / chart / pen
props.noteEn: icon: screen / blocks / type / stack / chart / pen

example: <MarkerSkills kicker="我做什么" skills={[{ name: '界面', no: '001', note: '产品界面', icon: 'screen' }, { name: '小工具', icon: 'blocks' }, { name: '字体', icon: 'type' }]} now="此刻我在做 ==一个很小的排版工具==。" />

name: 记号笔随笔
role: 内容 · 日志与文章列表
summary: 一列带日期的短条目，每条标题里有一处荧光笔标记，右边一个小标签和斜箭头；点一行，箭头转向主题色，下面展开一句摘要。
summaryEn: A column of short dated entries, each title with one highlighter-marked phrase, a small tag and a slanted arrow on the right; clicking a row turns the arrow to the accent colour and unfolds a one-line summary.
useWhen: 随笔、更新日志、读书笔记
想展示近期在想什么
useWhenEn: Notes, changelogs, reading notes
Show what you have been thinking about
avoidWhen: 版本更新要分类：用 Changelog
条目超过 6 条：分两页
avoidWhenEn: Release notes by category: use Changelog
More than 6 entries: split across slides
limits: entries 3–6 条：date ≤ 6 个字符，title ≤ 20 字，tag ≤ 4 字，body ≤ 50 字
limitsEn: entries 3–6: date ≤ 6 characters, title ≤ 20 chars, tag ≤ 4 chars, body ≤ 50 chars
interaction: 点击一行展开摘要，箭头旋转；悬停行轻推
interactionEn: Click a row to unfold its summary as the arrow turns; rows nudge on hover

props.name: open
props.note: 一开始展开哪一条，-1 不展开
props.noteEn: Entry open at the start, -1 for none

example: <MarkerLog kicker="随笔" entries={[{ date: '09.18', title: '为什么我只用 ==两种字重==', tag: '排版', body: '…' }, …]} />

name: 记号笔数字
role: 数据 · 一句话加数字
summary: 上面一句带荧光笔标记的大字，下面 3–4 个取景角框住的浅灰格子，大数字在翻到这页时从 0 滚动到目标值，单位和说明是灰色。
summaryEn: One large sentence with highlighter marks on top and 3–4 soft grey boxes in bracket corners below, their big figures counting up from zero when the slide opens, with grey units and labels.
useWhen: 个人或小团队的几个累计数字
想让数字有一句话的上下文
useWhenEn: A few running totals for a person or small team
Figures that need one sentence of context
avoidWhen: 数字需要对比或趋势：用 BarChart 或 StatRow
只有一个数字：用 BigNumber
avoidWhenEn: Comparison or trend: use BarChart or StatRow
A single figure: use BigNumber
limits: facts 3–4 个：value 为整数，unit ≤ 3 个字符，label ≤ 10 字
limitsEn: facts 3–4: value a whole number, unit ≤ 3 characters, label ≤ 10 chars
interaction: 数字从 0 滚动计数；悬停格子取景角张开
interactionEn: Figures count up from zero; box corners open on hover
example: <MarkerFacts say="八年里，我画过 ==很多界面==。" facts={[{ value: 42, label: '上线的界面' }, { value: 1280, unit: '+', label: '画满的速写页' }]} />

name: 记号笔收尾
role: 收尾 · 联系方式
summary: 双菱形小标记、一句带荧光笔标记的收尾语，下面一行等宽大字邮箱，悬停时主题色下划线从左划过，点一下复制并亮起“已复制”；最下面一排等宽社交链接。
summaryEn: The double-diamond mark, one closing sentence with highlighter marks, a large mono email whose accent underline draws across on hover and which copies on click with a "copied" chip, and a row of mono social links.
useWhen: 个人主页或作品集的最后一页
只想留一个联系方式
useWhenEn: Last slide of a personal site or portfolio
You only want to leave one way to reach you
avoidWhen: 要预约时间：用 FolioContact
要收集需求：用 DiptychContact
avoidWhenEn: Booking a time: use FolioContact
Collecting a brief: use DiptychContact
interaction: 悬停邮箱划出下划线；点击复制并提示
interactionEn: Hovering the email draws an underline; clicking copies it with a note

props.name: copied
props.note: 复制后的提示，默认“已复制”

example: <MarkerClose say={'有个 ==安静的想法==？\n写信给我。'} mail="hi@zhoushi.example" links={['即刻', 'GitHub']} />

name: 相册开场
role: 开场 · 温暖的消费产品首页
summary: 页面顶部一团暖黄晨光：小胶囊、一行手写感衬线小字、两行粗体大标题（最后一个词换成斜体衬线，带橙→玫红→紫的渐变）、导语和一枚按钮；底部 5–9 张拍立得沿一段大圆弧扇形发开，像发牌一样依次落下，悬停的那张会抽出来一截，旁边飘着几枚小标签。
summaryEn: A warm sunrise glow at the top: a small pill, a handwritten-feel serif line, a two-line bold title whose last word turns into italic serif with an orange-to-rose-to-violet gradient, a lead and one button. Along the foot 5–9 instant prints fan out on a wide arc, dealt in one by one; the one you point at slides up, and a few small chips float nearby.
useWhen: 相册、日记、家庭、生活方式类产品的第一页
想要温暖、私密、有手感的开场
useWhenEn: First slide of a photo album, journal, family or lifestyle product
A warm, private, hand-made opening
avoidWhen: B2B 或数据产品：用 SunriseHero
照片不够 5 张：用 AtelierHero
avoidWhenEn: B2B or data products: use SunriseHero
Fewer than 5 photos: use AtelierHero
limits: title 2 行 × ≤ 9 字；grad ≤ 4 字且在最后一行末尾
limitsEn: title 2 lines × ≤ 9 chars; grad ≤ 4 chars at the end of the last line
interaction: 拍立得依次发牌落下；悬停抽出一张；小标签轻轻浮动，晨光缓慢呼吸
interactionEn: Prints are dealt in one by one; hover pulls one up; chips bob and the glow breathes

props.name: hand
props.note: 标题上方的手写感小字

props.name: grad
props.note: 最后一行末尾变成渐变斜体的词
props.noteEn: Word at the end of the last line in gradient italic

example: <AlbumHero badge="私密内测中" hand="给那些拍了，却从没洗出来的照片" title={['有些时刻，值得', '被好好记住。']} grad="记住。" cta="开始记录" prints={[{ image: a, caption: '午后的窗' }, …]} chips={['✦ 本周 +42 张']} />

name: 相册桌面排版
role: 方法 · 三步演示
summary: 左边标题（一个词换成渐变斜体）和三步说明，右边一张斜放的白色桌面上摆着五张照片和一条圆形工具栏。点哪一步，桌上的照片就跟着变：第一步堆成一叠，第二步大小不一地摊开，第三步整齐排好、被选中的那张描上虚线框。
