summaryEn: A title with one word in gradient italic and three steps on the left; on the right a tilted white tabletop with five photos and a round toolbar. Picking a step rearranges the table: the photos pile up, then spread out at different sizes, then settle into a neat page with the picked one outlined in dashes.
useWhen: 演示一个“整理 / 排版 / 编辑”的过程
产品的核心是亲手摆放
useWhenEn: Show an organise / lay out / edit process
The product is about arranging by hand
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 3 个：用 FolioSteps 或 Steps
要放真实界面截图：用 DeviceFrame
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 steps: use FolioSteps or Steps
Real UI screenshots: use DeviceFrame
limits: title 2 行 × ≤ 9 字；em ≤ 4 字且在第一行里
steps 正好 3 步：name ≤ 10 字，note ≤ 26 字
photos 正好 5 张；loose 0–2 张
limitsEn: title 2 lines × ≤ 9 chars; em ≤ 4 chars inside the first line
steps exactly 3: name ≤ 10 chars, note ≤ 26 chars
interaction: 点击步骤：五张照片带弹性地移动、缩放、旋转到新位置；悬停桌面倾角变小
interactionEn: Click a step: the five photos spring to new positions, sizes and angles; hovering the table eases its tilt

props.name: em
props.note: 第一行里变成渐变斜体的词
props.noteEn: Word in the first line set in gradient italic

props.name: steps
props.note: 三步，每步对应一种摆法
props.noteEn: Three steps, each with its own arrangement

example: <AlbumLayout title={['亲手排一排，', '才像自己的相册。']} em="排一排" steps={[{ name: '放进一卷', note: '…' }, { name: '决定大小', note: '…' }, { name: '摆好', note: '…' }]} photos={[a, b, c, d, e]} />

name: 相册一周
role: 内容 · 一周图记
summary: 一根微微下垂的细绳横过页面，5–7 张拍立得用小木夹夹在上面，翻到这页时轻轻晃动；点一张，它放大落下，其余几张褪色，下方用斜体衬线写出日期、一句话和地点。
summaryEn: A slightly sagging string runs across the slide with 5–7 instant prints pegged on it, swinging gently as the slide opens. Click one and it grows and drops while the others fade, and the date, a line and the place write in below in italic serif.
useWhen: 一周、一次旅行、一个项目的逐日回顾
每天一张图加一句话
useWhenEn: A day-by-day look back at a week, a trip or a project
One picture and one line per day
avoidWhen: 超过 7 天：用 Timeline
图要大看：用 DiptychWorks
avoidWhenEn: More than 7 days: use Timeline
Pictures should be big: use DiptychWorks
limits: days 5–7 天：day ≤ 3 字，date ≤ 8 字，caption ≤ 6 字，note ≤ 40 字，place ≤ 10 字
limitsEn: days 5–7: day ≤ 3 chars, date ≤ 8 chars, caption ≤ 6 chars, note ≤ 40 chars, place ≤ 10 chars
interaction: 照片在绳上晃动落定；点击放大选中那天，下方文字淡入
interactionEn: Prints swing and settle on the string; click to lift a day and fade its text in below

props.name: days
props.type: { day, date, image, caption?, note?, place? }[]

example: <AlbumWeek kicker="第 24 周" title="这一周，一天一张" days={[{ day: '周一', date: '6 月 10 日', image: a, caption: '早班车', note: '…', place: '老城区' }, …]} />

name: 相册翻面故事
role: 证据 · 用户故事
summary: 三张大拍立得略带角度排开，悬停时摆正；点一张会立体翻到背面，背面是带横线的信纸，用衬线字写着这位用户的一句话和署名。
summaryEn: Three large instant prints set at slight angles that straighten on hover; clicking one flips it over in 3D to a lined-paper back where the person's words and name are written in serif.
useWhen: 消费产品的用户故事、评价
想让人自己翻开看，而不是一次铺满
useWhenEn: User stories or reviews for a consumer product
Let people turn them over rather than show everything at once
avoidWhen: 评价要配数字：用 DiptychWords
超过 3 条：用 ProofMosaic
avoidWhenEn: Quotes with figures: use DiptychWords
More than 3: use ProofMosaic
limits: stories 正好 3 条：caption ≤ 8 字，note ≤ 44 字，name ≤ 6 字，meta ≤ 10 字
limitsEn: stories exactly 3: caption ≤ 8 chars, note ≤ 44 chars, name ≤ 6 chars, meta ≤ 10 chars
interaction: 点击照片立体翻面；悬停摆正上浮
interactionEn: Click a print to flip it in 3D; hover straightens and lifts it

props.name: stories
props.noteEn: Three prints with words on the back

example: <AlbumStories title="照片背后，写着一句话" stories={[{ image: a, caption: '外婆的厨房', note: '…', name: '小满', meta: '用了 2 年' }, …]} />

name: 相册会员
role: 定价 · 单一会员
summary: 居中一张白色大卡：会员名带一枚渐变星号、一段说明、2×2 四个功能格（彩色圆角图标，悬停时图标歪一下），底部一排月付 / 年付切换、斜体衬线的大价格和按钮；切换时价格从下面滚上来。卡片四周漂着几张拍立得。
summaryEn: One large white card in the middle: the plan name with a gradient star, a short note, a 2 × 2 grid of four features with tinted rounded icons that tilt on hover, and a row with a monthly / yearly switch, a big italic serif price and a button; switching rolls the price up from below. Instant prints float around the card.
useWhen: 只有一档付费会员
消费产品的订阅页
useWhenEn: A single paid membership
Subscription page for a consumer product
avoidWhen: 多档套餐：用 PricingTiers
一次性买断：用 BuyoutPricing
avoidWhenEn: Several plans: use PricingTiers
One-time purchase: use BuyoutPricing
limits: feats 正好 4 个：icon 一个字符，title ≤ 7 字，note ≤ 24 字
prices 两个 × ≤ 6 个字符；cta ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: feats exactly 4: icon one character, title ≤ 7 chars, note ≤ 24 chars
interaction: 点击切换月付 / 年付，价格滚动更新；照片轻轻浮动
interactionEn: Click to switch monthly / yearly and roll the price; prints float gently

props.name: periods
props.note: 切换按钮和单位的文字，默认中文
props.noteEn: Text for the switch and units, Chinese by default

example: <AlbumPlus name="拾光 Plus" feats={[{ icon: '☁', title: '原图不限量', note: '…' }, …]} prices={['¥18', '¥168']} cta="加入 Plus" around={[a, b, c, d]} />

name: 相册收尾
role: 收尾 · 号召与照片堆
roleEn: Closing · call to action and a pile of prints
summary: 左边手写感小字、两行大标题（最后一个词渐变斜体）、导语、按钮和一行小字；右边一叠拍立得，点一下最上面那张飞出去再插回底部，下一张露出来，角落写着第几张。
summaryEn: A handwritten-feel line, a two-line title with the last word in gradient italic, a lead, buttons and a small note on the left; on the right a pile of instant prints where each click sends the top one flying out and back underneath, revealing the next, with a counter in the corner.
useWhen: 消费产品演示的最后一页
想留一个可以玩一下的小动作
useWhenEn: Last slide of a consumer product pitch
Leave one small thing to play with
avoidWhen: 要留联系方式：用 MarkerClose
要收集需求：用 DiptychContact
avoidWhenEn: Leave contact details: use MarkerClose
Collect a brief: use DiptychContact
limits: lead ≤ 40 字；ctas 每个 ≤ 8 字；note ≤ 24 字
limitsEn: lead ≤ 40 chars; ctas ≤ 8 chars each; note ≤ 24 chars
interaction: 点击照片堆：最上面一张飞出插回底部，计数更新；悬停时照片摆正
interactionEn: Click the pile: the top print flies out and tucks underneath, the counter updates; hovering straightens the prints

props.name: grad
props.note: 最后一行末尾变成渐变斜体的词
props.noteEn: Word at the end of the last line in gradient italic

example: <AlbumClose title={['把这一周，', '留给以后的你。']} grad="以后的你。" ctas={['开始记录', '先看看示例']} prints={[{ image: a, caption: '洗出来了' }, …]} />

name: 立体看板开场
role: 开场 · SaaS 产品首页
summary: 左侧一枚版本小胶囊、两行大标题（标题里嵌一枚斜放的渐变图标块）、导语、主按钮加文字链接和一排客户字标；右侧一块数据看板在 3D 里向内倾斜：标签栏、问候语、三张 KPI 卡和一张柱状图。点哪张 KPI 卡，它就被渐变点亮，柱状图换成它的走势；悬停看板会慢慢转正。
summaryEn: On the left a version pill, a two-line headline with a small tilted gradient icon tile set into it, a lead, a button with a text link and a row of customer wordmarks. On the right a dashboard tilts inward in 3D: tabs, a greeting, three KPI cards and a bar chart. Click a KPI card and it lights up in the accent gradient while the chart redraws its trend; hovering the dashboard slowly turns it face-on.
useWhen: SaaS、数据产品、效率工具的第一页
想一眼看出“这是一个有看板的产品”
useWhenEn: First slide of a SaaS, data product or productivity tool
You want it obvious at a glance that the product has a dashboard
avoidWhen: 没有可展示的数字：用 SunriseHero
消费类、生活方式产品：用 AlbumHero
avoidWhenEn: No numbers to show: use SunriseHero
Consumer or lifestyle products: use AlbumHero
limits: chip 标签 ≤ 6 个字符，后半句 ≤ 12 字
lead ≤ 50 字；ctas 各 ≤ 8 字；logos 3–5 个 × ≤ 10 个字符
dash.tabs 3–5 个 × ≤ 4 字；hello ≤ 12 字；note ≤ 24 字
dash.kpis 恰好 3 张：value ≤ 8 个字符，series 8–14 个数
limitsEn: lead ≤ 50 chars; ctas ≤ 8 chars each; logos 3–5 × ≤ 10 chars
dash.tabs 3–5 × ≤ 4 chars; hello ≤ 12 chars; note ≤ 24 chars
dash.kpis exactly 3: value ≤ 8 chars, series 8–14 numbers
interaction: 看板从远处转进来；点 KPI 卡换图表；悬停看板转正；图标块悬停会弹一下
interactionEn: The dashboard turns in from a distance; clicking a KPI card redraws the chart; hovering turns the dashboard face-on; icon tiles bounce on hover

props.name: chip
props.noteEn: Version tag and the line after it

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Two headline lines; may hold icon tiles

props.name: float
props.noteEn: Small chip floating by the dashboard

example: <SlateHero chip={['2.0 版', '更聪明，也更快']} title={['用 {bolt} 数衡', '理顺你的工作流']} ctas={['免费试用', '看演示 →']} dash={{ tabs: ['总览', '收入'], hello: '早上好', kpis: [{ label: '本月收入', value: '¥156.6万', delta: '+12%', series: [42, 50, …] }, …] }} />

name: 立体看板三步
role: 方法 · 三步上手
summary: 居中的小圆点标签、两行标题和副标题；下面三张白卡并排，每张上半是一幅会动的小图（节点连线、柱状、半圆仪表、圆环、横条或声波），下半是渐变小标签、步骤名和一句说明。悬停卡片会浮起。
summaryEn: A centred dot label, a two-line title and a subtitle; below, three white cards side by side. Each has a small animated picture on top (linked nodes, bars, a half gauge, a donut, horizontal rows or a sound wave) and an accent tag, step name and one-line note below. Cards lift on hover.
useWhen: 讲清楚产品怎么上手、怎么运作
三个步骤各自能配一幅简单的图
useWhenEn: Explaining how to get started or how the product works
Each of three steps can carry a simple picture
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 3 个：用时间线类模板
每步需要长段说明：用 FolioSteps
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 steps: use a timeline template
Each step needs a long explanation: use FolioSteps
limits: steps 恰好 3 个：tag ≤ 6 字，title ≤ 10 字，body ≤ 34 字
vis 取 bars / gauge / wave / donut / rows / nodes；gauge 与 donut 需 value 0–100
limitsEn: steps exactly 3: tag ≤ 6 chars, title ≤ 10 chars, body ≤ 34 chars
vis is bars / gauge / wave / donut / rows / nodes; gauge and donut need value 0–100
interaction: 小图依次生长、扫过；悬停卡片浮起
interactionEn: Pictures grow and sweep in turn; cards lift on hover
example: <SlateSteps title={['接入、整理、行动，', '一个下午就能跑起来']} steps={[{ tag: '步骤 1', title: '连上现有工具', body: '…', vis: 'nodes' }, …]} />

name: 立体看板对比表
role: 对比 · 我们与替代方案
summary: 左侧标题、导语、按钮和三张小数字卡；右侧一张白色对比表，“我们”那一列被一根渐变竖条整体点亮，打勾为白圈、打叉为深色圈。右上角的开关打开后，两边相同的行会收起，只剩差异。
summaryEn: Title, lead, button and three small stat cards on the left; on the right a white comparison table whose 'us' column is lit as a whole by one accent gradient bar, ticks in white circles and crosses in dark ones. A switch at the top right collapses the rows where both sides agree, leaving only the differences.
useWhen: 和传统做法或竞品逐项比较
想让差异一眼可见
useWhenEn: Comparing item by item with the old way or a competitor
Making the difference visible at a glance
avoidWhen: 要比较的对象超过 2 个：用多列对比模板
比较项是数字而非有无：用 SlateTrend 或数据类模板
avoidWhenEn: More than 2 things to compare: use a multi-column comparison template
The items are numbers rather than yes/no: use SlateTrend or a data template
limits: title 2 行 × ≤ 10 字；lead ≤ 50 字；cta ≤ 6 字
stats ≤ 3 个：value ≤ 5 个字符，label ≤ 8 字
rows 4–8 行：label ≤ 10 字，icon 1 个字符
limitsEn: title 2 lines × ≤ 10 chars; lead ≤ 50 chars; cta ≤ 6 chars
interaction: 开关收起相同的行；悬停行名变主色；小数字卡悬停浮起
interactionEn: The switch collapses identical rows; row labels turn accent on hover; stat cards lift on hover

props.name: cols
props.noteEn: Column names for us and them

props.name: diffLabel
props.note: 开关文字，默认“只看差异”

example: <SlateCompare title={['同样的预算，', '少开一半的会']} cols={['数衡', '传统报表']} rows={[{ label: '实时同步数据', ours: true, theirs: false }, …]} />

name: 立体看板趋势
role: 趋势 · 多指标走势
summary: 左上标题；左侧一列指标卡（名称、当前值、绿色涨幅），右侧一张大白卡里画面积折线图，末端一颗圆点和深色气泡标出当前值。点哪张指标卡，它被渐变点亮，曲线重新画成它的走势。
summaryEn: A title at the top left; a column of metric cards (name, current value, green change) on the left and, in a large white card on the right, an area line chart whose end is marked by a dot and a dark bubble with the current value. Click a metric card and it lights up in the accent gradient while the line redraws its trend.
useWhen: 复盘一年或一个季度的增长
2–4 个指标想放在同一页轮流看
useWhenEn: Looking back on a year or quarter of growth
2–4 metrics you want to show in turn on one slide
avoidWhen: 只有一个数字：用大数字类模板
要同时比较多条曲线：用数据类多序列图表
avoidWhenEn: Only one number: use a big-number template
Several lines must be compared at once: use a multi-series data chart
limits: series 2–4 个：label ≤ 8 字，value ≤ 8 个字符，delta ≤ 6 个字符，points 与 xs 等长
limitsEn: series 2–4: label ≤ 8 chars, value ≤ 8 chars, delta ≤ 6 chars, points as long as xs
interaction: 曲线从左往右画出；点指标卡换曲线；末端圆点和气泡弹出
interactionEn: The line draws from left to right; clicking a metric card switches the line; the end dot and bubble pop in
example: <SlateTrend title="每一条曲线都在往上走" series={[{ label: '月度经常性收入', value: '¥156.6万', delta: '+212%', points: [50, 56, …] }, …]} xs={['1月', …, '12月']} />

name: 立体看板定价
role: 定价 · 按人数计价
summary: 顶部标题，右侧一个团队人数步进器（− / +）；下面三张方案卡并排，中间那张整体被渐变点亮并带“最多人选”标签。价格随人数实时算出，企业方案可以写“联系我们”。
summaryEn: A title at the top with a team-size stepper (− / +) on the right; below, three plan cards side by side, the middle one lit as a whole in the accent gradient with a 'most popular' tag. Prices are recalculated from the seat count as you go; an enterprise plan can say 'contact us' instead.
useWhen: 按席位收费的 SaaS 定价
想让观众自己感受人数对价格的影响
useWhenEn: Per-seat SaaS pricing
Letting the audience feel how team size changes the price
avoidWhen: 只有一个方案：用 AlbumPlus
按用量计费：用数据类模板讲清楚阶梯
avoidWhenEn: A single plan: use AlbumPlus
Usage-based billing: explain the tiers with a data template
limits: plans 恰好 3 个：name ≤ 4 字，note ≤ 14 字，items 3–5 条 × ≤ 12 字，cta ≤ 6 字
perSeat 为单人月价；不填 perSeat 时用 custom（≤ 6 字）
limitsEn: plans exactly 3: name ≤ 4 chars, note ≤ 14 chars, items 3–5 × ≤ 12 chars, cta ≤ 6 chars
perSeat is the monthly price per person; without perSeat use custom (≤ 6 chars)
interaction: − / + 改人数，价格实时重算；方案卡悬停浮起
interactionEn: − / + change the seat count and prices update live; plan cards lift on hover

props.name: plans
props.type: { name, note, perSeat?, custom?, items, cta }[]
props.noteEn: Three plans, the middle one recommended

props.name: step
props.noteEn: Seats added or removed per click

example: <SlatePricing title="按人数付费，随时增减" plans={[{ name: '入门', note: '…', perSeat: 39, items: […], cta: '免费开始' }, …]} />

name: 立体看板集成
role: 收尾 · 集成与号召
roleEn: Closing · integrations and call to action
summary: 左侧标题（可嵌图标块）、导语、两个按钮和一行小字；右侧一个集成星图：中间一枚大图标块，外圈 6–8 个工具图标沿虚线环排开，每根辐条上有光点流向中心。悬停某个工具，它和它的辐条被点亮。
summaryEn: On the left a title (which may hold an icon tile), a lead, two buttons and a small line; on the right an integration map: a large icon tile in the middle and 6–8 tool icons around a dashed ring, with light pulses running along each spoke towards the centre. Hover a tool and it and its spoke light up.
useWhen: 讲产品能接入哪些现有工具
SaaS 演示的最后一页号召试用
useWhenEn: Showing which existing tools the product plugs into
The last slide of a SaaS demo, asking people to try it
avoidWhen: 要列出几十个真实集成：用清单类模板
需要讲接入步骤：用 SlateSteps
avoidWhenEn: Listing dozens of real integrations: use a checklist template
Explaining how to connect: use SlateSteps
limits: title 2 行 × ≤ 10 字，可嵌图标块
lead ≤ 50 字；ctas 各 ≤ 8 字；note ≤ 30 字
tools 6–8 个：name ≤ 4 字，mark 1–3 个字符
请用通用类别名，不要写真实品牌
limitsEn: title 2 lines × ≤ 10 chars; may hold icon tiles
lead ≤ 50 chars; ctas ≤ 8 chars each; note ≤ 30 chars
Use generic category names, not real brands
interaction: 光点沿辐条流向中心；悬停工具点亮它的辐条
interactionEn: Light pulses run along the spokes; hovering a tool lights its spoke
example: <SlateConnect title={['你已经在用的工具，', '{link} 都能接上']} tools={[{ name: '表格', mark: '▦' }, …]} />

name: 暗场开场
role: 开场 · AI 产品首页
summary: 满版一张暗调光影图（例如被轮廓光勾出的人头侧影），随鼠标轻轻漂移；顶部一枚“新”字胶囊，中间两行衬线大标题，下面一个半透明提问框：示例问题会自己一个字一个字打出来再删掉，附件和联网是可以按下的开关，模型名点一下会换，发送键会发出一圈光并换下一个问题。
summaryEn: A full-bleed dark, lit picture (for example a head silhouette traced by rim light) that drifts gently with the pointer; a 'new' pill at the top, a two-line serif headline in the middle and a translucent prompt box below. Example requests type themselves in letter by letter and erase again, the attach and web chips are switches you can press, the model name changes on click and the send button sends out a ring of light and moves to the next request.
useWhen: AI 代理、智能助手、对话式产品的第一页
想让观众一眼看到“它是用来提问的”
useWhenEn: First slide of an AI agent, assistant or chat product
You want it obvious at a glance that the product is something you ask
avoidWhen: 没有合适的暗调大图：用 NocturneHero
需要展示数据看板：用 SlateHero
avoidWhenEn: No suitable dark hero picture: use NocturneHero
You need to show a data dashboard: use SlateHero
limits: badge 标签 ≤ 2 字，后半句 ≤ 18 字
ask.chips ≤ 3 个 × ≤ 6 字；ask.models ≤ 3 个 × ≤ 10 个字符
image 宜用暗底、单侧打光、主体居中的图
limitsEn: image works best dark, lit from one side, subject centred
interaction: 背景随鼠标漂移；提问框自动打字；开关可按；模型可切换；发送键换下一个问题
interactionEn: The background drifts with the pointer; the prompt box types by itself; chips toggle; the model switches; send moves to the next request

props.name: ask
props.noteEn: Prompt box: placeholder, prompts, chips, models

example: <EmberHero badge={['新', '4.1 版支持多代理协作']} title={['让 AI 代理', '替你把事办完。']} image={head} ask={{ placeholder: '今天想让它帮你处理什么？', prompts: ['把会议纪要整理成周报'], chips: ['＋ 附件'], models: ['4.1'] }} />

name: 暗场能力拼贴
role: 能力 · 四项功能
summary: 居中一行衬线标题，下面四张暗色卡片拼成一块：左右两张竖长的图片卡，中间上方一张图片卡浮着一排工具图标（点哪个就点亮并显示名字），中间下方一张卡是可以拨动的开关列表。每张卡底部是余烬色小方块图标、标题和一句说明，悬停时图片缓慢推近。
summaryEn: A centred serif title over four dark cards fitted together: two tall picture cards left and right, a picture card top-centre with a floating row of tool icons (click one to light it and show its name), and a card bottom-centre holding a list of working switches. Each card ends in a small ember icon square, a title and one line; pictures push in slowly on hover.
useWhen: 介绍 AI 产品的 4 项核心能力
既想要氛围图，又想有一点可以动手的界面
useWhenEn: Introducing four core capabilities of an AI product
You want atmosphere pictures and a little interface to play with
avoidWhen: 能力超过 4 项：用 FeatureBento
没有图片：用要点类模板
avoidWhenEn: More than 4 capabilities: use FeatureBento
No pictures: use a key-points template
limits: cards 恰好 4 张：title ≤ 8 字，body ≤ 34 字
第 1、3 张宜放竖图；tools 3–6 个；toggles 2–4 个 × ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: cards exactly 4: title ≤ 8 chars, body ≤ 34 chars
cards 1 and 3 suit portrait pictures; tools 3–6; toggles 2–4 × ≤ 8 chars
interaction: 点工具图标切换并显示名字；开关可拨；悬停图片推近、卡片描出主色边
interactionEn: Tool icons switch and show their name; switches flip; pictures push in and cards take an accent edge on hover

props.name: cards
props.type: { icon, title, body, image?, tools?, toggles? }[]

example: <EmberBento title="更聪明的能力，无尽的可能。" cards={[{ icon: '◐', title: '对话式 AI', body: '…', image: dots }, { icon: '◎', title: '多模态理解', body: '…', image: lake, tools: [{ mark: '▤', name: '文档' }, …] }, …]} />

name: 暗场代理执行
role: 机制 · 代理一步步完成任务
roleEn: Mechanism · an agent finishing a task step by step
summary: 左侧衬线标题、一条“你”发出的请求气泡，以及一份正在生成的草稿；右侧一张“执行过程”卡，3–6 个步骤依次转圈、打勾，左边的进度轨随之点亮，每步显示用到的工具和耗时。步骤推进时，左边草稿的行一条条从模糊变清楚，全部完成后状态变绿并显示总用时，可以点“再跑一次”。
summaryEn: On the left a serif title, a request bubble from 'you' and a draft being written; on the right an 'activity' card whose 3–6 steps spin and tick off in turn while a progress rail lights up beside them, each showing the tool used and the time taken. As steps finish, the draft's lines sharpen one by one from blur; when all are done the status turns green with the total time, and 'run again' replays it.
useWhen: 讲清楚 AI 代理具体怎么干活
演示一次完整的委托：从一句话到交付
useWhenEn: Showing concretely how an AI agent does the work
Demonstrating a whole delegation, from one sentence to the result
avoidWhen: 步骤超过 6 个：用时间线类模板
没有可展示的产出：用 SlateSteps
avoidWhenEn: More than 6 steps: use a timeline template
No output to show: use SlateSteps
limits: steps 3–6 个：label ≤ 10 字，detail ≤ 24 字，tool ≤ 6 字
limitsEn: steps 3–6: label ≤ 10 chars, detail ≤ 24 chars, tool ≤ 6 chars
pace is milliseconds per step, default 1400
interaction: 步骤自动依次完成，进度轨点亮；草稿逐行变清楚；“再跑一次”重新播放
interactionEn: Steps complete on their own and the rail lights up; the draft sharpens line by line; 'run again' replays

props.name: result
props.noteEn: Draft that fills in step by step

example: <EmberAgent title={['你只说一句话，', '剩下的交给它。']} task="把上周的会议纪要整理成周报" steps={[{ label: '读取会议纪要', detail: '…', tool: '文档库', secs: 4 }, …]} result={{ title: '第 45 周 · 团队周报', lines: ['…'] }} />

name: 暗场省时对比
role: 数据 · 每项工作省下的时间
summary: 左侧衬线标题、导语和一个巨大的渐变衬线数字（每周省下多少小时）；右侧一张卡列出 3–6 项工作，每行一根横条：先显示自己做要花的时间，随后缩短成交给代理后的时间并亮起余烬色，原来的长度留成一段虚线。顶部的分段按钮可以在两种情况之间来回切。
summaryEn: On the left a serif title, a lead and a huge gradient serif number (hours saved per week); on the right a card listing 3–6 tasks, one bar each: it first shows the time done by hand, then shrinks to the time with the agent and lights up in ember, leaving the old length as a dotted ghost. A segmented switch at the top flips between the two.
useWhen: 量化 AI 工具或自动化省下的时间
前后对比，单位一致的几项工作
useWhenEn: Quantifying the time an AI tool or automation saves
Before and after for several tasks in the same unit
avoidWhen: 数字单位不一致：用数据类模板
只有一个对比数字：用大数字类模板
avoidWhenEn: Mixed units: use a data template
Only one before/after number: use a big-number template
interaction: 横条从“自己做”缩到“交给代理”，总数随之出现；分段按钮来回切换
interactionEn: Bars shrink from 'by hand' to 'with the agent' and the total appears; the segmented switch flips back and forth

props.name: tasks
props.noteEn: Hours before and after per task

example: <EmberSaves title={['每周多出来的，', '是整整一天半。']} tasks={[{ name: '写周报', before: 3, after: 0.5 }, …]} />

name: 暗场用户评价
role: 证据 · 两位客户的话和结果
roleEn: Evidence · two customers, their words and results
summary: 一团余烬色光晕下居中标题，两张暗色大卡并排：上面是衬线体引语，底部左边头像、姓名和职位，右边一个巨大的衬线结果数字（如 26%、3×）从零数上来。鼠标在卡片上移动时，一团光跟着走。
summaryEn: A centred title under an ember glow and two large dark cards side by side: a serif quote on top, an avatar, name and role at the bottom left, and a huge serif result (such as 26% or 3×) at the bottom right that counts up from zero. A pool of light follows the pointer across the card.
useWhen: 用两位客户的原话加结果做证明
发布会、销售演示里的口碑页
useWhenEn: Proof from two customers' own words plus a result
The testimonial slide of a launch or sales demo
avoidWhen: 评价超过 2 条：用 FolioWords 或 AlbumStories
没有量化结果：用引语类模板
avoidWhenEn: More than 2 testimonials: use FolioWords or AlbumStories
No measurable result: use a quote template
limits: quotes 恰好 2 条：quote ≤ 40 字，role ≤ 16 字
value ≤ 5 个字符，数字部分会滚动；label ≤ 8 字
limitsEn: quotes exactly 2: quote ≤ 40 chars, role ≤ 16 chars
value ≤ 5 chars, the number part counts up; label ≤ 8 chars
interaction: 结果数字从零滚动；光斑跟随鼠标；悬停卡片浮起
interactionEn: Results count up from zero; a light follows the pointer; cards lift on hover

props.name: quotes
props.type: { quote, name, role, avatar?, value, label }[]

example: <EmberWords title="听听用户怎么说" quotes={[{ quote: '…', name: '邓帆', role: '产品负责人 · 远舟数据', value: '26%', label: '演示转化提升' }, …]} />

name: 暗场收尾
role: 收尾 · 号召与提问框
roleEn: Closing · call to action with a prompt box
summary: 画面中央一圈缓慢呼吸的火光，环里是两行衬线大字、一句导语和一个小号提问框（同样会自己打字），下面一个浅色按钮、一条文字链接和一行小字。
summaryEn: A ring of fire breathing slowly in the middle of the slide; inside it two lines of large serif type, a lead and a compact prompt box (which also types by itself), then a light button, a text link and a small line.
useWhen: AI 产品演示的最后一页
想让观众带着“现在就去问它一句”离开
useWhenEn: The last slide of an AI product demo
You want the audience to leave wanting to ask it something right away
avoidWhen: 需要列出联系方式或二维码：用联系类模板
亮色风格的演示：用 SlateConnect
avoidWhenEn: You need contact details or a QR code: use a contact template
A light-themed deck: use SlateConnect
limits: image 宜用中心留空的光环图
limitsEn: image works best as a ring of light with an empty centre
interaction: 光环缓慢呼吸；提问框自动打字；按钮悬停发出主色光
interactionEn: The ring breathes slowly; the prompt box types by itself; the button glows in the accent on hover

props.name: title
props.noteEn: Two large lines inside the ring

example: <EmberClose title={['把今天的第一件事，', '交给观止。']} image={ring} ask={{ placeholder: '…', prompts: ['…'] }} ctas={['开始使用', '预约团队演示']} />

name: 霞光面板开场
role: 开场 · 开发者工具首页
summary: 顶部一枚薄荷绿公告胶囊，居中两行紧凑大标题、导语和一黑一浅两个按钮；下方左边一块日落渐变大面板，上面一排标签，点哪个，面板中央半透明框住的深色小部件就换成那一项的数字和分段条；右边一张白色代码卡，删改行用红绿底色标出，逐行滑入。
summaryEn: A mint announcement pill at the top, a centred two-line tight headline, a lead and a dark and a light button. Below on the left a big sunset gradient panel with a row of tabs: click one and the dark widget in a frosted frame at its centre switches to that item's number and segmented bar. On the right a white code card marks removed and added lines in red and green, sliding in line by line.
useWhen: 开发者工具、AI 编程助手、技术 SaaS 的第一页
想同时展示“产品界面”和“代码”
useWhenEn: First slide of a developer tool, AI coding assistant or technical SaaS
Showing the product interface and the code at the same time
avoidWhen: 非技术受众：用 SlateHero
没有代码可展示：用 SunriseHero
avoidWhenEn: Non-technical audience: use SlateHero
No code to show: use SunriseHero
limits: ann ≤ 20 字 + 链接 ≤ 4 字
title 2 行 × ≤ 8 字；lead ≤ 30 字；ctas 各 ≤ 6 字
tabs 2–5 个：label ≤ 4 字，head ≤ 8 字，bars 2–5 段 × ≤ 4 字，file ≤ 18 个字符
code 6–12 行 × ≤ 34 个字符；以 "- " "+ " "# " 开头分别表示删除、新增、注释
limitsEn: title 2 lines × ≤ 8 chars; lead ≤ 30 chars; ctas ≤ 6 chars each
tabs 2–5: label ≤ 4 chars, head ≤ 8 chars, bars 2–5 × ≤ 4 chars, file ≤ 18 chars
code 6–12 lines × ≤ 34 chars; start with "- " "+ " "# " for removed, added, comment
interaction: 点标签切换小部件；代码逐行滑入；渐变面板缓慢流动
interactionEn: Tabs swap the widget; code slides in line by line; the gradient panel drifts slowly

props.name: tabs
props.type: { label, head, stat, unit, bars, file }[]
props.note: 面板标签与小部件内容
props.noteEn: Panel tabs and their widget content

example: <DuskHero ann={['完成 A 轮融资', '阅读全文']} title={['把复杂代码', '讲成人话的 AI']} tabs={[{ label: '编辑器', head: '时间分布', stat: '24', unit: '个运行周期', bars: [{ label: '解释', value: 22 }, …], file: 'AuthService.ts' }, …]} code={['# 解释补丁', '- if (a && b)', '+ if (a || b)']} />

name: 霞光面板特性
role: 产品 · 一项功能和它的图表
roleEn: Product · one feature and its chart
summary: 左侧小标签、两行标题、一段说明、两到四条打勾要点和一个浅色按钮；右侧一块浅粉渐变面板，中间深色小部件里是 2–3 条平滑曲线，鼠标在图上左右移动，竖线光标跟着走，底部读出那一刻每条线的数值。
summaryEn: On the left a small tag, a two-line title, a paragraph, two to four ticked points and a light button; on the right a soft pink gradient panel whose dark widget holds 2–3 smooth lines. Move the pointer across the chart and a vertical cursor follows, reading out every line's value at that point underneath.
useWhen: 一页讲清一项功能，并配一张能读数的图
调试、监控、分析类功能
useWhenEn: Explaining one feature with a chart you can read
Debugging, monitoring or analytics features
avoidWhen: 要讲多项功能：用 EmberBento 或要点类模板
图表需要坐标轴和精确刻度：用数据类图表模板
avoidWhenEn: Several features: use EmberBento or a key-points template
The chart needs axes and exact ticks: use a data chart template
limits: chart.series 2–3 条，每条 6–14 个数，长度一致；xs 与之等长
limitsEn: chart.series 2–3, each 6–14 numbers of equal length; xs the same length
interaction: 曲线画出；鼠标左右移动时光标和读数跟随
interactionEn: Lines draw in; the cursor and readout follow the pointer

props.name: chart
props.noteEn: Line chart with a scrubbing cursor

example: <DuskFeature tag={{ icon: '◆', label: '调试' }} title={['在问题变大之前，', '先看见它。']} chart={{ stat: '37', unit: '个问题', series: [{ label: '严重', points: [3, 6, 8, …] }, …] }} />

name: 霞光面板逐段讲解
role: 讲解 · 代码逐段说成人话
roleEn: Explanation · code told in plain words, block by block
summary: 左边一张白色代码卡，代码分成 2–4 段，当前那段亮起并带主色左边线，其余变淡；右边日落渐变面板里，深色卡片用大字标题和一段白话解释这段代码在做什么，顶部进度条显示讲到第几段。会自动往下讲，点任意一段就停在那里。
summaryEn: On the left a white code card split into 2–4 blocks: the current one lights up with an accent edge and the rest fade. On the right, inside a sunset gradient panel, a dark card explains in a large title and plain sentences what that block does, with a progress bar on top showing which block you are on. It moves on by itself; click any block to stop there.
useWhen: 给非作者讲清楚一段代码、配置或脚本
技术分享、代码评审、新人培训
useWhenEn: Explaining a piece of code, config or script to someone who didn't write it
Tech talks, code reviews and onboarding
avoidWhen: 代码超过 20 行：拆成多页
要展示改动前后：用 DuskHero 的差异行
avoidWhenEn: More than 20 lines of code: split over several slides
Showing before and after: use the diff rows in DuskHero
limits: title ≤ 16 字，单行；file ≤ 24 个字符
blocks 2–4 段：每段 2–5 行 × ≤ 40 个字符
每段 title ≤ 12 字，note ≤ 50 字
autoplay 默认 3600 毫秒，0 关闭
limitsEn: title ≤ 16 chars, one line; file ≤ 24 chars
autoplay defaults to 3600 ms; 0 turns it off
interaction: 自动逐段讲解；点代码段切换并停止自动播放
interactionEn: Explains block by block on its own; clicking a block selects it and stops autoplay
example: <DuskExplain title="一段一段，讲给你听。" file="billing/retry.ts" blocks={[{ lines: ['async function retry(order) {', '  const max = 3'], title: '先定好重试几次', note: '…' }, …]} />

name: 霞光面板结果卡
role: 数据 · 三个结果
summary: 一行标题下三张高卡片并排：上面是小标签和一条占满卡宽的面积曲线，底部是巨大的数字（从零数上来）和一句说明。鼠标停在哪张，哪张就变成日落渐变、文字和曲线变白并微微浮起。
summaryEn: Under a one-line title, three tall cards side by side: a small label and an area line spanning the card at the top, a huge number (counting up from zero) and one line of explanation at the bottom. The card you point at turns into the sunset gradient, its text and line go white and it lifts slightly.
useWhen: 用三个数字总结效果
每个数字都有一段可以画出来的变化
useWhenEn: Summing up the effect in three numbers
Each number has a change over time you can draw
avoidWhen: 数字超过 3 个：用数据类模板
没有变化趋势：用大数字类模板
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 numbers: use a data template
No trend to show: use a big-number template
limits: stats 恰好 3 个：value ≤ 7 个字符，label ≤ 10 字，note ≤ 30 字
limitsEn: stats exactly 3: value ≤ 7 chars, label ≤ 10 chars, note ≤ 30 chars
interaction: 数字滚动、曲线画出；悬停的卡片变成渐变
interactionEn: Numbers count up and lines draw in; the hovered card turns into the gradient
example: <DuskStats title="团队用了之后，变化很具体。" stats={[{ value: '3.2×', label: '读懂旧代码', note: '…', series: [1, 1.2, …] }, …]} />

name: 霞光面板客户案例
role: 客户 · 案例轮播与两句评价
roleEn: Customer · case carousel with two quotes
summary: 左边一张大照片案例卡：左上客户名，左下一句结果大字和白色按钮，右下进度点和左右箭头，2–4 个案例会自动轮播（照片交叉淡入并缓慢推远）；右边上下两张白卡各是一句客户原话，底部是头像、姓名和职位。
summaryEn: On the left a large photo case card: the customer name top left, a one-line result in large type and a white button bottom left, progress dots and arrows bottom right; 2–4 cases rotate on their own as photos cross-fade and slowly pull back. On the right two white cards, each a customer quote with an avatar, name and role at the foot.
useWhen: 用真实感的客户故事做证明
既有案例又有几句短评价
useWhenEn: Proof through realistic customer stories
You have both case studies and a few short quotes
avoidWhen: 没有照片：用 EmberWords
评价超过 2 条：用评价墙类模板
avoidWhenEn: No photos: use EmberWords
More than 2 quotes: use a testimonial wall template
limits: voices 恰好 2 条：quote ≤ 44 字，role ≤ 12 字
cta ≤ 6 字；autoplay 默认 5200 毫秒
limitsEn: voices exactly 2: quote ≤ 44 chars, role ≤ 12 chars
cta ≤ 6 chars; autoplay defaults to 5200 ms
interaction: 案例自动轮播，箭头切换；进度点计时；评价卡悬停浮起
interactionEn: Cases rotate on their own and arrows switch them; dots time each one; quote cards lift on hover
example: <DuskCases title="用解码交付的团队，都更快。" cases={[{ company: '✳ 常青科技', headline: '平台改版快了 3 倍', image: a }, …]} voices={[{ company: '◼ 模块实验室', quote: '…', name: '罗振', role: 'CEO' }, …]} />

name: 霞光面板收尾
role: 收尾 · 号召与安装命令
roleEn: Closing · call to action with an install command
summary: 居中两行大标题、一句导语和两个按钮；下方一块日落渐变面板里放着一个深色终端：三个小圆点、一行可以一键复制的命令，下面几行输出依次打印出来，最后一行变绿表示就绪。
summaryEn: A centred two-line headline, a lead and two buttons; below, a sunset gradient panel holds a dark terminal: three small dots, a command you can copy with one click, and a few output lines printing one after another, the last turning green when ready.
useWhen: 开发者产品演示的最后一页
想让观众带走一行能直接运行的命令
useWhenEn: The last slide of a developer product demo
You want the audience to leave with a command they can run
avoidWhen: 非技术受众：用 SlateConnect 或 EmberClose
需要联系方式或二维码：用联系类模板
avoidWhenEn: Non-technical audience: use SlateConnect or EmberClose
You need contact details or a QR code: use a contact template
limits: title 2 行 × ≤ 10 字；lead ≤ 30 字；ctas 各 ≤ 6 字
limitsEn: title 2 lines × ≤ 10 chars; lead ≤ 30 chars; ctas ≤ 6 chars each
interaction: 点“复制”把命令放进剪贴板；输出逐行打印
interactionEn: 'Copy' puts the command on the clipboard; output prints line by line

props.name: output
props.noteEn: Output that prints line by line

example: <DuskClose title={['下一段看不懂的代码，', '交给解码。']} command="npx jiema init" output={['✓ 已连接代码仓库', '✓ 已就绪']} />

name: 电光蓝舞台开场
role: 开场 · 机构或品牌第 1 页
roleEn: Opening · first page for an agency or brand
summary: 整页由主题色调出的电光蓝渐变加细颗粒，一团亮光跟着鼠标缓慢移动；左上两行细体大标题和白色胶囊按钮（圆形箭头悬停时转向），右上一张毛玻璃照片卡（悬停浮起、照片推近），下方一排圆头像和两行说明；底部一个巨大的英文字标出血到页面下沿，字母依次升起，指到哪个字母哪个微微抬起。
summaryEn: The whole page is an electric-blue gradient mixed from the theme accent with fine grain, and a soft light slowly follows the pointer. Top left, a light two-line headline and a white pill button whose round arrow turns on hover; top right, a frosted photo card that lifts on hover; below it a row of round faces with a two-line note. A giant Latin wordmark bleeds off the bottom edge, its letters rising one by one and lifting under the pointer.
useWhen: 增长机构、咨询公司、品牌方案的封面
想要有冲击力、像官网首屏的开场
useWhenEn: Cover for a growth agency, consultancy or brand proposal
An opening that hits like a website hero
avoidWhen: 没有英文字标：用 AgencyHero
正式汇报：用 Cover
avoidWhenEn: No Latin wordmark: use AgencyHero
Formal reports: use Cover
limits: trust.faces 2–4 张，text 两行各 ≤ 12 字
word 3–7 个英文字母；mark 默认 ®
这一页在 deck 里请设 tone: 'dark'，页眉才是浅色
limitsEn: trust.faces 2–4, text two lines ≤ 12 chars each
word 3–7 Latin letters; mark defaults to ®
Set tone: 'dark' on this slide so the header turns light
interaction: 亮光跟随鼠标；字标字母依次升起，悬停单个字母抬起；照片卡悬停浮起；按钮箭头悬停转向
interactionEn: Light follows the pointer; wordmark letters rise in turn and lift on hover; the card lifts on hover; the button arrow turns on hover
example: <AgencyStage title={['为认真做增长的', '品牌而生']} cta="预约一次诊断" card={{ image: night, title: '增长策略', body: '…' }} trust={{ faces: [a, b, c], text: ['已服务 120+ 家', '快速成长的品牌'] }} word="LANQI" />

name: 人像加手风琴
role: 方法 · 使命、服务或做法展开讲
roleEn: Method · mission, services or approach in detail
summary: 左上白色小胶囊，右半边两行细体标题；左边一张竖幅人像带姓名小签，右边 3–4 行编号白色手风琴：展开的那一行撑满剩余高度，显示一句说明、浅色小胶囊和一张横幅照片，底边一条主题色进度线；不点时每隔几秒自动展开下一行，点任意一行就停在那一行。
summaryEn: A small white pill top left and a light two-line title on the right half. On the left a tall portrait with a name chip; on the right 3–4 numbered white accordion rows. The open row fills the remaining height with a sentence, soft chips and a landscape photo, plus an accent progress line along its foot. Rows open in turn every few seconds until someone clicks one.
useWhen: 讲机构的使命、方法或服务，每项都需要一句展开说明
有一张代表人物照片
useWhenEn: An agency's mission, method or services, each needing a sentence
You have one representative portrait
avoidWhen: 5 项以上：用 AgencyRows
每项都要同时可见：用 IconGrid
avoidWhenEn: 5 or more items: use AgencyRows
Every item must be visible at once: use IconGrid
limits: items 3–4 行：title ≤ 10 字，body ≤ 40 字，chips 0–3 个 × ≤ 5 字，image 可选
autoplay 默认 5600 毫秒，0 关闭
limitsEn: items 3–4: title ≤ 10 chars, body ≤ 40 chars, chips 0–3 × ≤ 5 chars, optional image
autoplay defaults to 5600 ms; 0 turns it off
interaction: 自动依次展开并显示进度线；点击任意行展开并停止自动；悬停行标题变色；照片悬停推近
interactionEn: Rows open in turn with a progress line; clicking a row opens it and stops the cycle; row titles tint on hover; the portrait pushes in on hover
example: <AgencyAccordion tag="我们的使命" title={['我们把策略做成系统，', '让增长不靠运气。']} photo={{ image: p, caption: '策略总监 · 周以宁' }} items={[{ title: '策略与执行', body: '…', chips: ['用户研究'], image: t }, …]} />

name: 深蓝评价加便当格
role: 客户 · 评价与成果
summary: 左上白色小胶囊，右半边两行细体标题；中间一张深蓝长卡，左边一句客户原话和左右箭头、页码，右边一张人像带姓名职位，1–3 条评价自动轮换（人像交叉淡入）；下面三格：主题色渐变一句话（悬停渐变流动）、一张图片带说明（悬停推近）、一个从零数上去的大数字配圆头像。
summaryEn: A small white pill top left and a light two-line title on the right half. Across the middle a long navy card: a client quote with arrows and a counter on the left, a portrait with name and role on the right; 1–3 quotes rotate as portraits cross-fade. Below, three tiles: a one-line statement on an accent gradient that flows on hover, a picture with a caption that pushes in on hover, and a big number that counts up beside round faces.
useWhen: 机构或产品的客户评价页
既要一句原话，又要一个成果数字
useWhenEn: Client testimonials for an agency or product
You want one quote plus one result number
avoidWhen: 评价超过 3 条：用评价墙类模板
没有人像照片：用 QuoteBlock
avoidWhenEn: More than 3 quotes: use a testimonial wall
No portraits: use QuoteBlock
limits: stat.value 如 "+65%"；label ≤ 8 字；foot ≤ 8 字；faces 0–4 张
limitsEn: stat.value like "+65%"; label ≤ 8 chars; foot ≤ 8 chars; faces 0–4
interaction: 评价自动轮换，箭头切换并停止自动；数字从零数上去；渐变格悬停流动；图片格悬停推近；头像悬停散开
interactionEn: Quotes rotate on their own; arrows switch and stop the rotation; the number counts up; the gradient tile flows on hover; the picture pushes in on hover; faces spread on hover
example: <AgencyProof tag="客户评价" title={['官网改完那个季度，', '线索翻了一倍。']} quotes={[{ text: '…', name: '陈嘉禾', role: '市场负责人 · 栖木家居', image: f }]} statement="把数字体验做到能转化" visual={{ image: g, caption: '策略先行的创意' }} stat={{ value: '+65%', label: '客户平均增长', foot: '增长已交付' }} />

name: 电光蓝预约收尾
role: 收尾 · 预约一次沟通
summary: 整页电光蓝渐变加细颗粒；左边毛玻璃小胶囊、两三行细体大标题和导语；右边一张毛玻璃预约卡：标题和接待人头像，一排 4–5 天日期、3–6 个时间段，选哪个哪个变亮，底部白色长按钮实时读出“预约 周三 11/12 · 14:00”，点一下变成绿色对勾“已预约”；页面底部可加一排联系方式。
summaryEn: The whole page is the electric-blue gradient with fine grain. On the left a frosted pill, a light two- or three-line headline and a lead; on the right a frosted booking card with a heading and the host's face, a row of 4–5 days and 3–6 time slots that light up when picked. A long white button reads the picked day and time back and turns into a green tick when clicked. An optional row of contact facts runs along the bottom.
useWhen: 机构提案、销售演示的最后一页
希望听众当场约下一次沟通
useWhenEn: Last page of an agency proposal or sales demo
You want the audience to book the next call on the spot
avoidWhen: 只要一句结束语：用 Closing
线上发布、没有预约环节：用 DuskClose
avoidWhenEn: Only a closing line: use Closing
Online launch with no booking: use DuskClose
limits: tag ≤ 8 字；title 2–3 行 × ≤ 9 字；lead ≤ 44 字
heading ≤ 12 字；days 4–5 天 [星期, 日期]；slots 3–6 个
contacts 0–4 条：label ≤ 6 字，value ≤ 16 个字符
这一页在 deck 里请设 tone: 'dark'
limitsEn: tag ≤ 8 chars; title 2–3 lines × ≤ 9 chars; lead ≤ 44 chars
heading ≤ 12 chars; days 4–5 as [weekday, date]; slots 3–6
interaction: 点日期和时间段选中，按钮文字随之更新；点按钮变成已预约对勾；时间段依次弹出；按钮箭头悬停前移
interactionEn: Pick a day and a slot and the button text updates; clicking the button shows a booked tick; slots pop in one by one; the button arrow nudges on hover

props.name: pick
props.note: 初始选中的日期和时间
props.noteEn: Day and slot picked at the start

example: <AgencyBook title={['下一季的增长，', '从一次诊断开始']} lead="…" heading="预约一次增长诊断" days={[['周一', '11/10'], …]} slots={['10:00', '14:00']} host={{ image: p, name: '周以宁', role: '策略总监' }} />

name: 个人主页动态流
role: 内容 · 个人或品牌主页式的近况
roleEn: Content · recent news as a personal or brand home
summary: 仿社交主页的三栏：左边头像、名字、六项菜单（点哪项哪项高亮）和一块时钟（冒号闪烁，可写死时间或走实时）；中间一列动态，第一条带一到两张图，每条都有可点的 ♡（心形弹一下、数字加一）和分享；右边一排彩圈头像（点过变灰表示已看）、两个小方框列表和一个“聊两句”气泡加输入框。只用当前风格的颜色和圆角，任何风格都能用。
summaryEn: A three-column social home page. On the left an avatar, a name, six menu items that highlight on click and a clock tile with a blinking colon (fixed or live). In the middle a column of posts; the first carries one or two pictures, and every post has a heart that pops and adds one when clicked plus a share action. On the right a row of ringed avatars that grey out once viewed, two small list boxes and a chat bubble with an input. It uses only the current style's colours and radii, so it works in every style.
useWhen: 独立开发者、设计师、创作者介绍自己近况
想用“刷动态”的方式讲一段经历
useWhenEn: An indie maker, designer or creator sharing recent news
Telling a story as if scrolling a feed
avoidWhen: 正式汇报：用 Timeline
动态超过 3 条：拆页
avoidWhenEn: Formal reports: use Timeline
More than 3 posts: split the slide
limits: profile.name ≤ 6 字，role ≤ 10 字；menu 4–6 项 × ≤ 5 字
posts 2–3 条：text ≤ 34 字，time ≤ 6 字；只有第一条显示 0–2 张图
stories 0–4 个 × ≤ 3 字；boxes 0–2 个，各 2 条：title ≤ 12 字，note ≤ 10 字
limitsEn: profile.name ≤ 6 chars, role ≤ 10 chars; menu 4–6 × ≤ 5 chars
posts 2–3: text ≤ 34 chars, time ≤ 6 chars; only the first shows 0–2 pictures
stories 0–4 × ≤ 3 chars; boxes 0–2 with 2 items each: title ≤ 12 chars, note ≤ 10 chars
interaction: 点 ♡ 点赞并弹跳计数；点彩圈头像标为已看；菜单点击切换高亮；时钟冒号闪烁；动态依次滑入
interactionEn: Heart pops and counts on click; ringed avatars mark as viewed; menu items switch highlight; the clock colon blinks; posts slide in one by one

props.name: clock
props.note: 时钟方块，不写 time 则走实时
props.noteEn: Clock tile; without time it runs live

example: <SocialFeed profile={{ name: '许知夏', role: '设计 · 独立开发', avatar: a }} menu={[{ icon: 'home', label: '首页' }, …]} posts={[{ text: '…', time: '9 个月前', pinned: true, media: [p, q], likes: '2.3k' }, …]} say="最近正好在看新机会 👋" />

name: 一条发布动态
role: 证据 · 一次上线或里程碑的反响
roleEn: Evidence · the response to a launch or milestone
summary: 同一套三栏外壳，中间只放一条大动态：返回链接、作者行、两行大字公告、一张宽幅图和可点的 ♡、评论数、分享；右边一个“这次上线”方框列 2–3 个带图标的数字，下面“热门评论”方框里 2–3 条评论依次出现。只用当前风格的颜色和圆角。
summaryEn: The same three-column shell with one big post in the middle: a back link, the author line, a two-line announcement in large type, a wide picture, and a clickable heart, comment count and share. On the right a box lists 2–3 launch figures with icons, and below it 2–3 top comments arrive one by one. It uses only the current style's colours and radii.
useWhen: 讲一次上线、发布、里程碑，以及大家的反应
想让数字和评论显得像真实发生过
useWhenEn: A launch, release or milestone and how people reacted
Making numbers and comments feel like they really happened
avoidWhen: 数字是重点：用 StatRow
没有配图：用 QuoteHero
avoidWhenEn: The numbers are the point: use StatRow
No picture: use QuoteHero
limits: facts 2–3 条：value ≤ 8 个字符，note ≤ 10 字
interaction: 点 ♡ 点赞并弹跳计数；评论依次出现；配图悬停推近；菜单点击切换高亮
interactionEn: Heart pops and counts on click; comments arrive one by one; the picture pushes in on hover; menu items switch highlight
example: <SocialPost profile={me} menu={menu} time="去年" text={['夏至 AI 上线了。', '…']} image={shot} counts={['12.8k', '932']} facts={{ title: '这次上线', items: [{ icon: 'clock', value: '11 个月', note: '一个人从零做完' }] }} />

name: 私信邀约
role: 收尾 · 邀请对方联系或合作
roleEn: Closing · invite the audience to get in touch
summary: 左边同一套头像菜单时钟，右边一整块私信窗口：顶部头像、名字和绿色“通常 1 小时内回复”；对话从底部往上排，访客的白气泡和主人的主题色气泡依次出现，中间可以插一张报价卡（图、标题、说明、价格）；底部一排快捷回复，点一个就发出去，主人显示“正在输入”的三个跳点后回答，用过的快捷回复变灰。只用当前风格的颜色和圆角。
summaryEn: The same avatar, menu and clock on the left; on the right a full direct-message window with the owner's face, name and a green reply-time line. Messages stack from the bottom: the visitor's white bubbles and the owner's accent bubbles arrive in turn, with an optional offer card (picture, title, note, price) between them. A row of quick replies sits at the foot; clicking one sends it, three typing dots bounce, then the owner answers, and used replies grey out. It uses only the current style's colours and radii.
useWhen: 作品集、个人介绍、服务提案的最后一页
想让听众看到“联系我”之后会发生什么
useWhenEn: Last page of a portfolio, personal intro or service proposal
Showing what happens after someone says hello
avoidWhen: AI 助手的对话演示：用 ChatDemo
只要联系方式：用 Closing
avoidWhenEn: Demoing an AI assistant: use ChatDemo
Only contact details: use Closing
limits: offer 可选：title ≤ 10 字，note ≤ 18 字，price ≤ 10 个字符；after 是插在第几条之后（从 0 数）
limitsEn: offer optional: title ≤ 10 chars, note ≤ 18 chars, price ≤ 10 chars; after is the message it follows (from 0)
interaction: 对话依次出现；点快捷回复会发出消息，出现三个跳点后收到回答；报价卡悬停浮起
interactionEn: Messages arrive in turn; a quick reply sends a message, typing dots bounce, then an answer arrives; the offer card lifts on hover
example: <DirectChat profile={me} menu={menu} messages={[{ from: 'you', text: '…' }, { from: 'me', text: '…' }]} offer={{ after: 1, image: d, title: '首屏诊断 · 一周', note: '…', price: '¥12,000 起' }} quick={[{ label: '约个时间', reply: '…' }]} />
